papers.title: Reflex: Enabling Fast and Predictive Vision-Language-Action Models for Reaction-Critical Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently achieved promising performance in robotic manipulation. However, existing benchmarks mainly evaluate generalization on static manipulation tasks and largely overlook dynamic interaction scenarios. To address this gap, we present ReflexBench, a benchmark for reaction-critical manipulation. ReflexBench contains six dynamic tasks and introduces an evaluation framework that decouples simulator stepping from robot control while supporting configurable latency under synchronous and asynchronous inference. Building upon ReflexBench, we propose ReflexVLA, an efficient VLA model designed for reaction-critical manipulation without large-scale robot-data pretraining. ReflexVLA enhances temporal reasoning through latent future prediction and multi-frame temporal fusion within the vision backbone, while reducing deployment latency through batched visual encoding and CUDA Graph replay. Experiments show that ReflexVLA consistently improves dynamic manipulation performance while maintaining competitive accuracy on standard static manipulation benchmarks, and real-world experiments further demonstrate its effectiveness under practical deployment conditions. Project website: https://reflexvla.github.io
core_contributions: 提出了ReflexBench，一个包含六个动态任务的反应关键型操作基准，并引入了解耦模拟器步进与机器人控制的评估框架
提出了ReflexVLA，一个无需大规模机器人数据预训练的高效VLA模型，通过潜在未来预测和多帧时间融合增强时间推理，并通过批量视觉编码和CUDA Graph replay减少部署延迟
实验表明ReflexVLA在动态操作性能上持续提升，同时在静态基准上保持竞争力，真实世界实验验证了有效性
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型最近在机器人操作中取得了有希望的性能。然而，现有基准主要评估静态操作任务的泛化能力，而很大程度上忽略了动态交互场景。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了ReflexBench，一个用于反应关键型操作的基准。ReflexBench包含六个动态任务，并引入了一个评估框架，该框架将模拟器步进与机器人控制解耦，同时支持同步和异步推理下的可配置延迟。基于ReflexBench，我们提出了ReflexVLA，一个高效的VLA模型，专为反应关键型操作设计，无需大规模机器人数据预训练。ReflexVLA通过视觉骨干中的潜在未来预测和多帧时间融合增强了时间推理，同时通过批量视觉编码和CUDA Graph replay减少了部署延迟。实验表明，ReflexVLA在标准静态操作基准上保持竞争性准确率的同时，持续提高了动态操作性能，真实世界实验进一步证明了其在实际部署条件下的有效性。项目网站：https://reflexvla.github.io
papers.image_caption: Fig. 3 : Overview of ReflexVLA. ReflexVLA is an efficient vision-language-action model for reaction-critical robotic manipulation, integrating latent future prediction, multi-frame temporal fusion, and inference latency optimization to enable fast and anticipatory decision-making.

papers.title: Capstan-driven Continuum Surgical Robot: Design, Modeling, and Perception
papers.abstract: Shape and force sensing have long been critical bottlenecks in the development of compact capstan-driven continuum surgical robots, primarily due to the difficulty of obtaining cable tension information within the confined capstan assembly. To overcome these challenges, this paper presents an integrated design-modeling-sensing approach based on the concept of actuation-perception co-design. A compliant element is introduced into the motor mounting bracket of the drive system, enabling micro-deformation under the cable reaction force and thereby allowing real-time cable tension measurement without occupying the compact capstan space. To address the modeling complexity arising from unconventional joint configurations introduced by the spatial cable routing strategy, a parallel computation framework based on a multibody short-thick-beam model is proposed, which captures shear effects in short beam segments and synergistic multi-cable interactions while achieving real-time performance. Building on this framework, stable shape and force sensing is achieved by incorporating a proximal multi-axis force/torque sensor as an additional measurement anchor. Following this design-modeling-sensing framework, capstan-driven continuum surgical robots with single- and dual-segment configurations are developed. Experimental results validate the proposed framework in both single- and dual-segment continuum robots, demonstrating real-time tip pose estimation together with contact force and location perception. By enabling cable tension feedback without compromising the compact capstan architecture, the proposed framework makes integrated perception feasible for capstan-driven continuum surgical robots.
core_contributions: 提出了基于驱动-感知协同设计的集成设计-建模-传感方法
在电机安装支架中引入柔性元件，实现实时缆绳张力测量而不占用绞盘空间
提出了基于多体短粗梁模型的并行计算框架，处理空间缆绳布线带来的建模复杂性
通过集成近端多轴力/扭矩传感器实现了稳定的形状和力传感
开发了单段和双段配置的绞盘驱动连续体手术机器人并实验验证了框架的有效性
papers.abstract_zh: 形状和力传感长期以来一直是紧凑型绞盘驱动连续体手术机器人发展的关键瓶颈，主要由于在受限的绞盘组件内获取缆绳张力信息的困难。为了克服这些挑战，本文提出了一种基于驱动-感知协同设计概念的集成设计-建模-传感方法。在驱动系统的电机安装支架中引入一个柔性元件，使其在缆绳反作用力下产生微变形，从而在不占用紧凑绞盘空间的情况下实现实时缆绳张力测量。为了解决空间缆绳布线策略引入的非传统关节配置带来的建模复杂性，提出了一种基于多体短粗梁模型的并行计算框架，该框架捕捉短梁段中的剪切效应和多缆绳协同相互作用，同时实现实时性能。在此框架基础上，通过引入近端多轴力/扭矩传感器作为额外的测量锚点，实现了稳定的形状和力传感。遵循这一设计-建模-传感框架，开发了单段和双段配置的绞盘驱动连续体手术机器人。实验结果在单段和双段连续体机器人上验证了所提出的框架，展示了实时尖端姿态估计以及接触力和位置感知。通过在不影响紧凑绞盘架构的情况下实现缆绳张力反馈，所提出的框架使绞盘驱动连续体手术机器人的集成感知成为可能。

(a) Experimental setup for robot validation; (b) Experimental setup for validating cable tension sensing using strain gauges; (c) Error in force sensing using strain gauges; (d) Validation of bending in the plane A under no-load conditions; (e) Validation of bending in the plane A under a 25g load; (f) Validation of bending in the plane B under no-load conditions; (g) Validation of bending in the plane B under a 25g load.

papers.title: ContactGuard: Pre-Contact Execution Monitoring with Action-Conditioned Latent World Models
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation failures are often detected only after the robot has committed to contact. This is especially limiting in wrist-camera setups: close gripper--object views help observe contact, but a poor approach may already push, miss, slip, or disturb the object before conventional detectors react. We introduce \emph{ContactGuard}, a pre-contact execution monitor for chunked visuomotor policies. Given the policy's planned action chunk, ContactGuard predicts its short-horizon consequence in latent visual space and aborts if the predicted future latent indicates likely failure. Its latent world model is trained from unlabelled robot trajectories to predict compact multi-view visual embeddings under planned actions, avoiding pixel-level video prediction. A lightweight failure probe is then trained from a small labelled set of pre-contact clips. At deployment, ContactGuard anchors prediction before an imminent contact event, rolls the model forward under the policy's own actions, and verifies the predicted post-contact latent. Across real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, ContactGuard predicts failure more accurately than direct and corrupted-action ablations, and transfers to live robot as a pre-contact abort signal without modifying the underlying policy.
core_contributions: 提出ContactGuard，一种用于分块视觉运动策略的预接触执行监控器
利用潜在世界模型从无标签轨迹中预测动作的短期后果，避免像素级视频预测
使用少量标记的预接触片段训练轻量级失败探针
在真实世界任务中准确预测失败，并可作为预接触中止信号，无需修改底层策略
papers.abstract_zh: 接触丰富的操作失败通常只有在机器人已经接触之后才被检测到。这在腕部相机设置中尤其受限：近距离的夹爪-物体视图有助于观察接触，但在传统检测器反应之前，一个糟糕的接近可能已经推动、错过、滑动或干扰物体。我们提出了ContactGuard，一种用于分块视觉运动策略的预接触执行监控器。给定策略规划的动作块，ContactGuard在潜在视觉空间中预测其短期后果，如果预测的未来潜在表示指示可能失败，则中止。其潜在世界模型从未标记的机器人轨迹中训练，以在规划动作下预测紧凑的多视图视觉嵌入，避免了像素级视频预测。然后，从一小批标记的预接触片段中训练一个轻量级失败探针。在部署时，ContactGuard在即将发生的接触事件之前锚定预测，在策略自身动作下滚动模型，并验证预测的接触后潜在表示。在真实世界的接触丰富操作任务中，ContactGuard比直接和破坏动作消融更准确地预测失败，并作为预接触中止信号转移到真实机器人，而无需修改底层策略。
papers.image_caption: Figure 2: ContactGuard overview. A shared multi-view encoder maps camera observations to a latent context. An action-conditioned predictor rolls this context forward under the policy’s planned action chunk to produce future latents z ^ t + 1 : t + K \hat{z}_{t+1:t+K} . A lightweight probe is trained offline on labelled pre-contact clips and used online to score the predicted post-contact latent z ^ t + K \hat{z}_{t+K} . If the predicted failure probability exceeds threshold τ \tau , execution is aborted before contact. Training uses teacher-forced next-latent prediction; inference uses autoregressive rollout.
papers.summary_one_sentence: ContactGuard提出一种预接触执行监控方法，利用潜在世界模型预测动作块的结果并在失败前中止。
papers.research_problem: 接触丰富的操作失败通常只有在接触发生后才能被检测到，尤其是在腕部相机设置中，传统方法反应滞后，导致机器人可能已经推动、错过、滑动或干扰物体。
papers.method_summary: ContactGuard使用潜在世界模型，该模型从无标签机器人轨迹中训练，预测在规划动作下的多视图视觉嵌入。然后，从标记的预接触片段训练失败探针。部署时，在接触事件前锚定预测，滚动模型并验证接触后潜在表示，以决定是否中止。
papers.experimental_setup: 在真实世界的接触丰富操作任务上进行实验，与直接和破坏动作消融方法对比。
papers.key_results: ContactGuard比直接和破坏动作消融更准确地预测失败，并能作为预接触中止信号在真实机器人上运行，无需修改底层策略。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作解决了接触丰富操作中失败检测滞后的问题，通过预接触监控提高了操作安全性，且无需修改底层策略，具有实用价值。

papers.title: Decoding Task Progress from VLA Representations
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are moving rapidly towards deployment as general-purpose manipulation policies, but we currently lack basic tools for understanding what these models represent internally or for monitoring them at runtime. Leveraging ideas from mechanistic interpretability, we probe the residual stream of $π_{0.5}$ and find that task progress, the normalized time remaining in a trajectory, is linearly readable from the activations. We find that this signal is present in the pretrained PaliGemma backbone prior to training on any robot-specific data. A single linear probe generalizes to unseen tasks and varies under language counterfactuals when trained on multi-prompt data, but does not enable meaningful steering of the policy. These properties make the signal directly useful for instrumenting deployed VLAs. We use the probe as a simple label-free OOD detector, which detects stalled task progress, and find it competitive with state-of-the-art methods. Our results suggest that VLAs have rich, linearly readable internal representations of semantic quantities like task progress, and that learning to read these signals offers a lightweight, interpretable path toward monitoring deployed visuomotor policies.
core_contributions: 发现VLA模型残差流中任务进度可线性读取
任务进度信号存在于预训练PaliGemma骨干中
线性探针可泛化到未见任务并随语言反事实变化
探针作为无标签OOD检测器，性能与SOTA相当
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）正迅速向通用操作策略部署迈进，但目前我们缺乏理解这些模型内部表示或运行时监控的基本工具。利用机械可解释性的思想，我们探测了π0.5的残差流，发现任务进度（轨迹中归一化的剩余时间）可以从激活中线性读取。我们发现这个信号存在于预训练的PaliGemma骨干网络中，在训练任何机器人特定数据之前。一个单一的线性探针可以泛化到未见过的任务，并在多提示数据训练下随语言反事实变化，但不能实现有意义的策略引导。这些特性使得该信号直接可用于部署VLA的仪器化。我们使用该探针作为简单的无标签OOD检测器，检测停滞的任务进度，并发现它与最先进的方法具有竞争力。我们的结果表明，VLA具有丰富的、可线性读取的语义量内部表示，如任务进度，学习读取这些信号为监控部署的视觉运动策略提供了一条轻量级、可解释的路径。
papers.image_caption: Figure 3: Weak decodability of the progress feature across four models, probed at successive stages of training: PaliGemma (vision-language backbone only), base π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} (after large-scale robot pre-training, before fine-tuning), and VLABench fine-tuned π 0 \pi_{0} (a distinct VLA architecture), and VLABench fine-tuned π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} (our target model).

papers.title: hint$^2$: Hierarchical World Models for Inference-Time Temporal Logic Guidance
papers.abstract: A central goal of robot learning is to enable robots to execute rich instructions specified at runtime. Large-scale language-conditioned policies have made substantial progress toward this goal, yet still struggle with temporal structure and safety constraints. Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) provides a powerful language to express complex, non-Markovian instructions. However, guiding learned manipulation policies toward LTL satisfaction remains challenging because modern policies generate short-horizon action chunks and replan in closed loop, while almost all LTL specifications are evaluated over long-horizon trajectories. In this paper, we introduce hint$^2$, a method for guiding short-horizon policies toward satisfying complex LTL specifications at inference time using hierarchical world models. Our key idea is to derive two separate guidance objectives using each world model's abstraction level. A high-level model predicts future action-induced transitions in task-relevant atomic propositions to guide progress through the LTL automaton, while a low-level dynamics model predicts immediate state evolution for accurate local safety guidance. Our results show that hint$^2$ overcomes the limitations of current LTL-guided diffusion methods, outperforms existing inference-time steering methods in CALVIN, and successfully completes instructions with complex liveness and safety constraints more elegantly than language-conditioned alternatives. Finally, we demonstrate that hint$^2$ can handle complex instructions on a real UR5e manipulator.
core_contributions: 提出hint$^2$方法，利用分层世界模型在推理时引导策略满足LTL规范。
设计高层世界模型预测原子命题转换以指导LTL自动机进展，低层世界模型预测状态演化以提供局部安全引导。
在CALVIN基准和真实UR5e机械臂上验证了方法有效性，优于现有推理时引导方法。
papers.abstract_zh: 机器人学习的一个核心目标是使机器人能够执行运行时指定的丰富指令。大规模语言条件策略已经朝着这个目标取得了实质性进展，但仍然难以处理时间结构和安全约束。线性时序逻辑（LTL）提供了一种强大的语言来表达复杂的非马尔可夫指令。然而，引导学习到的操作策略满足LTL仍然具有挑战性，因为现代策略生成短视动作块并在闭环中重新规划，而几乎所有LTL规范都是在长视轨迹上评估的。在本文中，我们介绍了hint$^2$，一种使用分层世界模型在推理时引导短视策略满足复杂LTL规范的方法。我们的关键思想是利用每个世界模型的抽象级别推导出两个独立的引导目标。高层模型预测未来动作引起的任务相关原子命题转换，以指导LTL自动机的进展，而低层动力学模型预测即时状态演化，以提供准确的局部安全引导。我们的结果表明，hint$^2$克服了当前LTL引导扩散方法的局限性，在CALVIN基准上优于现有的推理时引导方法，并且比语言条件替代方案更优雅地完成了具有复杂活性和安全约束的指令。最后，我们展示了hint$^2$可以在真实的UR5e机械臂上处理复杂指令。
papers.image_caption: Figure 1: Our method hint 2 can guide a diffusion policy based on TL constraints specified at inference time. In the CALVIN environment, hint 2 executes complex long-horizon instructions that a state-of-the-art vision-language-action policy trained on the same data fails to complete.

papers.title: Policy-Induced Hand Priors in Humanoid Dual-Arm Manipulation: Diagnosing and Mitigating Initial-Pose Dependence
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies are expected to operate robustly across variations in the robot's initial configuration, yet aggregate task success can conceal pose-specific failures and inappropriate hand selection. This work investigates initial-pose dependence in VLA-based humanoid dual-arm manipulation. We characterize the initial-condition-dependent early hand preference as a policy-induced hand prior and quantify it using HandPriorScore, residual hand bias, and target responsiveness. Evaluations across multiple policies and 17 initial configurations reveal strong initial-pose--policy interactions: the same pose produces substantially different success rates across policies, while a single policy exhibits large performance variation across poses. Specific initial arm configurations can suppress or induce an asymmetric hand preference, with the resulting effect varying in direction and strength across policies. Wrist-camera observations also influence hand selection and task performance. Expanding initial-pose coverage in the training dataset substantially improves robustness, while targeted augmentation around a low-performing configuration increases its success rate. Comparisons across training configurations show that sufficient exposure to the target simulation task is beneficial, whereas the effect of real or auxiliary data depends on pose coverage, simulation ratio, and observation availability. These findings characterize a pose-conditioned hand prior, identify a localized initial arm configuration as a causal handle on hand-selection behavior, and demonstrate how data coverage and training composition affect initial-pose robustness.
core_contributions: 表征了初始条件依赖的早期手部偏好作为策略诱导的手部先验
提出了量化手部先验的指标：HandPriorScore、残余手部偏差和目标响应性
揭示了初始姿态-策略交互：相同姿态在不同策略下成功率不同，单个策略在不同姿态下性能变化大
发现特定初始手臂配置可以抑制或诱导不对称手部偏好，且效果因策略而异
发现腕部摄像头观察影响手部选择和任务性能
证明扩展初始姿态覆盖和针对性数据增强可提高鲁棒性
比较了训练配置的影响，表明充分暴露于目标模拟任务有益，真实或辅助数据效果取决于多种因素
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略预期能够在机器人初始配置的变化下稳健运行，但聚合的任务成功可能掩盖特定于姿态的失败和不恰当的手部选择。本文研究了基于VLA的人形双臂操作中的初始姿态依赖性。我们将依赖于初始条件的早期手部偏好表征为策略诱导的手部先验，并使用HandPriorScore、残余手部偏差和目标响应性对其进行量化。在多个策略和17种初始配置上的评估揭示了强烈的初始姿态-策略交互：相同的姿态在不同策略下产生显著不同的成功率，而单个策略在不同姿态下表现出较大的性能变化。特定的初始手臂配置可以抑制或诱导不对称的手部偏好，其产生的效果在不同策略中方向和强度各异。腕部摄像头观察也影响手部选择和任务性能。在训练数据集中扩展初始姿态覆盖范围显著提高了鲁棒性，而围绕低性能配置进行有针对性的数据增强则提高了其成功率。跨训练配置的比较表明，充分暴露于目标模拟任务是有益的，而真实或辅助数据的效果取决于姿态覆盖范围、模拟比率和观察可用性。这些发现表征了一种姿态条件手部先验，确定了局部初始手臂配置作为手部选择行为的因果手柄，并展示了数据覆盖和训练组成如何影响初始姿态鲁棒性。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 本文研究了VLA策略在人形双臂操作中的初始姿态依赖性，提出了量化手部先验的指标，并揭示了数据覆盖和训练组成对鲁棒性的影响。

papers.title: G0.5: One Autoregressive Stream for Robot Reasoning and Action
papers.abstract: The prevailing recipe for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models couples a pretrained VLM with a separately trained flow-matching action expert. This makes the VLM a context encoder rather than a decision-maker. We introduce G0.5, a pretrained autoregressive VLA in which a single transformer decoder emits reasoning and action tokens under a single objective. Three components make this tractable at foundation-model scale: a learnable cross-embodiment action tokenizer that maps heterogeneous robot actions into a shared vocabulary; a native chain-of-thought stream interleaving task decomposition, object grounding, and action hints with action tokens; and a visual memory module that injects multi-second history through the vision encoder. Because reasoning and action share a single set of weights, the pretrained VLM's capabilities carry over to physical behavior: the model follows instructions closely, and prompts directly steer action granularity, task horizon, and out-of-distribution scene handling without further training. Pretrained on a large collection of robot datasets together with VQA samples, G0.5 surpasses state-of-the-art models across 7 independent regimes: real-world fine-tuning on R1lite and R1pro robots (76.7\% vs.\ 53.3\% for $π_{0.5}$ and 24.4\% for GR00T-N1.7), the 2025 BEHAVIOR Challenge on 50 long-horizon household mobile manipulation tasks using a generalist policy (31.4\% vs.\ 26.3\% for $π_{0.5}$ and 26.1\% for the challenge winner), DROID post-training followed by zero-shot transfer to an unseen environment and objects (82.5\%), a language-following Pick-and-Place benchmark, LIBERO (98.9\%), RoboTwin 2.0 (93.3\%), and SimplerEnv-Bridge (87.3\%).
core_contributions: 提出可学习的跨具身动作分词器，将异构机器人动作映射到共享词汇表
设计原生思维链流，交织任务分解、对象定位和动作提示与动作token
引入视觉记忆模块，通过视觉编码器注入多秒历史信息
推理和动作共享同一组权重，实现预训练VLM能力向物理行为的迁移
在7个独立场景中超越最先进模型，包括真实世界微调、长时域任务和零样本迁移
papers.abstract_zh: 当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的主流方法是将预训练的VLM与单独训练的流匹配动作专家结合。这使得VLM成为上下文编码器而非决策者。我们提出G0.5，一个预训练的自回归VLA，其中单个Transformer解码器在单一目标下发出推理和动作token。三个组件使其在基础模型规模下可行：一个可学习的跨具身动作分词器，将异构机器人动作映射到共享词汇表；一个原生思维链流，交织任务分解、对象定位和动作提示与动作token；以及一个视觉记忆模块，通过视觉编码器注入多秒历史。由于推理和动作共享同一组权重，预训练VLM的能力迁移到物理行为：模型紧密遵循指令，提示直接引导动作粒度、任务时域和分布外场景处理，无需进一步训练。在大量机器人数据集和VQA样本上预训练后，G0.5在7个独立场景中超越了最先进模型：在R1lite和R1pro机器人上的真实世界微调（76.7%对比π0.5的53.3%和GR00T-N1.7的24.4%）；2025年BEHAVIOR挑战赛，使用通用策略在50个长时域家庭移动操作任务上（31.4%对比π0.5的26.3%和挑战获胜者的26.1%）；DROID后训练后零样本迁移到未见环境和物体（82.5%）；语言跟随的拾取和放置基准LIBERO（98.9%）、RoboTwin 2.0（93.3%）和SimplerEnv-Bridge（87.3%）。
papers.summary_one_sentence: G0.5是一个预训练的自回归视觉-语言-动作模型，通过单个Transformer解码器统一推理和动作生成，在多个机器人操作基准上达到最先进性能。

papers.key_results: 真实世界微调：76.7% (G0.5) vs 53.3% (π0.5) vs 24.4% (GR00T-N1.7)；BEHAVIOR Challenge：31.4% (G0.5) vs 26.3% (π0.5) vs 26.1% (挑战获胜者)；DROID零样本迁移：82.5%；LIBERO：98.9%；RoboTwin 2.0：93.3%；SimplerEnv-Bridge：87.3%。

Heterogeneous robot actions are decomposed into semantically aligned motion parts, encoded with a residual vector quantizer, and serialized as part-specific action tokens. This representation shares one action vocabulary across embodiments while allowing sparse prediction over only the activated parts.

papers.title: StellaVLA: In-Context Structured Demonstration for Generalizable Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can follow instructions and manipulate objects, but their performance often collapses out of distribution (OOD), when the scene, viewpoint, or object differs from training. Adapting to each new situation typically requires collecting more data and fine-tuning. We present StellaVLA, a framework that instead adapts at test time by conditioning on a single retrieved demonstration. The key idea is to move beyond imitating what an expert did and instead convey why: an automated offline pipeline converts each raw trajectory into a structured demonstration, e.g., a task plan, sub-goal descriptions, and verbalized 3D motion, at zero human-annotation cost. Provided as in-context guidance, this structured demonstration lets the policy reason about the task rather than mimic a pixel trajectory, which also makes it transferable across embodiments (real-robot, human-hand, or XR demonstrations). A parallel dual-training design internalizes this reasoning during training through a joint action-and-language objective, while inference uses the action expert alone, preserving real-time, high-frequency control with no added latency. On the VLA-Arena leaderboard(Aug 1, 2026), StellaVLA ranks first with an overall score of 0.63, versus 0.44 and 0.22 for the strong prior models ($π_{0.5}$ and LingBot-VLA), and it further leads on LIBERO with 98.8% average success rate and LIBERO-Plus with 85.1% success rate. Our real-robot benchmark demonstrates that StellaVLA can use both human/robot demos and human-to-robot (XR) demos as in-context structured demonstration to help VLA model adapt to OOD tasks.
core_contributions: 提出StellaVLA框架，通过测试时基于单个检索的演示进行适应，无需微调。
引入自动离线管道将原始轨迹转换为结构化演示（任务计划、子目标描述、口头化3D运动），零人工注释成本。
结构化演示作为上下文指导，使策略推理任务而非模仿像素轨迹，并支持跨具身转移。
设计并行双训练框架，联合动作和语言目标内化推理，推理仅用动作专家，保持实时控制无额外延迟。
在VLA-Arena排行榜上取得第一名，LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus上取得高成功率，真实机器人验证有效。
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型可以遵循指令并操作物体，但当场景、视角或物体与训练不同时，其性能通常在分布外（OOD）崩溃。适应每种新情况通常需要收集更多数据和微调。我们提出StellaVLA，一个框架，通过在测试时基于单个检索的演示进行条件化来适应。关键思想是超越模仿专家做了什么，而是传达为什么：一个自动离线管道将每个原始轨迹转换为结构化演示，例如任务计划、子目标描述和口头化3D运动，零人工注释成本。作为上下文指导提供，这种结构化演示让策略推理任务而不是模仿像素轨迹，这也使其可跨具身（真实机器人、人手或XR演示）转移。并行双训练设计通过联合动作和语言目标在训练期间内化这种推理，而推理仅使用动作专家，保持实时高频控制无额外延迟。在VLA-Arena排行榜（2026年8月1日）上，StellaVLA以总体得分0.63排名第一，而强先验模型（π0.5和LingBot-VLA）分别为0.44和0.22，并在LIBERO上以98.8%平均成功率和LIBERO-Plus上85.1%成功率进一步领先。我们的真实机器人基准测试表明，StellaVLA可以使用人类/机器人演示和人类到机器人（XR）演示作为上下文结构化演示来帮助VLA模型适应OOD任务。
papers.summary_one_sentence: StellaVLA通过上下文结构化演示实现视觉-语言-动作模型的泛化，无需微调即可适应分布外任务。
papers.research_problem: 视觉-语言-动作模型在分布外场景下性能下降，需要额外数据和微调才能适应新情况。
papers.method_summary: StellaVLA使用自动离线管道将每个原始演示轨迹转换为结构化格式，包括任务计划、子目标描述和口头化3D运动。训练时采用并行双训练设计，通过联合动作和语言目标让模型内化推理能力；测试时基于检索的单个结构化演示作为上下文指导，仅使用动作专家进行实时高频控制，无需额外延迟。
papers.experimental_setup: 在VLA-Arena排行榜上评估，与π0.5和LingBot-VLA对比；在LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus数据集上测试成功率；在真实机器人基准测试中使用人类/机器人演示和人类到机器人（XR）演示作为上下文结构化演示。
papers.key_results: 在VLA-Arena上总体得分0.63，领先于π0.5（0.44）和LingBot-VLA（0.22）；LIBERO上平均成功率98.8%；LIBERO-Plus上成功率85.1%；真实机器人上成功使用不同演示适应分布外任务。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作解决了VLA模型分布外泛化难题，通过结构化演示传递任务推理，无需额外数据或微调即可适应新场景，显著提升了泛化性和跨具身转移能力，对机器人操作和具身智能的实际部署具有重要意义。

papers.image_caption: Figure 2 : Overview of StellaVLA. Top left: a retrieved context demonstration is represented as a task plan and a sequence of subgoals, each containing a keyframe, robot state, 2D trace, and 3D motion. Right: these annotations are generated automatically offline from VLM reasoning and robot trajectories, without human labeling. Bottom left: the vision-language model encodes the demonstration together with the current observation and instruction into a shared representation, which is consumed by an action expert for action prediction and a spatial-language expert for auxiliary supervision during training only. The spatial-language expert is removed at inference, requiring only a single forward pass.
papers.image_caption_zh: StellaVLA概述。左上：检索到的上下文演示表示为任务计划和一系列子目标，每个子目标包含关键帧、机器人状态、2D轨迹和3D运动。右：这些注释通过VLM推理和机器人轨迹自动离线生成，无需人工标注。左下：视觉语言模型将演示与当前观察和指令编码为共享表示，该表示由动作专家用于动作预测，并由空间语言专家用于训练期间的辅助监督。推理时移除空间语言专家，仅需一次前向传播。

papers.title: Surgical WAM: A World-Action Model for Data-Efficient Surgical Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Learning reliable surgical manipulation policies is bottlenecked by the scarcity of action-labeled demonstrations: teleoperated surgical robot (e.g., dVRK) trajectories with synchronized kinematics are costly to collect, while surgical tasks demand precise contact handling, long-horizon reasoning, and bimanual coordination. Endoscopic video is comparatively inexpensive and abundant relative to synchronized video--kinematics trajectories, and a natural way to exploit it is to learn world models of surgical scenes. However, existing surgical world models use video primarily for simulation or policy evaluation, and rarely translate the learned dynamics into closed-loop control. This gap raises our central question: under a fixed budget of action-labeled demonstrations, does action-free video pretraining improve closed-loop surgical manipulation? To answer it, we introduce the Surgical World-Action Model (Surgical WAM), a unified generative model built on Cosmos Policy that jointly predicts future endoscopic observations and executable surgical robot action chunks. Surgical WAM first learns surgical visual dynamics from action-free video and is then fine-tuned on the fixed action-labeled budget; at deployment, it acts as a closed-loop, receding-horizon controller that executes a short prefix of each predicted action chunk and replans from the resulting observation. On a suite of four simulated surgical manipulation tasks, video pretraining improves the average success rate from 63.5% to 77.8%, including an absolute gain of 20 percentage points on PegTransfer, with the largest improvements on contact-rich and bimanual tasks. These results demonstrate that action-free video provides transferable visual dynamics priors for learning surgical robot control with limited action supervision, positioning data-efficient video pretraining as a practical path toward scaling up surgical robot learning.
core_contributions: 提出了Surgical WAM，一个统一生成模型，联合预测未来内窥镜观察和可执行手术机器人动作块。
利用无动作视频预训练学习手术视觉动态，然后在固定动作标注预算上微调，实现数据高效学习。
在部署时作为闭环、滚动时域控制器，执行预测动作块前缀并重新规划。
在四个模拟手术操作任务上验证了视频预训练的有效性，平均成功率从63.5%提升至77.8%。
papers.abstract_zh: 学习可靠的手术操作策略受限于动作标注演示的稀缺性：通过遥操作手术机器人（如dVRK）收集带有同步运动学的轨迹成本高昂，而手术任务需要精确的接触处理、长程推理和双手协调。相比之下，内窥镜视频相对于同步视频-运动学轨迹更便宜且丰富，利用它的自然方式是学习手术场景的世界模型。然而，现有的手术世界模型主要将视频用于模拟或策略评估，很少将学习到的动态转化为闭环控制。这一差距引出了我们的核心问题：在固定预算的动作标注演示下，无动作视频预训练是否能改善闭环手术操作？为了回答这个问题，我们引入了手术世界-动作模型（Surgical WAM），这是一个基于Cosmos Policy构建的统一生成模型，联合预测未来的内窥镜观察和可执行的手术机器人动作块。Surgical WAM首先从无动作视频中学习手术视觉动态，然后在固定的动作标注预算上进行微调；在部署时，它作为一个闭环、滚动时域控制器，执行每个预测动作块的一个短前缀，并根据产生的观察重新规划。在四个模拟手术操作任务上，视频预训练将平均成功率从63.5%提高到77.8%，包括在PegTransfer上绝对提升20个百分点，在接触丰富和双手任务上提升最大。这些结果表明，无动作视频为在有限动作监督下学习手术机器人控制提供了可迁移的视觉动态先验，将数据高效的视频预训练定位为扩展手术机器人学习的实用路径。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出Surgical WAM，通过无动作视频预训练学习手术视觉动态，然后在有限动作标注数据上微调，作为闭环控制器显著提升模拟手术操作任务的成功率。
papers.research_problem: 在固定预算的动作标注演示下，无动作视频预训练是否能改善闭环手术操作？
papers.method_summary: Surgical WAM基于Cosmos Policy构建，首先从无动作视频中学习手术视觉动态（世界模型），然后在固定数量的动作标注轨迹上微调，以联合预测未来观察和动作块。部署时，它作为闭环控制器，在每个时间步预测一个动作块，执行前几个动作，然后根据新观察重新预测。
papers.experimental_setup: 在四个模拟手术操作任务上评估，包括PegTransfer等接触丰富和双手协调任务。使用固定预算的动作标注演示，比较有无视频预训练的成功率。具体任务细节和超参数未在摘要中详述。

papers.why_it_matters: 这项工作表明，无动作视频预训练可以为手术机器人控制提供可迁移的视觉动态先验，显著减少对昂贵动作标注数据的依赖，为数据高效的手术机器人学习扩展提供了实用路径。

papers.image_caption: Figure 2: Surgical WAM architecture and two-stage training recipe. (Top) Architecture. Closed-loop inference with the Surgical WAM on SurRoL peg transfer. At each control step, the model conditions on the current endoscopic frame, robot state and goal, and the task text. A single video-action diffusion transformer samples an action chunk in the same latent sequence used for visual/state prediction. (Bottom) Two-stage training recipe. Stage 1 (Video pretraining): the world model is fine-tuned on unlabeled surgical video using only the video loss ℒ vid \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{vid}} ; action latent frames are masked (zeroed). Stage 2 (Joint fine-tuning): the pretrained world model is jointly fine-tuned on action-labeled demonstrations using the full objective ℒ joint \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{joint}} .
papers.image_caption_zh: 手术WAM架构与两阶段训练方案。（上）架构。在SurRoL peg转移上使用手术WAM进行闭环推理。在每个控制步骤，模型以当前内窥镜帧、机器人状态和目标以及任务文本为条件。一个视频-动作扩散变压器在用于视觉/状态预测的相同潜在序列中采样一个动作块。（下）两阶段训练方案。阶段1（视频预训练）：世界模型仅在未标记的手术视频上使用视频损失ℒ_vid微调；动作潜在帧被掩码（置零）。阶段2（联合微调）：预训练的世界模型在带动作标签的演示上使用完整目标ℒ_joint联合微调。

papers.title: Neural Introspection Gating for Adaptive KV-Cache Reuse in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action(VLA) models map camera images and language instructions directly to motor commands through a single autoregressive transformer. In real-time control, they still spend substantial compute recomputing key-value(KV) representations for visual tokens that barely change across neighboring frames. Recent work such as VLA-Cache reduces that cost by reusing KV states for visually static patches, but its policy relies only on observation-space heuristics and does not account for the model's own uncertainty. We propose Gated VLA-Cache, a lightweight, training-free extension that augments visual-similarity caching with neural introspection. The method monitors the logit margin between the top two predicted action tokens, a zero-cost confidence signal available during decoding. When the margin drops below a threshold, the cache is invalidated and a full recompute is triggered. Evaluated on four LIBERO benchmark suites with both OpenVLA and OpenVLA-OFT, Gated VLA-Cache improves reliability when blind caching hurts. On LIBERO-Goal and LIBERO-Long, it recovers over 100% of the lost accuracy while retaining 80% of the compute savings.
core_contributions: 提出Gated VLA-Cache，一种轻量级、无需训练的扩展，通过神经内省增强视觉相似性缓存。
利用解码过程中前两个预测动作标记的logit间隔作为零成本置信度信号，自适应控制缓存失效。
在四个LIBERO基准套件上验证，该方法在恢复损失精度的同时保留了大部分计算节省。
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过单一的自回归变换器将相机图像和语言指令直接映射到电机命令。在实时控制中，它们仍然花费大量计算来重新计算在相邻帧中几乎不变的视觉标记的键值（KV）表示。最近的工作如VLA-Cache通过重用视觉静态补丁的KV状态来减少计算成本，但其策略仅依赖于观测空间启发式，并未考虑模型自身的不确定性。我们提出Gated VLA-Cache，一种轻量级、无需训练的扩展，通过神经内省增强视觉相似性缓存。该方法监测解码过程中可用的零成本置信度信号——前两个预测动作标记之间的logit间隔。当间隔低于阈值时，缓存失效并触发完全重新计算。在四个LIBERO基准套件上使用OpenVLA和OpenVLA-OFT进行评估，Gated VLA-Cache在盲目缓存有害时提高了可靠性。在LIBERO-Goal和LIBERO-Long上，它恢复了超过100%的损失精度，同时保留了80%的计算节省。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出Gated VLA-Cache，通过神经内省门控机制自适应重用KV缓存，在保持计算节省的同时提高VLA模型在机器人操作中的可靠性。
papers.research_problem: VLA模型在实时控制中重复计算几乎不变的视觉标记的KV表示，现有缓存策略仅基于观测空间启发式，未考虑模型自身的不确定性，导致在盲目缓存时性能下降。
papers.method_summary: 通过监测前两个预测动作标记的logit间隔作为模型置信度信号，当间隔低于预设阈值时使缓存失效并触发完全重新计算，从而在视觉相似性缓存基础上引入神经内省门控。
papers.experimental_setup: 在LIBERO-Goal、LIBERO-Long等四个LIBERO基准套件上，使用OpenVLA和OpenVLA-OFT模型进行评估。
papers.key_results: 在LIBERO-Goal和LIBERO-Long上，恢复了超过100%的损失精度，同时保留了80%的计算节省。
papers.why_it_matters: 该方法通过简单有效的门控机制平衡了VLA模型在实时控制中的计算效率与任务性能，提升了缓存策略的可靠性，对机器人操作中的高效推理具有实际意义。

papers.image_caption: Figure 2 : Gated VLA-Cache architecture. At each step t t , the logit-margin gate evaluates the action confidence from step t − 1 t{-}1 . If the margin signals low confidence, the cache is invalidated and full inference runs for step t t . Otherwise, the standard VLA-Cache pipeline proceeds.
papers.image_caption_zh: 门控VLA-Cache架构。在每个时间步t，logit-margin门评估来自时间步t-1的动作置信度。若置信度低，则缓存失效并对时间步t运行完整推理；否则，执行标准VLA-Cache流程。

papers.title: SpeedTuning: Speeding Up Policy Execution with Lightweight Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: While learned robotic policies hold promise for advancing generalizable manipulation, their practical deployment is often hindered by suboptimal execution speeds. Imitation learning policies are inherently limited by hardware constraints and the speed of the operator during data collection. In addition, there are no established methods for accelerating policies learned via imitation, and the empirical relationship between execution speed and task success remains underexplored. To address these issues, we introduce SpeedTuning, a reinforcement learning framework specifically designed to enhance the speed of manipulation policies. SpeedTuning learns to predict the optimal execution speed for actions, thereby complementing a base policy without necessitating additional data collection. We provide empirical evidence that SpeedTuning achieves substantial improvements in execution speed, exceeding 2.4x speed-up, while preserving an adequate success rate compared to both the original task policy and straightforward speed-up methods such as linear interpolation at a fixed speed. We evaluate our approach across a diverse set of dynamic and precise tasks, including pouring, throwing, and picking, demonstrating its effectiveness and robustness in enhancing real-world robotic manipulation. Videos and code are available at https://daivdyuan.github.io/speed-tuning/
core_contributions: 提出SpeedTuning框架，利用强化学习学习预测动作的最佳执行速度，从而加速基础策略。
无需额外数据收集，直接对现有模仿学习策略进行速度优化。
在多种动态和精确任务（倒水、投掷、拾取）上实现超过2.4倍执行速度提升，同时保持与原始策略相当的成功率。
提供了与简单加速方法（如固定速度线性插值）的实证比较，展示了方法的有效性。
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然学习型机器人策略在推进通用操作方面具有前景，但其实际部署常常受到次优执行速度的阻碍。模仿学习策略本质上受到硬件限制和数据收集时操作员速度的制约。此外，目前还没有成熟的方法来加速通过模仿学习的策略，并且执行速度与任务成功之间的经验关系仍未得到充分探索。为了解决这些问题，我们引入了SpeedTuning，这是一个专门设计用于提高操作策略速度的强化学习框架。SpeedTuning学习预测动作的最佳执行速度，从而补充基础策略，无需额外数据收集。我们提供的经验证据表明，与原始任务策略和简单的加速方法（如固定速度的线性插值）相比，SpeedTuning实现了执行速度的显著提升，超过2.4倍加速，同时保持了足够的成功率。我们在包括倒水、投掷和拾取在内的多种动态和精确任务上评估了我们的方法，展示了其在增强真实世界机器人操作方面的有效性和鲁棒性。视频和代码可在https://daivdyuan.github.io/speed-tuning/获取。
papers.summary_one_sentence: SpeedTuning是一个强化学习框架，通过学习预测最优执行速度来加速机器人操作策略，实现超过2.4倍加速同时保持成功率。
papers.research_problem: 如何在不额外收集数据的情况下加速机器人操作策略的执行速度，同时保持任务成功率？
papers.method_summary: SpeedTuning使用强化学习训练一个模块，该模块根据当前状态预测动作执行的最佳速度因子，从而在运行时动态调整基础策略输出的动作速度，无需修改基础策略或重新收集数据。

papers.title: Trajectory Divergence Horizon Decision for Reliable Dual-Arm Surgical Subtask Manipulation
papers.abstract: Surgical robotic systems are increasingly being adopted as clinical workload rises, motivating autonomous solutions for repetitive manipulation subtasks. Learning-based controllers improve generalization compared with rule-based and analytic approaches, but most are trained for individual tasks and remain difficult to reuse across procedures. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a unified framework that integrates visual perception, language grounding, and action generation, offering a promising path toward more composable surgical autonomy. However, existing VLA policies rely on fixed-length open-loop action sequences, where changing scene conditions can lead to accumulated errors and potential risks in surgical manipulation. To mitigate this issue, we formulate surgical VLA deployment as an adaptive execution-horizon decision problem and propose Trajectory Divergence Horizon Decision (TDHD), a test-time mechanism that estimates step-wise action reliability by measuring the divergence between two flow-matching-generated trajectories under small noise perturbations and truncates execution using a dual-threshold rule to trigger timely replanning. We further establish a real-world da Vinci-like dual-arm benchmark with synchronized multi-view perception and language instructions, and collect 600 teleoperated demonstrations across needle (reach, pick, regrasp) and tissue (reach, lift, resection) manipulation suites. On real hardware with 20 trials per task setting, TDHD consistently improves performance over the latest VLA baselines: success increases from 55\% to 60\% for needle manipulation and from 55\% to 80\% for tissue manipulation, with the largest gains observed in the final manipulation stages. These results highlight the importance of adaptive execution control for reliable deployment of VLA models in surgical robotic manipulation.
core_contributions: 将手术VLA部署形式化为自适应执行水平决策问题
提出TDHD机制，通过测量流匹配生成轨迹的发散度并用双阈值规则触发重新规划
建立真实da Vinci-like双手机器人基准，包含多视角感知和语言指令，收集600次遥操作演示
在真实硬件上验证，性能优于最新VLA基线
papers.abstract_zh: 随着临床工作量的增加，手术机器人系统被越来越多地采用，这促使了针对重复性操作子任务的自主解决方案。与基于规则和分析的方法相比，基于学习的控制器提高了泛化能力，但大多数是为单个任务训练的，难以跨程序重用。视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型提供了一个统一框架，整合了视觉感知、语言基础和动作生成，为更可组合的手术自主性提供了有希望的路径。然而，现有的VLA策略依赖于固定长度的开环动作序列，场景变化可能导致累积误差和手术操作中的潜在风险。为了缓解这个问题，我们将手术VLA部署形式化为一个自适应执行水平决策问题，并提出了轨迹发散水平决策（TDHD），这是一种测试时机制，通过测量两个流匹配生成轨迹在小噪声扰动下的发散度来估计逐步骤动作可靠性，并使用双阈值规则截断执行以触发及时重新规划。我们进一步建立了一个真实的达芬奇式双手机器人基准，具有同步多视角感知和语言指令，并收集了600次遥操作演示，涵盖针操作（到达、抓取、重抓）和组织操作（到达、提起、切除）套件。在真实硬件上每个任务设置20次试验，TDHD一致地提高了性能，优于最新的VLA基线：针操作成功率从55%提高到60%，组织操作成功率从55%提高到80%，最大的提升出现在最终操作阶段。这些结果强调了自适应执行控制对于VLA模型在手术机器人操作中可靠部署的重要性。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 本文提出轨迹发散水平决策（TDHD）机制，通过自适应执行水平决策提高视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在双手机器人手术操作中的可靠性，并在真实硬件上验证了成功率提升。

papers.title: Skills in Weights, Memory in Code: Hybrid Learning for Memory-Dependent Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Modern vision-language-action (VLA) policies have acquired broad manipulation skills, but typically generate each action chunk from the current observation or a short fixed-length history. However, real-world manipulation is often non-Markovian, requiring robots to retain and reason over task-relevant information from long-horizon interaction histories to determine the next action. To address this challenge, we propose HyMeS, a hybrid learning framework that leverages the reasoning and memory-management capabilities of coding agents to steer a Markovian VLA for memory-dependent manipulation. Specifically, HyMeS learns low-level motor skills through gradient-based imitation learning, while a coding agent acquires high-level memory-management strategies through heuristic learning by iteratively updating an executable heuristic system from rollout feedback. Furthermore, we close the loop between steering and execution through multimodal stage-completion verification, which updates memory using proprioceptive signals and multi-frame VLM judgments. Compared with end-to-end memory-augmented VLAs, HyMeS requires demonstrations only for reusable motor skills rather than for every history-dependent task configuration, enabling data-efficient compositional generalization. On RoboMemArena, HyMeS improves mean cumulative success from 52.5% to 66.2% and mean task success from 41.3% to 60.1% over pi0.5, while outperforming PrediMem by 4.5 points in cumulative success and 14.5 points in task success.
core_contributions: 提出HyMeS，一种混合学习框架，结合梯度模仿学习和启发式学习进行记忆管理。
利用编码代理进行高层记忆管理策略的启发式学习。
通过多模态阶段完成验证闭环引导与执行。
实现数据高效的组合泛化，仅需可重用运动技能演示。
在RoboMemArena上显著提升任务成功率和累积成功率。
papers.abstract_zh: 现代视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略已经获得了广泛的操作技能，但通常从当前观察或短固定长度历史生成每个动作块。然而，现实世界的操作通常是非马尔可夫的，要求机器人保留并推理长期交互历史中的任务相关信息以确定下一个动作。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了HyMeS，一种混合学习框架，利用编码代理的推理和记忆管理能力来引导马尔可夫VLA进行记忆依赖的操作。具体来说，HyMeS通过基于梯度的模仿学习学习低层运动技能，而编码代理通过启发式学习获取高层记忆管理策略，通过从rollout反馈迭代更新可执行启发式系统。此外，我们通过多模态阶段完成验证来闭环引导与执行，该验证使用本体感觉信号和多帧VLM判断更新记忆。与端到端记忆增强VLA相比，HyMeS只需要可重用运动技能的演示，而不是每个历史依赖任务配置的演示，从而实现数据高效的组合泛化。在RoboMemArena上，HyMeS将平均累积成功率从52.5%提高到66.2%，平均任务成功率从41.3%提高到60.1%，优于pi0.5，同时在累积成功率上超过PrediMem 4.5个百分点，在任务成功率上超过14.5个百分点。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出HyMeS混合学习框架，通过编码代理管理记忆引导马尔可夫VLA，实现数据高效的记忆依赖机器人操作。

papers.image_caption: Figure 2: Overview of the HyMeS within-episode execution loop. The instruction and the current observation are passed to the pretrained policy in weight space , whose weights stay fixed throughout. At initialization and after each verified stage transition, SAM and DINOv2 extract task-relevant keypoints; the coding agent (claude code / codex) combines them with the observation and the program 𝒫 ( n ) \mathcal{P}^{(n)} refined over prior rollouts to instantiate a code-space memory holding an executable plan, the current stage, its verification rules, and a stage-specific constraint reward. The gradient of that reward is injected into action generation as guidance, so the executed action chunk 𝐚 t \mathbf{a}_{t} follows the current memory state without any weight update. PACE verifies progress using synchronized multi-frame visual and joint-state evidence, advancing the stage only when at least k k of the most recent w w completion queries pass.

papers.title: SLIM-0.5B: Learning Action-Grounded Predictive Latents for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action policies rely on large multimodal backbones to jointly perform perception, language conditioning, and action generation at every control step. Much of this capacity supports open-domain semantics, whereas continuous robot manipulation primarily requires compact representations of observations, actions, and the transitions induced by actions. Pixel-level world models provide another route, but predicting visual details irrelevant to control can be unnecessarily expensive. We propose SLIM (Self-supervised Latent Interaction Model), a compact 0.5B-parameter latent interaction policy. SLIM learns action-grounded predictive latents that capture both action-conditioned future transitions and the actions that explain observed changes. SLIM learns these representations through self-supervised masked trajectory prediction, combining action reconstruction with future-latent prediction. A compact Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) backbone models interactions between observation latents and action tokens. The resulting policy is trained with flow matching for language-conditioned action generation. Across simulation benchmarks and real-world evaluation, SLIM matches or exceeds representative large-scale VLA and world-action-model baselines with fewer parameters, no additional embodied pretraining, lower inference latency, and substantially lower GPU memory usage.
core_contributions: 提出SLIM，一种紧凑的0.5B参数潜在交互策略
学习动作基础的预测潜在表示，同时捕捉动作条件下的未来转换和解释观测变化的动作

papers.title: SAFE-CHEM: Uncertainty-Aware Policy Switching for Robust Robotic Chemistry
papers.abstract: The deployment of autonomous robotic systems in chemistry laboratories is accelerating experimental workflows and providing the foundational data for AI-driven scientific discovery. However, despite the success of data-driven methods in acquiring dexterous skills, safety remains a primary barrier to their deployment in high-risk domains, such as early-stage materials chemistry experiments. Specifically, learning-based policies frequently struggle to distinguish between safe and unsafe actions, leading to overconfident extrapolation and potentially catastrophic failures. To mitigate these safety risks, we propose SAFE-CHEM, an uncertainty-aware framework designed for robust, learning-based robotic chemists. Our approach leverages an ensemble of recurrent neural network-based imitation learning policies to quantify epistemic uncertainty online through the variance of action predictions. By characterising the success-conditioned density of this variance using kernel density estimation, we introduce a hybrid control architecture that autonomously switches from the learned policy to a deterministic, rule-based backup controller when uncertainty exceeds a calibrated safety threshold. We evaluate SAFE-CHEM across three fundamental laboratory manipulation tasks, where our empirical results demonstrate that this hybrid strategy improves overall task success rates and reduces critical safety violations compared to traditional single-policy baselines. Finally, we demonstrate the practical viability of the framework through zero-shot sim-to-real transfer onto a physical Franka Production 3 robot manipulator.
core_contributions: 提出SAFE-CHEM不确定性感知框架，用于鲁棒的基于学习的机器人化学家。
利用RNN模仿学习策略集成，通过动作预测方差在线量化认知不确定性。
使用核密度估计表征成功条件密度，并引入混合控制架构，在不确定性超过阈值时切换到确定性备份控制器。
在三个基本实验室操作任务上验证，混合策略提高成功率并减少安全违规。
通过零样本sim-to-real迁移到物理Franka Production 3机器人，展示实际可行性。
papers.abstract_zh: 自主机器人系统在化学实验室的部署正在加速实验流程，并为AI驱动的科学发现提供基础数据。然而，尽管数据驱动方法在获取灵巧技能方面取得了成功，安全性仍然是高风险领域（如早期材料化学实验）部署的主要障碍。具体来说，基于学习的策略经常难以区分安全和不安全的动作，导致过度自信的外推和潜在的灾难性失败。为了减轻这些安全风险，我们提出了SAFE-CHEM，一个不确定性感知框架，用于鲁棒的、基于学习的机器人化学家。我们的方法利用基于循环神经网络的模仿学习策略集成，通过动作预测的方差在线量化认知不确定性。通过使用核密度估计表征该方差的成功条件密度，我们引入了一种混合控制架构，当不确定性超过校准的安全阈值时，自主地从学习策略切换到确定性的、基于规则的备份控制器。我们在三个基本的实验室操作任务中评估了SAFE-CHEM，我们的实证结果表明，与传统的单策略基线相比，这种混合策略提高了整体任务成功率并减少了关键安全违规。最后，我们通过零样本sim-to-real迁移到物理Franka Production 3机器人操作器上展示了该框架的实际可行性。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出SAFE-CHEM框架，通过不确定性感知的策略切换实现鲁棒的机器人化学操作，提高任务成功率并减少安全违规。

papers.title: C2Dex: Contact-Consistent Reconstruction and Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation from Monocular Video
papers.abstract: High-quality demonstrations for dexterous robot manipulation are costly and difficult to collect, whereas monocular human videos provide a scalable source of diverse manipulation behaviors. However, transferring such demonstrations to dexterous robots remains challenging: monocular hand-object interaction (HOI) reconstruction often produces temporally unstable contacts and physically implausible interactions, while conventional retargeting methods struggle to preserve task-relevant contacts and local interaction geometry across different hand embodiments. We present C2Dex, a video-to-dexterous-manipulation framework built around a shared interaction representation: stable object-side contacts recovered by aggregating noisy frame-wise observations in the canonical object space. These stable contacts serve a dual role: as trajectory-level constraints that guide reconstruction toward temporally coherent and physically plausible human HOI trajectories, and as explicit transfer targets for the dexterous hand, where Laplacian interaction optimization preserves the local hand-object geometry across embodiments and residual reinforcement learning refines the trajectory in simulation. Experiments on DexYCB and TACO show that C2Dex achieves end-to-end trajectory success rates of 57.78% and 26.67%, respectively, substantially outperforming the strongest baselines (17.78% and 10.00%) under identical evaluation criteria. Real-robot replay experiments further demonstrate physical feasibility across diverse contact-rich manipulation tasks. Project page: https://k-jie.github.io/C2Dex/
core_contributions: 提出在规范物体空间聚合逐帧观测恢复稳定物体侧接触的方法，作为共享交互表示。
利用稳定接触作为轨迹级约束，指导时间连贯且物理合理的人类手-物体交互重建。
提出拉普拉斯交互优化和残差强化学习，实现跨手部形态的接触保持重定向。
在DexYCB和TACO数据集上取得显著优于基线的端到端轨迹成功率，并在真实机器人上验证物理可行性。
papers.abstract_zh: 高质量的灵巧机器人操作演示成本高昂且难以收集，而单目人类视频提供了多样化操作行为的可扩展来源。然而，将这些演示转移到灵巧机器人仍然具有挑战性：单目手-物体交互（HOI）重建通常产生时间上不稳定的接触和物理上不合理的交互，而传统的重定向方法难以在不同手部形态之间保留任务相关的接触和局部交互几何。我们提出了C2Dex，一个视频到灵巧操作的框架，围绕一个共享的交互表示构建：通过在规范物体空间中聚合有噪声的逐帧观测而恢复的稳定物体侧接触。这些稳定接触具有双重作用：作为轨迹级约束，指导重建朝向时间上连贯且物理上合理的人类HOI轨迹；以及作为灵巧手的显式转移目标，其中拉普拉斯交互优化跨形态保留局部手-物体几何，残差强化学习在仿真中细化轨迹。在DexYCB和TACO上的实验表明，C2Dex分别实现了57.78%和26.67%的端到端轨迹成功率，在相同评估标准下显著优于最强基线（17.78%和10.00%）。真实机器人重放实验进一步证明了在多种接触密集型操作任务中的物理可行性。
papers.summary_one_sentence: C2Dex通过稳定接触表示实现了从单目视频到灵巧操作的接触一致重建和重定向，在DexYCB和TACO上显著提升了端到端轨迹成功率。
papers.research_problem: 从单目人类视频中获取高质量灵巧操作演示并转移到机器人，面临单目重建时间不稳定、物理不真实以及重定向难以保留任务相关接触和局部交互几何的问题。
papers.method_summary: C2Dex首先在规范物体空间聚合单目视频的逐帧观测，恢复稳定的物体侧接触点。这些接触作为轨迹级约束用于优化人类手-物体交互重建，使其时间连贯且物理合理。然后，将稳定接触作为显式转移目标，通过拉普拉斯交互优化保持局部手-物体几何，并利用残差强化学习在仿真中细化轨迹，最终部署到真实机器人。
papers.experimental_setup: 在DexYCB和TACO数据集上评估端到端轨迹成功率，与基线方法比较；并在真实机器人上进行接触密集型操作任务的重放实验。
papers.key_results: 在DexYCB上达到57.78%的端到端轨迹成功率，远超基线17.78%；在TACO上达到26.67%，远超基线10.00%。真实机器人重放实验验证了物理可行性。

papers.title: Detection and Ranging of Transient Extrinsic Contacts Based on 6D Dynamic Tactile Sensing
papers.abstract: Delicate manipulation often involves transient and subtle collisions between a grasped object and the environment. While the human hand localizes these contacts effortlessly thanks to superior tactile sensitivity, robotic systems often lack the requisite resolution to acquire the information necessary for motion planning, resulting in clumsy manipulation or even task failure. Here, we propose transient extrinsic contact detection and ranging (TECDAR), a simple yet fast and efficient method for detecting and ranging extrinsic contact of grasped objects. Our design of gripper tips employs dynamic tactile sensing leveraging a single 2.5$\times$3 mm 6D inertial measurement unit. The sensor captures sub-millisecond tip deformations at a 7 kHz sampling rate, but operating on a data stream of only 84 KB/s. High bandwidth and compact data size enable the system to rapidly detect and localize contact between grasped objects and their surroundings. Specifically, fusing tactile data with robot pose via an extended Kalman filter enables fast and precise localization of extrinsic contact, reaching millimeter-level accuracy within 180 ms. Experimental results demonstrate that the system achieves an average localization accuracy of approximately 7\,mm in both line-contact and point-contact localization tasks. Furthermore, this near-instantaneous localization enables the robot to rectify its trajectory on a millisecond scale, facilitating precise tool manipulation and enhanced perception of complex environments purely through tactile exploration and mapping. We envision such techniques advancing the future of robotics across domains requiring delicate manipulation, including precision assembly, surgical assistance, and autonomous exploration in touch-dominant environments. Project page: humitlab.github.io/TECDAR/
core_contributions: 提出TECDAR方法，用于检测和测距被抓取物体的外部接触
采用单个2.5×3mm 6D IMU实现动态触觉传感，以7kHz采样率捕获亚毫秒级变形，数据流仅84KB/s
通过扩展卡尔曼滤波融合触觉数据与机器人位姿，实现快速精确定位
在线接触和点接触定位任务中达到约7mm的平均定位精度，定位时间180ms内
实现毫秒级轨迹修正，促进精确工具操作和触觉探索与映射
papers.abstract_zh: 精细操作通常涉及被抓取物体与环境之间的瞬态和微妙碰撞。人类手部凭借卓越的触觉灵敏度能够轻松定位这些接触，而机器人系统往往缺乏必要的分辨率来获取运动规划所需的信息，导致操作笨拙甚至任务失败。本文提出瞬态外部接触检测与测距（TECDAR），一种简单、快速且高效的方法，用于检测和测距被抓取物体的外部接触。我们的夹爪尖端设计采用动态触觉传感，利用单个2.5×3毫米的6D惯性测量单元。该传感器以7 kHz采样率捕获亚毫秒级的尖端变形，但数据流仅84 KB/s。高带宽和紧凑的数据尺寸使系统能够快速检测和定位被抓取物体与其周围环境之间的接触。具体来说，通过扩展卡尔曼滤波器融合触觉数据与机器人位姿，实现了外部接触的快速精确定位，在180毫秒内达到毫米级精度。实验结果表明，该系统在线接触和点接触定位任务中均达到约7毫米的平均定位精度。此外，这种近乎瞬时的定位使机器人能够在毫秒级尺度上修正其轨迹，促进精确工具操作和仅通过触觉探索与映射增强对复杂环境的感知。我们预计这类技术将推动未来机器人技术在需要精细操作的领域取得进展，包括精密装配、手术辅助和触觉主导环境中的自主探索。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出一种基于6D动态触觉传感的瞬态外部接触检测与测距方法（TECDAR），通过单个IMU和扩展卡尔曼滤波实现毫米级精度和毫秒级响应的接触定位。

The top panel illustrates four experimental scenarios with pre- and post-movement states: (a) a plastic prism for controlled baseline validation, a book simulating real-world line contact, and a paper cutter demonstrating constrained trajectory planning; and (b) a rotating pen representing a typical point-contact case. papers.title: VIDP: Variable Impedance Diffusion Policy for Compliant Robot Manipulation from Diverse Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires precise tracking and mechanical compliance, where variable impedance control can improve robustness in task success, whereas static compliance cannot adapt to varying contact constraints. Variable impedance skills can be learned from demonstrations, avoiding complex modeling, but compliance is a hidden variable in force-agnostic kinematic data. While existing methods infer compliance from trajectory variations, these variations may reflect geometric adaptation and not intentional compliance when subject to changing spatial layouts. Therefore, this letter introduces Variable Impedance Diffusion Policy (VIDP), an imitation learning-based variable impedance control framework leveraging a Task-Parameterized Directionality-Aware Mixture Model (TP-DAMM) to extract physically consistent trajectory distributions from diverse demonstrations. By mapping distributions to stiffness profiles, VIDP jointly predicts pose actions and task compliance without force sensors. Real-world experiments show that VIDP significantly outperforms fixed-impedance baselines in task success rate while reducing interaction forces with respect to high stiffness controllers and tracking errors with respect to low stiffness baselines.
core_contributions: 提出VIDP框架，一种基于模仿学习的可变阻抗控制方法
提出任务参数化的方向感知混合模型（TP-DAMM）提取物理一致的轨迹分布
通过将轨迹分布映射到刚度轮廓，实现无需力传感器的位姿动作和任务柔顺性联合预测
真实世界实验验证了VIDP在任务成功率和交互力/跟踪误差方面优于固定阻抗基线
papers.abstract_zh: 接触丰富的操作需要精确的跟踪和机械柔顺性，其中可变阻抗控制可以提高任务成功的鲁棒性，而静态阻抗无法适应变化的接触约束。可变阻抗技能可以从演示中学习，避免复杂建模，但柔顺性在无力的运动学数据中是一个隐藏变量。现有方法从轨迹变化中推断柔顺性，但这些变化可能反映几何适应，而不是在空间布局变化时的有意柔顺。因此，本文介绍了可变阻抗扩散策略（VIDP），一种基于模仿学习的可变阻抗控制框架，利用任务参数化的方向感知混合模型（TP-DAMM）从多样演示中提取物理一致的轨迹分布。通过将分布映射到刚度轮廓，VIDP无需力传感器即可联合预测位姿动作和任务柔顺性。真实世界实验表明，VIDP在任务成功率上显著优于固定阻抗基线，同时相对于高刚度控制器减少了交互力，相对于低刚度基线减少了跟踪误差。

papers.title: Near-sensor Computing for Rapid Visuotactile Perception
papers.abstract: Visuotactile sensors reconstruct dense contact geometry from measured surface gradients, but host-based processing increases power consumption and introduces data-transfer delays and variable scheduling latency, limiting the sensing and response speed of robotic systems. To address these limitations, we implement a near-sensor computing framework that includes a spectral Poisson solver as a fully streaming hardware pipeline. The computational core logic has an estimated power consumption of 347 mW and achieves high throughput without data-dependent branching or iterative convergence, thereby providing deterministic latency. Operating at 166 MHz, the pipeline produces the first depth value of each 128x128 frame 35,107 cycles after receiving the first input pixel, corresponding to a fixed latency of 0.211 ms. Across 15 contact geometries, the reconstructed depths differ from a double-precision reference by 0.17 % of the peak contact depth. On-chip decisions based on these reconstructions close a robot protective reflex loop in 28.3 +/- 4.9 ms, compared with 169.9 +/- 27.8 ms for an equivalent host-based loop using the same actuator. These results demonstrate that near-sensor reconstruction can provide accurate, energy-efficient, and deterministic tactile geometry on timescales suitable for rapid robotic contact responses.
core_contributions: 提出近传感器计算框架，将触觉深度重建从主机卸载到传感器附近硬件。
设计全流式硬件流水线实现谱泊松求解器，无需数据依赖分支或迭代收敛，提供确定性延迟。
在128×128分辨率下实现0.211 ms固定延迟和347 mW低功耗，重建误差仅为峰值深度的0.17%。
在机器人保护性反射回路中验证，近传感器处理将响应时间从169.9 ms加速至28.3 ms。
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉触觉传感器从测量的表面梯度重建密集接触几何，但基于主机的处理增加了功耗并引入了数据传输延迟和可变调度延迟，限制了机器人系统的感知和响应速度。为了解决这些限制，我们实现了一个近传感器计算框架，其中包括一个作为全流式硬件流水线的谱泊松求解器。计算核心逻辑估计功耗为347 mW，并且在没有数据相关分支或迭代收敛的情况下实现高吞吐量，从而提供确定性延迟。在166 MHz下运行，该流水线在接收到第一个输入像素后35,107个周期产生每个128x128帧的第一个深度值，对应固定延迟0.211 ms。在15个接触几何形状上，重建深度与双精度参考值的差异为峰值接触深度的0.17%。基于这些重建的片上决策在28.3±4.9 ms内关闭机器人保护性反射回路，而使用相同执行器的等效基于主机的回路需要169.9±27.8 ms。这些结果表明，近传感器重建可以在适合快速机器人接触响应的时间尺度上提供准确、节能和确定性的触觉几何。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 本文提出一种近传感器计算框架，通过全流式硬件流水线实现快速、低功耗、确定性的视觉触觉深度重建，将机器人保护性反射回路延迟从169.9 ms降至28.3 ms。
papers.research_problem: 基于主机的视觉触觉处理存在功耗高、数据传输延迟和可变调度延迟，限制了机器人系统的感知和响应速度，亟需一种快速、低功耗、确定性的触觉几何重建方法以支持实时接触响应。
papers.method_summary: 采用近传感器计算框架，核心是一个作为全流式硬件流水线实现的谱泊松求解器，在FPGA等硬件上以166 MHz运行，流式处理像素输入，避免数据依赖分支和迭代收敛，从而提供确定性延迟和低功耗。

papers.key_results: 计算核心功耗347 mW；每帧（128×128）固定延迟0.211 ms；重建深度误差为峰值深度的0.17%；近传感器反射回路延迟28.3±4.9 ms，主机回路延迟169.9±27.8 ms。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作实现了传感器附近快速、低功耗、确定性的触觉深度重建，使机器人能够以毫秒级响应接触事件，对实时触觉反馈、安全交互和具身智能中的快速反射控制具有重要意义。

papers.title: In-Context VLA: Endowing Vision-Language-Action Models with Language via In-Context Post-Training and Agentic Tool Use
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become the dominant recipe for generalist manipulation, yet they are almost universally trained by behavior cloning: a policy imitates expert action chunks conditioned on a static image and a fixed instruction. A natural remedy is to inject explicit reasoning through textual chain-of-thought (CoT). We show, both empirically and analytically, that free-form textual CoT degrades low-level control: the reasoning it produces is ungrounded, its latency breaks closed-loop timing, and, crucially, the reasoning and action tokens are optimized against conflicting objectives so that the policy learns to narrate rather than to act. We argue that what a VLA needs is not the ability to generate language, but the ability to consume grounded language. To this end we introduce \textbf{\ourmethod{}}, a framework that endows a VLA with language competence through (i) in-context post-training, in which perceptual evidence is injected as structured context and the model is supervised only on actions, and (ii) an agentic tool-use interface, in which the policy queries open-vocabulary detectors, monocular depth, and a vision--language model to actively acquire task-relevant information. Rather than emitting a single templated caption, our data engine produces diverse, paraphrased, and evidence-conditioned spatial descriptions, so that the policy learns to interpret language it has never seen verbatim. Across the RoboCasa-GR1, SimplerEnv, and LIBERO simulation benchmarks, together with 8 real-world robot manipulation tasks, our method consistently achieves SOTA results in both performance and efficiency when compared with CoT-based approaches under matched configurations.
core_contributions: 证明自由形式文本CoT会降低低级控制，并分析其原因
提出In-Context VLA框架，包括上下文后训练和代理工具使用接口
提出数据引擎产生多样化、释义和证据条件的空间描述，增强策略对未见语言的解释能力
在多个模拟基准和真实世界任务中达到SOTA性能
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为通用操作的主导方法，但它们几乎普遍通过行为克隆训练：策略模仿基于静态图像和固定指令的专家动作块。一个自然的补救措施是通过文本链式思维（CoT）注入显式推理。我们通过实验和分析表明，自由形式的文本CoT会降低低级控制：它产生的推理是无根据的，其延迟破坏了闭环时序，而且关键的是，推理和动作标记针对冲突的目标进行优化，使得策略学会叙述而不是行动。我们认为VLA需要的不是生成语言的能力，而是消费接地语言的能力。为此，我们引入了In-Context VLA框架，通过（i）上下文后训练，其中感知证据作为结构化上下文注入，模型仅在动作上受到监督，以及（ii）代理工具使用接口，其中策略查询开放词汇检测器、单目深度和视觉语言模型以主动获取任务相关信息。我们的数据引擎不是发出单个模板化标题，而是产生多样化、释义和证据条件的空间描述，使得策略学会解释它从未逐字见过的语言。在RoboCasa-GR1、SimplerEnv和LIBERO模拟基准测试以及8个真实世界机器人操作任务中，我们的方法在匹配配置下与基于CoT的方法相比，在性能和效率上一致地达到SOTA结果。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 本文提出In-Context VLA框架，通过上下文后训练和代理工具使用接口赋予VLA模型消费接地语言的能力，避免自由形式CoT的缺陷，在模拟和真实操作任务中达到SOTA。
papers.research_problem: 如何有效地将语言能力融入VLA模型而不损害低级控制性能，因为自由形式文本CoT会导致推理无根据、延迟破坏闭环、优化目标冲突。
papers.method_summary: In-Context VLA框架包含两部分：(i) 上下文后训练，将感知证据作为结构化上下文注入，模型仅在动作上受监督；(ii) 代理工具使用接口，策略可查询开放词汇检测器、单目深度和视觉语言模型以主动获取任务相关信息。此外，数据引擎生成多样化、释义和证据条件的空间描述，使策略学会解释未见过的语言。
papers.experimental_setup: 模拟基准：RoboCasa-GR1、SimplerEnv、LIBERO；真实世界：8个机器人操作任务。与基于CoT的方法在匹配配置下比较。
papers.key_results: 在模拟和真实任务中，方法在性能和效率上一致地达到SOTA，相比基于CoT的方法。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作针对VLA模型语言集成中的关键问题，提出了一种新的范式，即消费语言而非生成语言，避免了CoT的缺陷，提升了操作任务的性能和效率，对具身智能和机器人操作领域有重要意义。

papers.title: SkillMemo: Expert-guided Skill Memory Framework for Compositional Embodied Manipulation
papers.abstract: Embodied visuomotor models, including Diffusion Policy (DP) and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, have demonstrated promising performance on robotic manipulation benchmarks. However, their potential remains fundamentally constrained by the scarcity of large-scale embodied trajectory datasets, leading to insufficient compositional generalization in out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios with limited capability to capture reusable skill structures. To address this limitation, we propose Skill-Based Memory (SkillMemo) framework that implicitly decomposes long-horizon demonstrations into latent atomic skills and integrates skill-level features into a dynamic episodic memory bank for solving compositional tasks. Specifically, we first introduce an expert-guided trajectory segmentation module built upon a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, which implicitly partitions trajectories into distinct skill primitives represented by learned gating coefficients. We further design a skill-level episodic memory architecture that stores compact skill representations as retrievable key-value pairs. During inference, the memory bank retrieves the most relevant skill primitives which are subsequently fused with the model's current gating distribution, providing a robust contextual prior to refine action predictions. Extensive experiments on the simulation benchmark and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that SkillMemo consistently enhances both DP and VLA backbones, achieving state-of-the-art performance and outperforming $π_{0.5}$, while exhibiting strong compositional generalization to unseen task configurations.
core_contributions: 提出SkillMemo框架，隐式地将长视界演示分解为潜在原子技能，并集成技能级特征到动态情景记忆库中。
设计基于混合专家（MoE）架构的专家引导轨迹分割模块，将轨迹划分为由门控系数表示的技能原语。
构建技能级情景记忆架构，存储紧凑技能表示为可检索键值对，推理时检索相关技能与当前门控分布融合以细化动作预测。
在仿真基准和真实世界操作任务上实现最先进性能，优于π0.5，并展示强大的组合泛化能力。
papers.abstract_zh: 具身视觉运动模型，包括扩散策略（DP）和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，在机器人操作基准上展示了有前景的性能。然而，它们的潜力仍然受到大规模具身轨迹数据集稀缺的根本限制，导致在分布外（OOD）场景中组合泛化不足，且捕获可重用技能结构的能力有限。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了基于技能的记忆（SkillMemo）框架，该框架隐式地将长视界演示分解为潜在原子技能，并将技能级特征集成到动态情景记忆库中，以解决组合任务。具体来说，我们首先引入了一个基于混合专家（MoE）架构的专家引导轨迹分割模块，该模块隐式地将轨迹划分为由学习到的门控系数表示的独特技能原语。我们进一步设计了一个技能级情景记忆架构，将紧凑的技能表示存储为可检索的键值对。在推理过程中，记忆库检索最相关的技能原语，随后与模型当前的门控分布融合，提供稳健的上下文先验以细化动作预测。在仿真基准和真实世界操作任务上的大量实验表明，SkillMemo持续增强了DP和VLA骨干网络，实现了最先进的性能，优于π_{0.5}，并对未见过的任务配置表现出强大的组合泛化能力。
papers.summary_one_sentence: SkillMemo通过专家引导的轨迹分割和技能级情景记忆库，隐式分解长视界演示为原子技能，提升了具身操作模型的组合泛化能力。
papers.research_problem: 大规模具身轨迹数据集稀缺导致具身视觉运动模型在分布外场景中组合泛化不足，且无法有效捕获可重用的技能结构。
papers.method_summary: SkillMemo框架包含两个核心模块：1) 专家引导的轨迹分割模块，基于MoE架构隐式地将长视界演示分割为多个技能原语，每个原语由学习到的门控系数表示；2) 技能级情景记忆库，将技能表示存储为键值对。推理时，记忆库检索与当前任务最相关的技能原语，并与模型当前的门控分布融合，提供上下文先验以细化动作预测。
papers.experimental_setup: 在仿真基准和真实世界操作任务上进行实验，以扩散策略（DP）和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型作为骨干网络。具体数据集和任务细节未在摘要中说明。
papers.key_results: SkillMemo持续增强了DP和VLA骨干网络的性能，实现了最先进的结果，优于π0.5模型，并对未见过的任务配置表现出强大的组合泛化能力。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作针对具身操作中数据稀缺导致的组合泛化问题，提出了一种通过隐式技能分解和情景记忆来提升模型泛化能力的方法，在多个骨干网络上取得显著提升，为利用有限数据实现复杂操作任务提供了新思路。

papers.title: EvoHIL: Self-Evolving Reward and Flow-Matched Policy Optimization for Robust Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning (HIL-RL) enables robots to learn contact-rich manipulation from limited real-world interaction, but deployment exposes three coupled limitations: static visual reward models fail under scene changes; independently sampled actions cause temporally inconsistent motion; and vision-based policies remain sensitive to appearance shifts. We present EvoHIL, a unified framework that adapts the reward model, action generator, and visual do main within a staged human-in-the-loop learning process. First, self-evolving reward (SER) adapts the success classifier from human-confirmed positives and provisional weak negatives. Second, Action Flow Stabilization (AFS) generates temporally coherent action chunks through flow matching, grounding policy updates in executed action prefixes and demonstrated behavior. Third, retention-aware offline fine-tuning replays relit interaction data while anchoring the AFS actor-critic to prior behavior, adapting the visual domain without additional robot interaction. Across six manipulation tasks on Franka FR3 and SO-101 arms under a controlled lighting shift, EvoHIL improves task success, agreement with human-confirmation labels, motion smoothness, and completion time relative to human-in-the-loop and imitation baselines.Project page: https://anonymous4366.github.io/EvoHIL/
core_contributions: 提出了EvoHIL统一框架，同时适应奖励模型、动作生成器和视觉域
自进化奖励（SER）利用人类确认的正样本和弱负样本动态更新成功分类器
动作流稳定（AFS）通过流匹配生成时间连贯的动作块，基于执行前缀和演示行为更新策略
保留感知的离线微调通过重放重新光照数据并锚定演员-评论家来适应视觉域，无需额外机器人交互
在六个操作任务上验证了EvoHIL在成功率、标签一致性、运动平滑度和完成时间上的提升
papers.abstract_zh: 人在回路强化学习（HIL-RL）使机器人能够从有限的真实世界交互中学习接触丰富的操作，但部署暴露了三个耦合的限制：静态视觉奖励模型在场景变化下失败；独立采样的动作导致时间上不一致的运动；基于视觉的策略仍然对外观变化敏感。我们提出了EvoHIL，一个统一的框架，在分阶段的人机交互学习过程中适应奖励模型、动作生成器和视觉域。首先，自进化奖励（SER）从人类确认的正样本和临时的弱负样本中适应成功分类器。其次，动作流稳定（AFS）通过流匹配生成时间上连贯的动作块，将策略更新基于执行的动作前缀和演示行为。第三，保留感知的离线微调重放重新光照的交互数据，同时将AFS演员-评论家锚定到先前行为，无需额外的机器人交互即可适应视觉域。在Franka FR3和SO-101机械臂上的六个操作任务中，在受控光照变化下，EvoHIL相对于人在回路和模仿基线提高了任务成功率、与人类确认标签的一致性、运动平滑度和完成时间。
papers.summary_one_sentence: EvoHIL提出了一种自进化奖励和流匹配策略优化的统一框架，用于鲁棒的人机交互强化学习，同时解决了视觉奖励模型静态、动作时间不一致和视觉域敏感三个耦合问题。
papers.research_problem: 人在回路强化学习在接触丰富操作中面临三个耦合限制：静态视觉奖励模型在场景变化下失效、独立采样动作导致时间不一致运动、基于视觉的策略对外观变化敏感。
papers.method_summary: EvoHIL包含三个组件：1) 自进化奖励（SER）从人类确认的正样本和临时弱负样本中适应成功分类器；2) 动作流稳定（AFS）通过流匹配生成时间连贯的动作块，将策略更新基于执行的动作前缀和演示行为；3) 保留感知的离线微调重放重新光照的交互数据，同时将AFS演员-评论家锚定到先前行为，从而适应视觉域。
papers.experimental_setup: 在Franka FR3和SO-101机械臂上执行六个操作任务，在受控光照变化下进行评估，并与人在回路和模仿学习基线进行比较。
papers.key_results: EvoHIL在任务成功率、与人类确认标签的一致性、运动平滑度和完成时间上均优于人在回路和模仿基线。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作提供了一种统一框架同时适应奖励模型、动作生成和视觉域，有效解决了人在回路强化学习在接触丰富操作中的三个耦合限制，提升了鲁棒性和效率，对机器人操作和具身智能研究具有重要参考价值。

papers.image_caption: Fig. 2: Staged overview of EvoHIL. During online interaction, SER updates the deployed success classifier from human confirmations, and AFS learns action chunks from source-tagged persistent replay. Retention-aware offline fine-tuning subsequently combines source and externally relit replay with frozen references for execution-prefix values and flow velocities. The three components share an actor–critic workflow but use distinct data paths and training stages.
papers.image_caption_zh: EvoHIL的分阶段概述。在线交互期间，SER根据人类确认更新部署的成功分类器，AFS从源标记的持久回放中学习动作块。随后，保留感知的离线微调将源回放和外部重放与执行前缀值和流速的冻结参考相结合。这三个组件共享一个演员-评论家工作流，但使用不同的数据路径和训练阶段。

papers.title: Continue or Replan? Bernoulli-Continuation Policy Learning for Adaptive Horizon Execution
papers.abstract: Existing chunk-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models execute a fixed number of actions (i.e., execution horizon) before replanning, turning replanning into a task-agnostic periodic schedule that is independent of task progress. As a result, when no replanning boundary falls before a critical manipulation stage, it is executed from a stale chunk rather than a freshly replanned one. To address this limitation, we propose Bernoulli-Continuation Policy (BCP), a lightweight, plug-and-play framework for adaptive horizon execution that keeps the base VLA frozen. Given a fixed-length action chunk, its continuation head decomposes execution-horizon selection into a sequence of continue-or-replan decisions, which imposes an ordinal, prefix-sharing inductive bias over candidate horizons rather than treating them as independent classes. Since the optimal horizon for each chunk is not observable, we train this head with reinforcement learning from trajectory-level outcomes and introduce a Replanning-Efficiency Reward that jointly rewards task success and efficient VLA usage, discouraging the policy from collapsing to unnecessarily short horizons. On RoboTwin 2.0 with LingBot-VLA as the base policy, BCP improves the average success rate by +11.08% on 13 low-success tasks and from 89.88% to 93.94% (+4.06%) across all 50 tasks. Although trained only under the Clean setting, BCP generalizes to the Randomized setting, raising the average success rate by +4.06%. It also transfers to a different base policy $π_{0.5}$, achieving a better result on LIBERO (+1.7%) and, notably, on the harder LIBERO-PRO (+6.8%). On a real robot, BCP lifts success from 74% to 92% and from 44% to 84% on two manipulation tasks. Meanwhile, its negligible overhead, combined with higher success, makes BCP's overall runtime even lower than the fixed-horizon baselines.
core_contributions: 提出BCP框架，将执行视界选择分解为一系列继续或重新规划的序列决策，施加顺序前缀共享归纳偏置。
使用强化学习从轨迹级结果训练continuation head，并引入Replanning-Efficiency Reward联合优化任务成功和VLA使用效率。
在多个仿真基准（RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO）和真实机器人上取得显著成功率提升，且开销可忽略。
BCP是即插即用框架，无需修改基础VLA模型，并展现出良好的泛化性和迁移性。
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的基于分块的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在执行固定数量的动作（即执行视界）后重新规划，将重新规划变成一种与任务进度无关的周期性调度。因此，当关键操作阶段之前没有重新规划边界时，它从过时的分块执行，而不是从新重新规划的分块执行。为了解决这个限制，我们提出了伯努利-继续策略（BCP），一个轻量级、即插即用的自适应视界执行框架，保持基础VLA冻结。给定一个固定长度的动作分块，其继续头将执行视界选择分解为一系列继续或重新规划的决策，这施加了顺序的、前缀共享的归纳偏置，而不是将候选视界视为独立类别。由于每个分块的最优视界不可观察，我们使用轨迹级结果的强化学习训练这个头，并引入重新规划效率奖励，共同奖励任务成功和高效的VLA使用，阻止策略崩溃到不必要的短视界。在RoboTwin 2.0上使用LingBot-VLA作为基础策略，BCP在13个低成功率任务上平均成功率提高+11.08%，在所有50个任务上从89.88%提高到93.94%（+4.06%）。尽管只在Clean设置下训练，BCP泛化到Randomized设置，平均成功率提高+4.06%。它还迁移到不同的基础策略π0.5，在LIBERO上取得更好结果（+1.7%），在更难的LIBERO-PRO上取得+6.8%。在真实机器人上，BCP在两个操作任务上将成功率从74%提高到92%，从44%提高到84%。同时，其可忽略的开销加上更高的成功率，使得BCP的整体运行时间甚至低于固定视界基线。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出伯努利-继续策略（BCP），一种轻量级即插即用框架，通过强化学习学习自适应执行视界，显著提升VLA模型的任务成功率和效率。
papers.research_problem: 现有基于分块的VLA模型使用固定执行视界，重新规划与任务进度无关，导致关键操作阶段可能从过时的分块执行，缺乏自适应执行视界的能力。
papers.method_summary: BCP在固定长度的动作分块上附加一个continuation head，将执行视界选择建模为一系列伯努利决策（继续或重新规划），通过强化学习训练该头，使用轨迹级奖励（任务成功与VLA调用效率的加权）来学习最优的继续/重新规划时机，从而自适应地决定每个分块的实际执行长度。
papers.experimental_setup: 在RoboTwin 2.0上以LingBot-VLA为基础策略，评估13个低成功率任务和全部50个任务；迁移到π0.5基础策略在LIBERO和LIBERO-PRO上测试；在真实机器人上执行两个操作任务。训练仅在Clean设置下进行，测试泛化到Randomized设置。
papers.key_results: 在RoboTwin 2.0上，低成功率任务平均成功率提高+11.08%，全部50个任务从89.88%提高到93.94%（+4.06%）；泛化到Randomized设置平均提高+4.06%；迁移到π0.5，LIBERO +1.7%，LIBERO-PRO +6.8%；真实机器人上成功率从74%→92%和44%→84%；整体运行时间低于固定视界基线。
papers.why_it_matters: 该方法解决了固定执行视界的根本限制，通过轻量级即插即用框架显著提升VLA模型性能，且开销可忽略，为机器人操作中的自适应决策提供了实用且高效的解决方案。

papers.image_caption: Figure 2: Overview of Bernoulli-Continuation Policy learning . Given a fixed-length action chunk predicted by a frozen VLA, BCP estimates continue probabilities to select an adaptive execution horizon, executes the corresponding action prefix, and is optimized with GRPO using the Replanning-Efficiency Reward.
papers.image_caption_zh: 伯努利延续策略学习概述。给定一个由冻结的VLA预测的固定长度动作块，BCP估计继续概率以选择自适应执行范围，执行相应的动作前缀，并使用重新规划效率奖励通过GRPO进行优化。

papers.title: A Hierarchical Approach to Imitation Learning for Manipulation Tasks Requiring Time Varying Forces
papers.abstract: Diffusion policies have shown strong performance in learning complex, multi-modal behaviors for robotic manipulation. However, their application to contact-rich disassembly tasks remains limited by a key trade-off: the iterative denoising process introduces inference latencies that makes high frequency control difficult, which is essential for realizing dynamic interactions such as chiseling and prying. Recent action-chunking techniques mitigate latency but use an open-loop execution window, rendering the system blind to rapid force transients caused by fracture events. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Diffusion Policy Augmented by Fast Trajectory Generation (DPA-FTG). Compared to recent visual-tactile approaches that focus on positional correction, DPA-FTG decouples low-frequency planning from high-frequency force regulation. At the high level ($5$ Hz), a conditional diffusion model predicts a sequence of latent parameters for selecting a strategy from a learned vocabulary of task primitives. At the low level ($60$ Hz), a lightweight, force-conditioned policy acts as a neural impedance controller, modulating execution in real-time to maintain contact stability. We validate our approach on a bimanual battery disassembly task involving the separation of a compliant sheet. Experimental evaluation demonstrates that DPA-FTG outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, including Reactive Diffusion Policy (RDP).
core_contributions: 提出DPA-FTG分层框架，解耦低频规划和高频力调节
高层使用条件扩散模型预测潜在参数以选择任务原语策略
低层使用轻量级力条件策略作为神经阻抗控制器实时调节力
在双臂电池拆卸任务上验证有效性，优于包括RDP在内的基线
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散策略在机器人操作中学习复杂多模态行为方面表现出色。然而，它们在接触密集的拆卸任务中的应用仍然受到一个关键权衡的限制：迭代去噪过程引入了推理延迟，使得高频控制变得困难，而这对于实现诸如凿削和撬动等动态交互至关重要。最近的动作分块技术减轻了延迟，但使用开环执行窗口，使得系统对断裂事件引起的快速力瞬变视而不见。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了扩散策略增强快速轨迹生成（DPA-FTG）。与最近关注位置校正的视觉-触觉方法相比，DPA-FTG将低频规划与高频力调节解耦。在高层次（5 Hz），条件扩散模型预测一系列潜在参数，用于从学习的任务原语词汇中选择策略。在低层次（60 Hz），轻量级的力条件策略充当神经阻抗控制器，实时调节执行以保持接触稳定性。我们在一个涉及分离柔性片的双臂电池拆卸任务上验证了我们的方法。实验评估表明，DPA-FTG优于最先进的基线，包括反应式扩散策略（RDP）。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出一种分层模仿学习方法DPA-FTG，通过解耦低频规划（5 Hz）和高频力调节（60 Hz），实现了接触密集拆卸任务中的实时力控制。
papers.research_problem: 扩散策略在接触密集拆卸任务中因推理延迟难以实现高频控制，而动作分块技术虽减轻延迟但使用开环执行，无法应对快速力瞬变。
papers.method_summary: DPA-FTG包含两层：高层（5 Hz）条件扩散模型预测潜在参数，从学习的任务原语词汇中选择策略；低层（60 Hz）力条件策略作为神经阻抗控制器，实时调节执行以保持接触稳定性。
papers.experimental_setup: 在双臂电池拆卸任务上验证，涉及分离柔性片，与包括Reactive Diffusion Policy (RDP)在内的基线比较。
papers.key_results: DPA-FTG优于最先进的基线，包括Reactive Diffusion Policy (RDP)。具体性能指标未在摘要中提供。
papers.why_it_matters: 该方法解决了扩散策略在接触密集任务中高频控制与开环执行的矛盾，实现了实时力调节，对于需要动态交互的机器人拆卸等应用具有重要意义。

papers.image_caption: Figure 2: System Architecture of DPA-FTG. The framework decouples high-level task planning from low-level reactive control. (A) Slow Loop (5 Hz): The Task Selection Policy ( π t ​ a ​ s ​ k \pi_{task} ) takes a history of multi-modal observations (Vision, Force, Proprioception) to predict a continuous latent embedding z ~ \tilde{z} . This embedding is quantized to the nearest codebook vector z k z_{k} and published to an atomic buffer. (B) Fast Loop (60 Hz): The Motion Generation Policy ( π m ​ o ​ t ​ i ​ o ​ n \pi_{motion} ), running on a separate thread, reads the latest skill z k z_{k} . It combines this semantic intent with instantaneous force and proprioceptive feedback to generate high-frequency velocity commands ( 𝐚 t \mathbf{a}_{t} ). The fast loop operates independently of the planner’s latency, ensuring continuous 60 Hz reactivity.
papers.image_caption_zh: DPA-FTG 系统架构。该框架将高层任务规划与底层反应式控制解耦。(A) 慢循环 (5 Hz)：任务选择策略 (π_task) 接收多模态观测历史（视觉、力觉、本体感觉），预测连续潜在嵌入 z̃。该嵌入被量化到最近的码本向量 z_k，并发布到原子缓冲区。(B) 快循环 (60 Hz)：运动生成策略 (π_motion) 在独立线程上运行，读取最新技能 z_k。它将此语义意图与即时力觉和本体感觉反馈相结合，生成高频速度指令 (a_t)。快循环独立于慢循环运行。

papers.title: Bimanual Manipulation Within an 8 GB Budget: Zero-Copy Sensing and Quantized ACT on an Entry-Level Jetson
papers.abstract: Bimanual manipulation policies trained with imitation learning are typically evaluated on workstation or datacenter-class GPUs, leaving the cost of deploying them on embedded hardware largely uncharacterized. We present a bimanual SO-101 system running entirely on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super (8 GB), the entry-level tier of NVIDIA's embedded line, using a desktop GPU (RTX 3070) only for offline training, evaluated on pick-and-place of a deformable beanbag. First, we build a GStreamer capture pipeline backed by NVMM buffers that removes redundant host-device copies from three-camera sensing. Contrary to expectation, the conventional path fit the memory budget and dropped no frames; what zero-copy sensing recovers is CPU headroom (peak single-core utilization 98.0% to 77.0%) and worst-case latency (117.31 ms to 101.52 ms). Second, we train ACT and Diffusion Policy on identical demonstrations, each at its own reference budget (100k gradient steps for ACT, 200k for Diffusion Policy). ACT converges to a task-competent policy (19/20 trials) while Diffusion Policy does not converge to a usable one (0/10) even at twice the step count, which we attribute to differing convergence costs rather than an accuracy ceiling. Third, we convert ACT to TensorRT. FP16 reduces mean inference latency from 114.02 ms to 17.93 ms (6.4x) and INT8 to 12.65 ms (9.0x), with task success preserved at all three precisions (19/20, 18/20, 19/20). We report two findings not previously documented for ACT: TensorRT's general-purpose INT8 calibration quantizes the ResNet18 backbone but accepts zero of 145 transformer layers, explaining INT8's negligible size reduction over FP16 (0.9%) despite a further 28% latency gain; and the need for quantization is conditional on ACT's action-chunking configuration, feasible in full precision at n_action_steps = 100 but not at the per-step re-prediction temporal ensembling requires.
core_contributions: 在8 GB Jetson Orin Nano Super上构建了完整的双臂操作SO-101系统。
提出了基于NVMM缓冲区的GStreamer零拷贝传感管道，降低了CPU利用率和延迟。
实验表明ACT在嵌入式预算下收敛（19/20成功率），而扩散策略未收敛（0/10）。
通过TensorRT量化ACT，FP16实现6.4倍加速，INT8实现9.0倍加速，且任务成功率保持不变。
首次报告了ACT在TensorRT INT8量化中Transformer层未被量化，以及量化需求取决于动作块配置。
papers.abstract_zh: 通过模仿学习训练的双臂操作策略通常在工作站或数据中心级GPU上评估，而将其部署在嵌入式硬件上的成本在很大程度上未被表征。我们提出了一个完全在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super（8 GB）上运行的双臂SO-101系统，这是NVIDIA嵌入式系列的入门级，仅使用桌面GPU（RTX 3070）进行离线训练，并在可变形豆袋的拾取和放置任务上进行了评估。首先，我们构建了一个由NVMM缓冲区支持的GStreamer捕获管道，该管道消除了三摄像头传感中冗余的主机-设备拷贝。与预期相反，传统路径适合内存预算且没有丢帧；零拷贝传感恢复的是CPU余量（峰值单核利用率从98.0%降至77.0%）和最坏情况延迟（从117.31毫秒降至101.52毫秒）。其次，我们在相同的演示上训练ACT和扩散策略，每个策略使用其自己的参考预算（ACT为100k梯度步，扩散策略为200k梯度步）。ACT收敛到一个任务胜任的策略（20次试验中19次成功），而扩散策略即使步数加倍也未收敛到可用策略（10次试验中0次），我们将其归因于不同的收敛成本而非准确率上限。第三，我们将ACT转换为TensorRT。FP16将平均推理延迟从114.02毫秒降至17.93毫秒（6.4倍），INT8降至12.65毫秒（9.0倍），且所有三种精度下的任务成功率保持不变（19/20、18/20、19/20）。我们报告了ACT的两个先前未记录的结果：TensorRT的通用INT8校准量化了ResNet18骨干网络，但接受了145个Transformer层中的零个，这解释了INT8相对于FP16的尺寸减小微不足道（0.9%），尽管延迟进一步降低了28%；以及量化的需求取决于ACT的动作块配置，在n_action_steps=100时全精度可行，但在每步重新预测的时间集成所需时不可行。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 本文在8 GB Jetson Orin Nano Super上实现了双臂操作，通过零拷贝传感和TensorRT量化ACT，在有限资源下达到高效部署，并揭示了量化中的关键发现。

papers.title: Look Where It Matters: Adaptive Visual Refinement for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Visual representations of VLA models remain unreliable for spatially precise robotic manipulation. We uncover that vision encoders in VLAs also exhibit attention artifacts previously documented in generic Vision Transformers, and further show that, in embodied policies, these artifacts are closely associated with spatial perception capabilities acquired during post-training. As the encoder learns task-relevant information such as object location, depth ordering, and local geometry, limited global-token capacity causes part of this information to spill into low-information patch tokens. We introduce AtVLA, a framework that inserts learnable register tokens into the visual encoder. Trained end-to-end using only embodied data and the original action objective, these registers emerge as dedicated carriers of embodied spatial information, while the remaining patch tokens recover clean and spatially faithful attention distributions crucial for precise target localization and fine-grained contact. Clean attention restores reliable localization, but cannot recover geometric details lost in low-resolution observations. AtVLA therefore couples attention rectification with uncertainty-gated local refinement. The action expert samples multiple action chunks and estimates uncertainty from their disagreement; only for uncertain predictions, action-conditioned attention rollout identifies the task-relevant region, which is cropped, re-encoded at high resolution, and appended to the cached prefix for refined action generation. Across LIBERO, SimplerEnv, and a challenging single-view real-world benchmark, AtVLA improves the average LIBERO success rate from 94.2% to 98.4% and real-world success from 46.5% to 69.0%. The cropping is triggered on approximately 30% of replanning steps, resulting in only 1.4-1.6x the total computation of the base model under the representative deployment setting.
core_contributions: 发现VLA视觉编码器中的注意力伪影与后训练获得的空间感知能力密切相关。
提出AtVLA框架，在视觉编码器中插入可学习注册令牌，作为具身空间信息的专用载体。
结合注意力校正与不确定性门控局部细化，通过高分辨率裁剪恢复几何细节。
在LIBERO、SimplerEnv和真实世界基准上取得显著成功率提升，计算开销仅增加1.4-1.6倍。
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的视觉表示在空间精确的机器人操作中仍然不可靠。我们发现VLA中的视觉编码器也表现出之前在通用视觉Transformer中记录到的注意力伪影，并进一步表明，在具身策略中，这些伪影与后训练期间获得的空间感知能力密切相关。当编码器学习任务相关信息（如物体位置、深度顺序和局部几何形状）时，有限的全局令牌容量导致部分信息溢出到低信息补丁令牌中。我们引入了AtVLA，一个在视觉编码器中插入可学习注册令牌的框架。仅使用具身数据和原始动作目标进行端到端训练，这些注册令牌成为具身空间信息的专用载体，而剩余的补丁令牌恢复了清晰且空间上忠实的注意力分布，这对于精确的目标定位和细粒度接触至关重要。清晰的注意力恢复了可靠的定位，但无法恢复在低分辨率观测中丢失的几何细节。因此，AtVLA将注意力校正与不确定性门控局部细化相结合。动作专家采样多个动作块并从它们的不一致性中估计不确定性；仅对于不确定的预测，动作条件注意力展开识别任务相关区域，该区域被裁剪、以高分辨率重新编码，并附加到缓存前缀以进行细化的动作生成。在LIBERO、SimplerEnv和一个具有挑战性的单视图真实世界基准测试中，AtVLA将平均LIBERO成功率从94.2%提高到98.4%，真实世界成功率从46.5%提高到69.0%。裁剪在大约30%的重新规划步骤中触发，在代表性部署设置下，总计算量仅为基础模型的1.4-1.6倍。
papers.summary_one_sentence: AtVLA通过插入可学习注册令牌和不确定性门控局部细化，改进了VLA模型在机器人操作中的视觉表示和空间精确性。

papers.title: TWINS: A Tactile Wearable Isomorphic Arm Networked System for Contact-Rich Manipulation Learning
papers.abstract: Recent advances in robot learning for manipulation have increased the importance of collecting real-world demonstration data. However, existing robotic systems primarily focus on end-effector manipulation, making it difficult to teach and execute manipulation tasks involving body-surface contact with the arms and chest. This paper presents TWINS (Tactile Wearable Isomorphic Arm Networked System), a robotic system for manipulation involving body-surface contact. TWINS consists of a Wearable Dual-Arm Device, which is worn by the operator, and an Isomorphic Robot with the same joint configuration and external dimensions. Distributed tactile sensors embedded in the chest and arms enable the measurement of body-surface contact synchronized with joint motion. Using the Wearable Dual-Arm Device, we collected demonstrations for four manipulation tasks involving body-surface contact. We then trained imitation learning policies using the collected demonstrations and deployed them on the Isomorphic Robot, enabling manipulation guided by body-surface tactile observations. Experimental results demonstrate that TWINS provides a unified robotic system for demonstration, learning, and execution of manipulation involving body-surface contact. https://mmurooka.github.io/twins-project-page/
core_contributions: 提出了TWINS系统，包括可穿戴双臂设备和同构机器人，用于涉及身体表面接触的操作。
在胸部和手臂嵌入分布式触觉传感器，实现与关节运动同步的身体表面接触测量。
收集了四个涉及身体表面接触的操作任务的演示数据。
训练模仿学习策略并部署在同构机器人上，实现由身体表面触觉观察引导的操作。
提供了一个统一的演示、学习和执行系统，填补了身体表面接触操作领域的空白。
papers.abstract_zh: 最近机器人操作学习的进展增加了收集真实世界演示数据的重要性。然而，现有的机器人系统主要关注末端执行器操作，使得教授和执行涉及手臂和胸部身体表面接触的操作任务变得困难。本文提出了TWINS（触觉可穿戴同构手臂网络系统），一种用于涉及身体表面接触的操作的机器人系统。TWINS由一个操作员穿戴的可穿戴双臂设备和一个具有相同关节配置和外部尺寸的同构机器人组成。嵌入在胸部和手臂的分布式触觉传感器能够测量与关节运动同步的身体表面接触。使用可穿戴双臂设备，我们收集了四个涉及身体表面接触的操作任务的演示。然后，我们使用收集的演示训练了模仿学习策略，并将其部署在同构机器人上，实现了由身体表面触觉观察引导的操作。实验结果表明，TWINS提供了一个统一的机器人系统，用于涉及身体表面接触的操作的演示、学习和执行。
