papers.title: ChainVLA: Chaining Vision-Language-Action Queries through a Unified Execution State for Long-Horizon Manipulation
papers.abstract: Humans perform long-horizon manipulation by retaining knowledge of what earlier actions have established while continuously adapting the motion underway. By contrast, action-chunked vision-language-action (VLA) policies repeatedly replan from the current input at each query. Existing methods preserve either long-term task evidence through memory or short-term motion through action reuse and ensembling, leaving the cross-query handoff incomplete. We introduce ChainVLA, a 1.2B-parameter VLA policy that chains successive queries through a joint and revisable execution state. Progress Context combines a recurrent Working State with sparse event memory to carry observation-derived task progress, while Motion Tail feeds the preceding prediction's unexecuted continuation into state construction and action generation. Together, the two components condition a decoder that regenerates each action horizon under the latest observation, allowing the carried state to guide the next prediction without fixing it. ChainVLA reaches 62.8% average success on RMBench and 98.8% across four LIBERO suites, while removing Motion Tail or Progress Context reduces RMBench success to 11.2% and 3.0%, respectively. These asymmetric ablations are consistent with motion continuity helping preserve the observation stream from which task progress is inferred.
core_contributions: 提出ChainVLA模型，通过联合且可修订的执行状态链接连续查询。
引入Progress Context组件，结合循环工作状态与稀疏事件记忆以携带任务进度。
引入Motion Tail组件，利用先前预测的未执行延续指导当前动作生成。
在RMBench和LIBERO套件上取得显著成功率，消融实验验证了各组件的必要性。
papers.abstract_zh: 人类通过保留先前动作建立的知识同时不断调整进行中的运动来执行长期操作。相比之下，动作分块的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略每次查询时都从当前输入重新规划。现有方法通过记忆保留长期任务证据，或通过动作重用和集成保留短期运动，但跨查询的交接不完整。我们提出ChainVLA，一个1.2B参数的VLA策略，通过联合且可修订的执行状态链接连续查询。Progress Context将循环工作状态与稀疏事件记忆相结合，以携带从观察中推导的任务进度，而Motion Tail将先前预测的未执行延续馈送到状态构建和动作生成中。这两个组件共同调节一个解码器，该解码器在最新观察下重新生成每个动作范围，使得携带的状态能够指导下一个预测而不固定它。ChainVLA在RMBench上达到62.8%的平均成功率，在四个LIBERO套件上达到98.8%，而移除Motion Tail或Progress Context分别将RMBench成功率降低到11.2%和3.0%。这些不对称消融与运动连续性有助于保留推断任务进度所依赖的观察流一致。
papers.summary_one_sentence: ChainVLA通过联合执行状态链接视觉-语言-动作查询，在长期操作任务中取得高成功率。
papers.research_problem: 现有VLA策略在长期操作中跨查询交接不完整，无法同时保留长期任务证据和短期运动连续性。
papers.method_summary: ChainVLA使用Progress Context（循环工作状态+稀疏事件记忆）携带从观察中推导的任务进度，Motion Tail将先前预测的未执行延续馈送到状态构建和动作生成中，两者共同调节一个解码器，在最新观察下重新生成每个动作范围，实现跨查询的状态链接。

papers.title: ReTouch: Empowering Contact-Rich Dexterous Manipulation with Online-Refined Tactile Prediction
papers.abstract: Fusing tactile signals has proven effective for contact-rich manipulation, enabling robots to perceive contact states and adapt to rapidly changing physical interactions. Yet effectively integrating tactile feedback into dexterous manipulation remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce ReTouch, a vision-language-action model (VLA) that supports contact-rich dexterous manipulation through tactile predictions continually refined online using execution-time feedback. ReTouch builds on two main innovations for tactile representation and closed-loop action generation. First, its Tactile-Patch Encoder represents tactile observations as structured tactile patch features that preserve finger identity and local contact structure, providing contact cues for fine-grained dexterous control. Second, its high-frequency action module jointly predicts future tactile states and action chunks and refines both using incoming tactile feedback during execution. This closed-loop refinement keeps tactile predictions aligned with evolving physical interactions, enabling responsive action correction and improving robustness to contact changes and execution errors. We further introduce XHT-Dataset, comprising 900 real-world demonstrations across seven contact-rich tasks collected on an XHand--UR7e platform, and evaluate ReTouch through closed-loop real-robot experiments. ReTouch surpasses the strongest baseline by 18.4 and 23.8 percentage points in average success rate under standard and challenging conditions, respectively, demonstrating its effectiveness and robustness.
core_contributions: 提出触觉补丁编码器，将触觉观察表示为结构化补丁特征，保留手指身份和局部接触结构。
设计高频动作模块，联合预测未来触觉状态和动作块，并通过执行时触觉反馈进行闭环优化。
构建XHT-Dataset，包含900个真实世界演示和七个接触丰富任务。
在真实机器人实验中，ReTouch在标准与挑战条件下分别超越最强基线18.4和23.8个百分点。
papers.abstract_zh: 融合触觉信号已被证明对接触丰富的操作有效，使机器人能够感知接触状态并适应快速变化的物理交互。然而，将触觉反馈有效整合到灵巧操作中仍未充分探索。在这项工作中，我们介绍了ReTouch，一种视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA），通过使用执行时反馈持续在线优化的触觉预测来支持接触丰富的灵巧操作。ReTouch建立在触觉表示和闭环动作生成的两个主要创新之上。首先，其触觉补丁编码器将触觉观察表示为结构化的触觉补丁特征，保留手指身份和局部接触结构，为精细灵巧控制提供接触线索。其次，其高频动作模块联合预测未来触觉状态和动作块，并在执行过程中使用传入的触觉反馈优化两者。这种闭环优化使触觉预测与不断变化的物理交互保持一致，实现响应式动作修正，并提高对接触变化和执行错误的鲁棒性。我们进一步介绍了XHT-Dataset，包含在XHand-UR7e平台上收集的七个接触丰富任务的900个真实世界演示，并通过闭环真实机器人实验评估ReTouch。ReTouch在标准条件和挑战条件下分别比最强基线高出18.4和23.8个百分点，证明了其有效性和鲁棒性。

papers.title: Learning Physical Interaction: A Survey of Tactile- and Force-aware Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Physically grounded robot intelligence requires robots to perceive, reason about, and regulate their interactions with the physical world. This capability is particularly critical in contact-sensitive manipulation, where successful task execution depends not only on visual perception and motion generation, but also on force regulation and adaptive control. In this context, recent robot learning methods have made substantial progress by integrating force, tactile, vision, language, and proprioceptive sensing into learned manipulation policies. In parallel, many systems adopt multi-phase architectures that combine high-level policies, action-refinement modules, and low-level controllers to bridge semantic task understanding with reactive physical execution. Despite these advances, existing surveys have not explicitly reviewed force- and tactile-aware robot learning from a unified perspective that jointly captures multimodal sensing and multi-phase system design. This survey addresses this gap by proposing TF-ART, a Tactile/Force-Aware Robot learning Taxonomy for multimodal and multi-phase frameworks, which maps individual methods into a unified hierarchical structure. The framework characterizes how recent works organize observation modalities, encode and fuse heterogeneous sensory inputs, generate and refine actions across multiple phases, and connect learned policies to reactive robot-end control. Building on this methodological view, we further examine the task settings and infrastructure requirements of physical interaction, thereby integrating both algorithmic and practical perspectives on force- and tactile-aware robot learning.
core_contributions: 提出了TF-ART分类法，用于多模态和多阶段框架的统一层次结构
描述了近期工作如何组织观察模态、编码融合、动作生成细化和策略-控制连接
整合了算法和实践视角，考察了任务设置和基础设施需求
papers.abstract_zh: 物理基础的机器人智能要求机器人感知、推理和调节它们与物理世界的交互。这种能力在接触敏感操作中尤为关键，其中成功的任务执行不仅依赖于视觉感知和运动生成，还依赖于力调节和自适应控制。在此背景下，最近的机器人学习方法通过将力、触觉、视觉、语言和本体感觉集成到学习到的操作策略中取得了实质性进展。同时，许多系统采用多阶段架构，结合高层策略、动作细化模块和低层控制器，以桥接语义任务理解与反应性物理执行。尽管有这些进展，现有的综述尚未从统一视角明确回顾触觉和力感知的机器人学习，该视角同时捕捉多模态感知和多阶段系统设计。本综述通过提出TF-ART（触觉/力感知机器人学习分类法）来填补这一空白，该分类法针对多模态和多阶段框架，将各个方法映射到一个统一的层次结构中。该框架描述了近期工作如何组织观察模态、编码和融合异构感官输入、跨多个阶段生成和细化动作，以及将学习到的策略连接到反应性机器人末端控制。在此方法论观点的基础上，我们进一步考察了物理交互的任务设置和基础设施需求，从而整合了触觉和力感知机器人学习的算法和实践视角。

papers.title: RLMM-Flow: A Flow-based Mobile Manipulation Framework with Latent-Space Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Mobile manipulation requires generating whole-body action chunks that jointly satisfy goal reaching, collision avoidance, base kinematic constraints, manipulator joint limits, and trajectory smoothness. Flow-based generative policies provide an efficient paradigm for learning multimodal and temporally consistent motion priors from expert demonstrations, but imitation-only training cannot improve policy quality beyond the demonstration distribution. We propose RLMM-Flow, a flow-based mobile manipulation framework that combines expert flow-policy pretraining with latent-space reinforcement learning post-training. The framework first learns a flow policy that captures a multimodal whole-body motion prior from expert demonstrations. The pretrained flow policy is then frozen, while a latent steering network steers its initial noise toward higher-value action chunks. To stabilize high-dimensional latent optimization, we warm up an action-space critic before jointly training the latent critic and latent actor, and introduce coarse-to-fine latent steering that progressively expands control from a horizon-shared latent representation to a full-dimensional residual representation. Experiments on mobile manipulation motion-planning benchmarks show that RLMM-Flow substantially improves task success, collision avoidance, and trajectory quality over imitation-only flow policies and existing reinforcement learning post-training baselines, while preserving fast flow-based inference.
core_contributions: 提出RLMM-Flow框架，结合专家流策略预训练和潜在空间强化学习后训练。
冻结预训练流策略，使用潜在引导网络将初始噪声导向更高价值的动作块。
引入动作空间评论家预热和从粗到细的潜在引导以稳定高维潜在优化。
在移动操纵运动规划基准上验证了显著改进。
papers.abstract_zh: 移动操纵需要生成全身动作块，同时满足目标到达、碰撞避免、基座运动学约束、机械臂关节限制和轨迹平滑性。基于流的生成策略提供了一种从专家演示中学习多模态和时间一致的运动先验的有效范式，但仅靠模仿训练无法提高超出演示分布的策略质量。我们提出了RLMM-Flow，一种基于流的移动操纵框架，结合了专家流策略预训练和潜在空间强化学习后训练。该框架首先学习一个流策略，从专家演示中捕获多模态全身运动先验。然后冻结预训练流策略，同时一个潜在引导网络将其初始噪声导向更高价值的动作块。为了稳定高维潜在优化，我们在联合训练潜在评论家和潜在演员之前预热动作空间评论家，并引入从粗到细的潜在引导，逐步将控制从共享视野的潜在表示扩展到全维残差表示。在移动操纵运动规划基准上的实验表明，RLMM-Flow在任务成功、碰撞避免和轨迹质量上显著优于仅模仿的流策略和现有的强化学习后训练基线，同时保持了基于流的快速推理。

papers.title: $N_0$-VTLA: Scaling Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Model with Latent Tactile Tokens
papers.abstract: We present $N_0$-VTLA, a vision-tactile-language-action (VTLA) foundation model capable of (1) fine-grained contact-rich manipulation with tactile perception and tactile-feedback control, and (2) offline policy improvement from stored deployment data. Building on current vision-based backbones, we propose a training recipe for tactile integration consisting of visuo-tactile pre-training, staged tactile-pathway integration, and advantage-conditioned offline policy improvement. During pre-training, the policy learns broad contact priors from NeoData, our large-scale visuo-tactile robot dataset; to our knowledge, $N_0$-VTLA is the first VTLA model pretrained on tactile data at scale. During post-training, we augment the policy with a predictive tactile pathway that distills the contact patterns learned at scale into the fine motion adjustments required by downstream tactile-centric manipulation. For offline policy improvement, we introduce ALTER, an advantage-conditioned offline reinforcement learning method that converts relative progress and trajectory-event comparisons into binary advantage labels for policy training on a fixed deployment corpus, further improving task-specific learning on contact-rich skills such as deformable object manipulation. Across contact-rich benchmarks, $N_0$-VTLA outperforms strong baselines by wide margins: it wins all nine real-robot NeoReal tasks and reaches 63.8% mean success on a twenty-task simulation suite, against 44.0% for the strongest baseline. $N_0$-VTLA policies trained with ALTER reach 75-95% success on three long-horizon real-robot tasks. These results lay a foundation for versatile tactile-driven manipulation policies.
core_contributions: 提出了N0-VTLA，第一个在大规模触觉数据上预训练的视觉-触觉-语言-动作基础模型。
提出了触觉集成的训练方案：视觉-触觉预训练、分阶段触觉通路集成和优势条件离线策略改进。
构建了大规模视觉-触觉机器人数据集NeoData。
提出了ALTER，一种优势条件离线强化学习方法，用于从固定部署数据中改进策略。
在多个接触密集型基准上取得了显著性能提升，包括所有真实机器人任务和仿真套件。
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了N0-VTLA，一个视觉-触觉-语言-动作（VTLA）基础模型，能够实现（1）具有触觉感知和触觉反馈控制的精细接触操作，以及（2）从存储的部署数据进行离线策略改进。基于当前的视觉骨干网络，我们提出了一种触觉集成的训练方案，包括视觉-触觉预训练、分阶段触觉通路集成和优势条件离线策略改进。在预训练期间，策略从我们的大规模视觉-触觉机器人数据集NeoData中学习广泛的接触先验；据我们所知，N0-VTLA是第一个在大规模触觉数据上预训练的VTLA模型。在后训练期间，我们通过一个预测性触觉通路增强策略，将大规模学习的接触模式蒸馏为下游触觉中心操作所需的精细运动调整。对于离线策略改进，我们引入了ALTER，一种优势条件离线强化学习方法，将相对进度和轨迹事件比较转换为二元优势标签，用于在固定部署语料库上进行策略训练，进一步改进接触密集型技能（如可变形物体操作）的任务特定学习。在接触密集型基准测试中，N0-VTLA以较大优势超越强基线：它在所有九个真实机器人NeoReal任务中获胜，并在二十个任务的仿真套件中达到63.8%的平均成功率，而最强基线为44.0%。使用ALTER训练的N0-VTLA策略在三个长时域真实机器人任务中达到75-95%的成功率。这些结果为多功能触觉驱动操作策略奠定了基础。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出了N0-VTLA，一个通过大规模触觉预训练和离线策略改进实现精细接触操作的视觉-触觉-语言-动作基础模型。

papers.method_summary: 基于视觉骨干网络，通过视觉-触觉预训练学习接触先验，然后通过预测性触觉通路蒸馏接触模式到精细运动调整，最后使用ALTER方法进行离线策略改进。

papers.why_it_matters: 该工作是第一个大规模触觉预训练的VTLA模型，为触觉驱动的操作策略奠定了基础，展示了触觉感知在精细操作中的重要性。

papers.image_caption: Figure 6 : ALTER for offline policy improvement. Tactile contact changes, complemented by kinematic and visual cues, ground stage annotations of clean demonstrations and yield dense progress pairs. Tactile-detected object-drop events and logged HIL corrections yield sparse preference pairs. Both supervise a pairwise progress model, which is then frozen to estimate global task phase and local execution change for each stored trajectory. Within each predicted stage, local-change estimates produce binary advantage labels that are appended to the task prompt during policy training. At deployment, the task prompt uses the positive label.
papers.image_caption_zh: 用于离线策略改进的ALTER。触觉接触变化，结合运动学和视觉线索，对干净演示进行阶段标注并生成密集进度对。触觉检测的物体掉落事件和记录的HIL修正生成稀疏偏好对。两者监督成对进度模型，该模型随后被冻结以估计每个存储轨迹的全局任务阶段和局部执行变化。在每个预测阶段内，局部变化估计产生二元优势标签，在策略训练期间附加到任务提示。部署时，任务提示使用正标签。

papers.title: Asynchronous Multimodal Diffusion Policy Composition via Latency-Aware Guidance Fusion
papers.abstract: Diffusion policies have shown strong potential for robotic imitation learning, and recent extensions incorporate additional modalities to improve manipulation performance. However, these modalities often differ not only in information content but also in sensing rates and inference latencies. Existing multimodal diffusion policies typically rely on synchronous fusion or manually designed multi-frequency architectures, which either slow down high-frequency feedback or limit extensibility to new modality combinations. We propose LAG-Fusion, a latency-aware guidance fusion framework for asynchronous multimodal diffusion policy composition. LAG-Fusion allows modality-specific policies to operate at their native inference rates and contribute denoising guidance whenever available. To make asynchronous composition consistent, we derive a reference-frame rebasing rule for diffusion variables under relative action representations, enabling delayed guidance to be aligned before fusion. We instantiate LAG-Fusion in contact-rich manipulation by composing a low-frequency vision policy with a high-frequency force policy. Experiments under heterogeneous modality latencies show that LAG-Fusion improves policy responsiveness and task performance over synchronous fusion and specially designed force-aware baselines.
core_contributions: 提出LAG-Fusion，一种延迟感知引导融合框架，用于异步多模态扩散策略组合。
推导了在相对动作表示下扩散变量的参考帧重基规则，使得延迟的引导在融合前对齐，保证异步组合的一致性。
在接触丰富的操作中实例化LAG-Fusion，通过组合低频视觉策略和高频力策略，实验证明其优于同步融合和力感知基线。
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散策略在机器人模仿学习中显示出强大潜力，最近的扩展加入了额外模态以提高操作性能。然而，这些模态不仅在信息内容上不同，而且在感知速率和推理延迟上也不同。现有的多模态扩散策略通常依赖于同步融合或手动设计的多频率架构，这要么减慢高频反馈，要么限制对新模态组合的可扩展性。我们提出LAG-Fusion，一种用于异步多模态扩散策略组合的延迟感知引导融合框架。LAG-Fusion允许模态特定策略以其原生推理速率运行，并在可用时贡献去噪引导。为了使异步组合一致，我们推导了在相对动作表示下扩散变量的参考帧重基规则，使得延迟的引导在融合前对齐。我们在接触丰富的操作中实例化LAG-Fusion，通过组合低频视觉策略和高频力策略。在异构模态延迟下的实验表明，LAG-Fusion在策略响应性和任务性能上优于同步融合和专门设计的力感知基线。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出一种延迟感知引导融合框架LAG-Fusion，通过允许不同模态的策略以原生推理速率运行并推导参考帧重基规则实现异步多模态扩散策略的有效组合，在接触丰富的操作中结合低频视觉和高频力策略，提升了响应性和任务性能。
papers.research_problem: 现有多模态扩散策略通常依赖同步融合或手动设计的多频率架构，导致高频反馈变慢或限制可扩展性，无法有效处理不同模态在感知速率和推理延迟上的差异。
papers.method_summary: LAG-Fusion允许每个模态的策略以其原生推理速率独立运行，并在可用时提供去噪引导。为了处理异步性，推导了参考帧重基规则，将延迟到达的引导通过参考帧变换对齐到当前时间步，然后进行融合，从而实现一致的去噪过程。
papers.experimental_setup: 在接触丰富的操作任务中评估，组合低频视觉策略和高频力策略。实验在异构模态延迟下进行，与同步融合和专门设计的力感知基线进行比较。具体任务、环境和指标未在摘要中详细说明。
papers.key_results: LAG-Fusion在策略响应性和任务性能上优于同步融合和专门设计的力感知基线。
papers.why_it_matters: 该方法解决了多模态扩散策略中异步融合的关键问题，允许不同模态以各自原生速率运行，提高了系统的响应性和可扩展性，对于机器人操作中结合不同频率的传感器（如视觉和力觉）具有重要意义，有助于实现更高效和灵活的具身智能系统。

papers.image_caption: Figure 1: Overview of the LAG-Fusion Framework. LAG-Fusion composes modality-specific diffusion policies at their native inference frequencies. (Left) A low-frequency vision policy provides long-horizon scene guidance, while a high-frequency force/torque policy provides local contact guidance. (Right) In the diffusion composition head, the overlapping noisy action segment is rebased into the current force frame for force denoising. The corresponding vision guidance is rebased to the same frame, fused with force guidance, and mapped back to update the full-horizon noise prediction.
papers.image_caption_zh: LAG-Fusion框架概述。LAG-Fusion以各模态自身的推理频率组合特定模态的扩散策略。(左)低频视觉策略提供长程场景引导，高频力/力矩策略提供局部接触引导。(右)在扩散组合头中，重叠的噪声动作片段重新基准到当前力帧进行力去噪。相应的视觉引导重新基准到同一帧，与力引导融合，并映射回更新全范围噪声预测。

papers.title: BayesContact: Uncertain Pose Estimation via Visuo-Tactile Proposals and Simulation-based Inference
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires pose estimates that are often more accurate than what depth-only sensing provides. Existing methods, relying on vision and contact, employ costly offline training procedures that need to be retrained for new environments and geometries. We propose BayesContact, a Simulation-Based Inference framework for visuo-tactile pose estimation in peg-in-hole insertion. BayesContact maintains a particle belief over object pose and fuses depth observations with force/torque-derived contact evidence. We employ simulation based forward models to approximate these observation likelihoods. For each pose hypothesis, a renderer predicts depth measurements and a physics simulator predicts contact outcomes under guarded probing actions; both are scored against real observations to update the belief. The resulting multimodal belief also enables information-gain-based probing for active disambiguation. Across simulated geometries and real-robot experiments, BayesContact improves pose observability and insertion success over vision-only inference by 30%
core_contributions: 提出BayesContact框架，将模拟推理用于视觉-触觉姿态估计。
采用粒子信念融合深度观测和力/力矩接触证据，避免离线训练。
利用渲染器和物理模拟器作为前向模型，实现观测似然的近似。
基于信息增益的主动探测策略，用于多模态信念的消歧。
papers.abstract_zh: 接触丰富的操作需要比仅深度传感更准确的姿态估计。现有方法依赖视觉和接触，采用昂贵的离线训练程序，需要针对新环境和几何形状重新训练。我们提出BayesContact，一个基于模拟推理的框架，用于插孔插入中的视觉-触觉姿态估计。BayesContact维护关于物体姿态的粒子信念，并将深度观测与力/力矩导出的接触证据融合。我们采用基于模拟的前向模型来近似这些观测似然。对于每个姿态假设，渲染器预测深度测量，物理模拟器在受保护的探测动作下预测接触结果；两者都与真实观测进行评分以更新信念。由此产生的多模态信念还能够实现基于信息增益的探测以进行主动消歧。在模拟几何和真实机器人实验中，BayesContact将姿态可观测性和插入成功率比仅视觉推理提高了30%。
papers.summary_one_sentence: BayesContact是一个基于模拟推理的视觉-触觉姿态估计框架，通过粒子滤波融合深度和力/力矩信息，在插孔插入任务中提高了姿态估计精度和成功率。
papers.research_problem: 如何在不需重新训练的情况下实现准确的视觉-触觉姿态估计，以支持接触丰富的操作任务。
papers.method_summary: BayesContact维护粒子信念，对每个姿态假设使用渲染器预测深度、物理模拟器预测接触结果，并与真实观测评分更新信念；同时利用信息增益选择探测动作以主动消歧。
papers.experimental_setup: 在模拟几何环境和真实机器人平台上进行实验，评估姿态可观测性和插入成功率。
papers.key_results: BayesContact将姿态可观测性和插入成功率比仅视觉推理提高了30%。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作解决了接触丰富操作中姿态估计精度不足和现有方法泛化性差的问题，通过模拟推理避免了昂贵的离线训练，提高了实际部署的可行性。

BayesContact performs pose estimation using simulation-based forward models with a graphics renderer for depth observations and a physics simulator for contact observations. papers.title: Scalable Open-Source Visuotactile Sensor for 6-Axis Contact Wrench Estimation in Tensegrity Robots
papers.abstract: This paper presents a scalable, open-source visuotactile sensing system for tensegrity robots that enables six-axis wrench estimation and contact detection. The proposed endcap sensor integrates an elastomeric shell, a 3D-printed thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) interface, and a rigid base housing an embedded camera and LED illumination ring. A novel gyroid-infill bonding technique is introduced to form a durable elastomer-TPU interface without adhesives, yielding a lightweight and modular design compatible with large-scale tensegrity structures. A tactile-to-wrench neural network maps shear vector fields to six-dimensional force and torque measurements. Experimental results demonstrate accurate and stable wrench estimation with a mean squared error (MSE) of 0.1531 on static validation data and out-of-domain generalization under dynamic motion. Furthermore, full-system integration on a 12 kg tensegrity robot confirms the sensor's ability to reliably identify ground contacts. The system substantially improves the practicality of tactile feedback for tensegrity robots, offering a low-cost, reproducible, and physically interpretable pathway toward contact-aware proprioception and state estimation. Open source files are available at \href{https://github.com/Jonathan-Twz/tensegrity-gelfoot}{github.com/Jonathan-Twz/tensegrity-gelfoot}
core_contributions: 提出了一种可扩展的开源视触觉传感系统，专为张拉整体机器人设计。
设计了集成弹性体外壳、3D打印TPU接口和嵌入式摄像头的端盖传感器。
引入了新颖的螺旋填充粘合技术，无需粘合剂即可形成耐用的弹性体-TPU接口。
开发了触觉到力/力矩的神经网络，将剪切矢量场映射为六维力/力矩。
在静态和动态实验中验证了力/力矩估计的准确性和泛化能力，并在12kg张拉整体机器人上验证了地面接触识别。
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种可扩展的开源视触觉传感系统，用于张拉整体机器人，能够实现六轴力/力矩估计和接触检测。所提出的端盖传感器集成了一个弹性体外壳、一个3D打印的热塑性聚氨酯（TPU）接口和一个容纳嵌入式摄像头和LED照明环的刚性底座。引入了一种新颖的螺旋填充粘合技术，无需粘合剂即可形成耐用的弹性体-TPU接口，从而产生轻量化和模块化设计，适用于大规模张拉整体结构。一个触觉到力/力矩的神经网络将剪切矢量场映射到六维力和力矩测量。实验结果表明，在静态验证数据上均方误差（MSE）为0.1531，实现了准确稳定的力/力矩估计，并在动态运动下具有域外泛化能力。此外，在12公斤张拉整体机器人上的全系统集成证实了传感器可靠识别地面接触的能力。该系统显著提高了张拉整体机器人触觉反馈的实用性，为接触感知本体感觉和状态估计提供了一条低成本、可重复且物理可解释的途径。开源文件可在github.com/Jonathan-Twz/tensegrity-gelfoot获取。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 本文提出了一种用于张拉整体机器人的可扩展开源视触觉传感系统，通过集成弹性体外壳、3D打印TPU接口和嵌入式摄像头，结合触觉到力/力矩神经网络，实现了六轴力/力矩估计和接触检测。
papers.research_problem: 如何为张拉整体机器人提供低成本、可扩展、开源的视触觉传感系统，以实现六轴力/力矩估计和接触检测，从而增强其接触感知和状态估计能力。
papers.method_summary: 通过集成弹性体外壳、3D打印TPU接口和嵌入式摄像头的端盖传感器，利用螺旋填充粘合技术形成无粘合剂接口，并训练神经网络将触觉图像中的剪切矢量场映射为六维力/力矩。
papers.experimental_setup: 在静态验证数据集上评估力/力矩估计精度（MSE 0.1531），在动态运动下测试域外泛化能力，并在12kg张拉整体机器人上进行全系统集成以验证地面接触检测。具体实验细节（如数据集构成、传感器数量等）无法从摘要确认。

papers.title: A Model-Based Decoupling Strategy for Proprioception and Contact Sensing in an Architected Soft Manipulator
papers.abstract: Soft continuum robots require embedded sensing for proprioception and contact detection, yet integrating sensors into sparse, highly deformable architected structures remains challenging. We present a model-based strategy that decouples proprioceptive and contact signals from a common set of fluidic pressure sensors embedded in a soft architected segment. Each segment of the Innervated Trimmed Helicoid (ITH) contains six air channels routed in a localized zigzag pattern along the circumference. With only three principal kinematic degrees of freedom (axial compression, bending in x, bending in y), the six pressure readings form an overdetermined system. A piecewise constant curvature model maps pressures to shape, and Huber regression identifies outlier channels whose residuals indicate external contact. On a single ITH segment, this approach achieves proprioceptive shape estimation with a relative bending error of 0.11 +/- 0.02 and a contact detection rate of 97% across 178 trials. We integrate eight ITH segments into Air-Helix, a tendon-driven soft continuum manipulator, and present exploratory whole-arm demonstrations that include tactile teaching by demonstration, admittance-controlled force regulation, and tactile object reconstruction. The results suggest that localized fluidic innervation combined with model-based redundancy resolution is a practical path toward concurrent proprioception and contact sensing in architected soft robots.
core_contributions: 提出一种基于模型的策略，从共同的流体压力传感器中解耦本体感知和接触信号。

papers.abstract_zh: 软体连续机器人需要嵌入式传感来实现本体感知和接触检测，但在稀疏、高度可变的架构化结构中集成传感器仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了一种基于模型的策略，从嵌入在软体架构化段中的一组流体压力传感器中解耦本体感知和接触信号。每个Innervated Trimmed Helicoid (ITH)段包含六个空气通道，沿圆周以局部锯齿形图案布置。仅具有三个主要运动学自由度（轴向压缩、x方向弯曲、y方向弯曲），六个压力读数形成一个过定系统。分段常曲率模型将压力映射到形状，Huber回归识别残差指示外部接触的异常通道。在单个ITH段上，该方法实现了本体感知形状估计，相对弯曲误差为0.11±0.02，接触检测率为97%（178次试验）。我们将八个ITH段集成到Air-Helix（一种腱驱动软体连续机械臂）中，并展示了探索性全臂演示，包括触觉示教、导纳控制力调节和触觉物体重建。结果表明，局部流体神经支配与基于模型的冗余解析相结合，是在架构化软体机器人中实现并发本体感知和接触传感的实用路径。

papers.title: Beyond Implicit Force: Evaluating Explicit Force-Torque Proxies in Action Chunking with Transformers
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires policies to infer interaction state from signals that are often weakly observable through vision and kinematics alone. Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) has shown strong performance in fine-grained manipulation, but many deployments collect demonstrations through leader-follower teleoperation, where tracking error between commanded leader motion and executed follower motion implicitly encodes contact, resistance, and constraint violation. This paper examines whether ACT's apparent force-awareness depends on this hidden interaction cue. We introduce an observation-centric ACT variant that predicts future follower joint states instead of leader commands, thereby removing the teleoperation-induced discrepancy signal while preserving the rest of the learning pipeline. We then evaluate whether simple joint-torque proxies, derived from onboard motor current or joint effort, can recover contact-aware behavior without external force/torque sensors. Across four real-world tasks spanning surface following, insertion, stiffness discrimination, and force-based stopping, removing the implicit cue leads to severe failures in force-critical phases. In contrast, torque-augmented policies recover robust contact behavior and improve the base ACT policy. These results demonstrate that, on real hardware, the implicit teleoperation cue is a recoverable source of force-awareness, where torque signals are available, a simple proxy matches, surpasses, or further enhances it.
core_contributions: 揭示了ACT在接触操作中的力感知依赖于遥操作产生的隐式跟踪误差线索
提出了一个以观察为中心的ACT变体，通过预测未来从端关节状态去除隐式线索，用于隔离研究力感知来源
评估了从电机电流或关节力矩派生的简单扭矩代理在四个真实世界接触任务中的有效性
证明简单扭矩代理可以匹配、超越或进一步增强隐式线索带来的力感知能力
papers.abstract_zh: 接触丰富的操作需要策略从视觉和运动学通常难以观察的信号中推断交互状态。Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) 在精细操作中表现出色，但许多部署通过主从遥操作收集演示，其中命令的主端运动和执行的从端运动之间的跟踪误差隐式编码了接触、阻力和约束违反。本文研究ACT的明显力感知是否依赖于这种隐藏的交互线索。我们引入了一个以观察为中心的ACT变体，预测未来的从端关节状态而不是主端命令，从而去除遥操作引起的差异信号，同时保留其余学习流程。然后我们评估简单的关节扭矩代理（来自电机电流或关节力矩）是否可以在没有外部力/扭矩传感器的情况下恢复接触感知行为。在四个真实世界任务（表面跟随、插入、刚度辨别、基于力的停止）中，去除隐式线索导致力关键阶段的严重失败。相反，扭矩增强的策略恢复了鲁棒的接触行为并改进了基础ACT策略。这些结果表明，在真实硬件上，隐式遥操作线索是可恢复的力感知来源，在扭矩信号可用的情况下，简单的代理匹配、超越或进一步增强它。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 本文通过实验证明Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) 在接触操作中的力感知依赖于遥操作产生的隐式跟踪误差线索，并验证了简单扭矩代理可以替代该线索实现鲁棒的接触感知行为。
papers.research_problem: 研究问题：Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) 在接触丰富操作中的力感知是否依赖于遥操作中主从跟踪误差这一隐式线索？以及在没有外部力/扭矩传感器的情况下，简单的关节扭矩代理能否恢复接触感知行为？
papers.method_summary: 本文引入了一个以观察为中心的ACT变体，该变体预测未来的从端关节状态而非主端命令，从而去除遥操作中主从跟踪误差这一隐式力线索，同时保留ACT的其他学习流程。然后，作者评估了从电机电流或关节力矩派生的简单关节扭矩代理作为显式力线索的效果，并与隐式线索进行对比。
papers.experimental_setup: 实验在真实硬件上进行，涉及四个接触丰富的操作任务：表面跟随、插入、刚度辨别和基于力的停止。没有使用外部力/扭矩传感器，仅依赖机器人自身的电机电流或关节力矩信号。
papers.key_results: 去除隐式遥操作线索导致在力关键阶段（如接触检测、力控制）出现严重失败；而使用简单扭矩代理增强的策略能够恢复鲁棒的接触行为，并在所有任务中匹配或超越基础ACT策略的性能。具体地，扭矩代理在某些任务中甚至超越了隐式线索的效果。
papers.why_it_matters: 该研究揭示了广泛使用的ACT策略在接触操作中力感知的真正来源，为理解基于演示的模仿学习中的隐式力感知机制提供了重要见解。同时，它证明了无需外部力传感器，仅利用机器人本体感知的扭矩信号即可实现有效的接触感知操作，这对于降低机器人操作系统的成本和复杂性具有重要意义。

papers.title: KineFuse: Kinematic-Aware Haptic Fusion for In-Hand Occluded-Object Pose Tracking
papers.abstract: Dexterous in-hand manipulation requires continuous 6D pose tracking, yet the manipulating fingers inevitably occlude the object from the camera. We study how to structure the sparse haptic signals already available on multi-fingered hands, including proprioception, proximal force/torque, and binary contact, to complement a pretrained visual pose tracker under occlusion. We propose a kinematic-aware finger-level encoder and systematically compare it against four alternative designs through three levels of evaluation: per-frame refinement, sequential open-loop tracking, and closed-loop manipulation. Our experiments reveal that (i) per-frame evaluation cannot distinguish encoder quality, while sequential tracking amplifies architectural differences by up to 15 times; (ii) the structured encoder learns task-specific cross-modal gating, using vision exclusively for translation and dedicating one attention head to haptics for rotation, without explicit supervision; and (iii) compact finger-level tokenization with 4 tokens outperforms both flat fusion and joint-level representations, which suppress vision through norm dominance. We validate that improved tracking yields higher success in a downstream reorientation task and provide qualitative real-world demonstrations. Our project page is available at https://cold-young.github.io/kine-fuse/.
core_contributions: 提出运动学感知的手指级编码器（KineFuse）
系统比较四种替代编码器设计，通过三个层次评估
揭示逐帧评估不能区分编码器质量，序列跟踪放大架构差异达15倍
结构化编码器学习任务特定的跨模态门控，视觉用于平移，触觉用于旋转
紧凑手指级标记化（4个标记）优于平面融合和关节级表示
改进跟踪提高下游重定向任务成功率
papers.abstract_zh: 灵巧手内操作需要连续的6D位姿跟踪，但操作手指不可避免地会遮挡相机中的物体。我们研究如何结构化多指手上已有的稀疏触觉信号，包括本体感觉、近端力/力矩和二值接触，以在遮挡情况下补充预训练的视觉位姿跟踪器。我们提出了一种运动学感知的手指级编码器，并通过三个层次的评估（逐帧精化、序列开环跟踪和闭环操作）系统地将其与四种替代设计进行比较。我们的实验揭示：(i) 逐帧评估无法区分编码器质量，而序列跟踪将架构差异放大至15倍；(ii) 结构化编码器学习任务特定的跨模态门控，在没有显式监督的情况下，专门使用视觉进行平移，并分配一个注意力头处理触觉以进行旋转；(iii) 具有4个标记的紧凑手指级标记化优于平面融合和关节级表示，后者通过范数主导抑制视觉。我们验证了改进的跟踪在下游重定向任务中提高了成功率，并提供了定性真实世界演示。我们的项目页面可在 https://cold-young.github.io/kine-fuse/ 获取。

papers.title: VTAP Gripper: Synergizing Fingertip Sensing and a Visuo-Tactile Active Palm for Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation
papers.abstract: This paper presents a tactile-reactive gripper that integrates a Visuo-Tactile Active Palm (VTAP) and compliant, reconfigurable fingers equipped with tactile array sensors. The design exploits structured finger-palm synergy and multi-modal perception to achieve both robust grasping and fine manipulation. The actuated bi-modal palm seamlessly combines long-range visual localization with contact-rich tactile feedback, substantially extending the system's manipulation capability. To bridge the embodiment gap between human hand motion and the heterogeneous three-finger structure, we further propose a staged, gesture-conditioned retargeting framework for dexterous teleoperation. Extensive experiments validate the system across a range of challenging tasks: reactive grasping of YCB and fragile objects, in-hand syringe reorientation and plunger actuation, singulation of clustered objects down to 3 mm in diameter, and vision-tactile peg-in-hole insertion. Results demonstrate that high manipulation performance can be achieved through coordinated finger-palm interaction and multi-modal sensing, without resorting to high degrees of freedom anthropomorphic designs. The VTAP gripper and its retargeting framework offer a practical reference architecture for dexterous gripper design, manipulation, and contact-rich data collection in support of learning-based approaches. Project webpage: https://yuhochau.github.io/vtap/.
core_contributions: 提出了VTAP抓取器，集成视觉-触觉主动手掌和触觉阵列传感器的柔性可重构手指
设计了结构化手指-手掌协同和多模态感知机制，实现稳健抓取和精细操作

在多个挑战性任务上验证了系统性能，包括反应抓取、手内操作、小物体分离和销孔插入
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种触觉反应抓取器，它集成了视觉-触觉主动手掌（VTAP）和配备触觉阵列传感器的柔性可重构手指。该设计利用结构化手指-手掌协同和多模态感知，实现了稳健抓取和精细操作。驱动的双模态手掌无缝结合了远程视觉定位和接触丰富的触觉反馈，显著扩展了系统的操作能力。为了弥合人手运动与异质三指结构之间的具身差距，我们进一步提出了一个分阶段的、手势条件重定向框架，用于灵巧遥操作。大量实验验证了系统在多种挑战性任务上的表现：YCB和易碎物体的反应抓取、手内注射器重新定向和柱塞驱动、直径小至3毫米的聚类物体分离，以及视觉-触觉销孔插入。结果表明，通过协调的手指-手掌交互和多模态感知可以实现高操作性能，而无需高自由度拟人设计。VTAP抓取器及其重定向框架为灵巧抓取器设计、操作和接触丰富数据收集提供了实用参考架构。项目网页：https://yuhochau.github.io/vtap/。

papers.title: Never Too Late for Force: Accelerating VLA Post-Training with Reactive Force Injection
papers.abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies provide strong language-conditioned manipulation knowledge, but they remain largely vision-driven and can struggle once manipulation enters contact states where the scene is occluded, depth is ambiguous, or small force errors push execution off the offline demonstration distribution. We present LIFT (Late Reactive Injection of Force for VLA Post-Training), a force-aware post-training framework that adds contact reactivity to a pretrained VLA policy while preserving its general manipulation knowledge. LIFT grafts a reactive action expert beside the original action expert, initializes it from pretrained action weights, and injects recent 6D end-effector force through causal force memory and zero-initialized cross attention, enabling actions to be refreshed during execution. To address the policy-dependent distribution shift of contact feedback, LIFT further couples reactive force injection with an online DAgger loop that trains on a mixture of offline task-alignment data and human-corrected online rollouts. Across towel folding, book insertion, and Hanoi ring placement, LIFT learns faster and reaches higher performance than vision-only post-training, while ablations show that reactive force memory and online corrective data are both important for robust contact-rich manipulation. Our code and data will be publicly available.
core_contributions: 提出LIFT框架，一种力感知的后训练方法，为预训练VLA策略增加接触反应性同时保留通用操作知识。
设计反应性动作专家，通过因果力记忆和零初始化交叉注意力注入6D末端执行器力，实现执行中动作刷新。
引入在线DAgger循环处理接触反馈的策略依赖分布偏移，结合离线任务对齐数据和人工校正在线rollouts。
在毛巾折叠、书籍插入和汉诺塔环放置任务上验证了LIFT相比纯视觉后训练的更快学习速度和更高性能。
papers.abstract_zh: 预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略提供了强大的语言条件操作知识，但它们仍然主要是视觉驱动的，一旦操作进入接触状态，场景被遮挡、深度模糊或小的力误差导致执行偏离离线演示分布时，它们就会遇到困难。我们提出了LIFT（Late Reactive Injection of Force for VLA Post-Training），一个力感知的后训练框架，它为预训练的VLA策略增加了接触反应性，同时保留了其通用操作知识。LIFT在原始动作专家旁边嫁接了一个反应性动作专家，从预训练的动作权重初始化，并通过因果力记忆和零初始化的交叉注意力注入最近的6D末端执行器力，使得动作可以在执行过程中刷新。为了解决接触反馈的策略依赖分布偏移，LIFT进一步将反应性力注入与在线DAgger循环耦合，该循环在离线任务对齐数据和人工校正的在线rollouts的混合上进行训练。在毛巾折叠、书籍插入和汉诺塔环放置任务中，LIFT比纯视觉后训练学习更快且达到更高性能，而消融实验表明反应性力记忆和在线校正数据对于鲁棒的接触丰富操作都很重要。我们的代码和数据将公开。
papers.summary_one_sentence: LIFT通过在后训练中向预训练VLA策略注入反应性力信息，显著提升了其在接触丰富操作任务中的性能和学习效率。
papers.research_problem: 预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在接触状态中因视觉遮挡、深度模糊和力误差而表现不佳，缺乏接触反应性。
papers.method_summary: LIFT在原始动作专家旁嫁接一个反应性动作专家，从预训练权重初始化，通过因果力记忆和零初始化交叉注意力注入6D力，并使用在线DAgger循环在混合数据上训练以处理分布偏移。

papers.image_caption: Figure 1: LIFT overview. LIFT adds reactive force control to a pretrained VLA by encoding recent force as causal force memory and injecting it through cross attention for within-chunk action updates. To preserve the pretrained prior, the reactive action expert is copied from the base action expert and the force-injected cross attention is zero-initialized, making the augmented policy initially output-equivalent to the original model. papers.title: Kepler-Encoder-v0.1: Towards a Multimodal Embedding Model for Robots
papers.abstract: A robot must understand the state of its own body, but a camera sees only part of it. Force and contact leave almost no trace in a single frame, and raw vision features read force at $R^2$ at or below $0.10$ on every robot we test. We present Kepler-Encoder-v0.1, a robot-first multimodal encoder that treats robot state as a modality and fuses vision, proprioception, and force/torque into a single shared latent with a learned-query cross-attention layer, trained self-supervised by masked cross-modal prediction under the LeJEPA/SIGReg objective. At evaluation only vision enters, which poses a sharp question. Does fusing state into training make the vision-only latent carry anything the pixels do not already contain? On the RH20T corpus the answer is yes, precisely where the camera is weakest. On held-out scenes, the vision-only latent recovers end-effector state, and force in particular, significantly above both raw frozen-ViT features and a compute-matched vision-only control on every sensored robot, though absolute force recovery at a single timestep is modest; on motor state, which the camera largely sees, it is statistically tied with the strongest vision baselines, and it is the only feature whose latent geometry tracks state. A single embodiment-agnostic encoder covers four robots, and a data-matched control shows this breadth reflects embodiment diversity rather than data volume. The frozen latent is directly useful. Its own cross-modal prediction error is a training-free invalid-state monitor (AUROC $0.90$ on out-of-range states, $0.69$ on scene-swapped states), and a diffusion decoder (PixNerd) reconstructs the camera frame from the latent, confirming the spatial compression preserves world-state. This report validates the single-timestep case; native-rate temporal fusion is the next step.
core_contributions: 提出Kepler-Encoder-v0.1，一种机器人优先的多模态编码器，将机器人状态作为模态融合视觉、本体感觉和力/扭矩。
使用学习查询交叉注意力层进行多模态融合，并通过LeJEPA/SIGReg目标进行自监督掩码跨模态预测训练。
证明仅视觉的潜在表示在相机薄弱环节（如力）上显著优于基线，且潜在几何跟踪状态。
单一编码器覆盖四个不同机器人，且泛化能力源于形态多样性而非数据量。
冻结的潜在表示可直接用于无效状态监测（AUROC 0.90/0.69）和通过扩散解码器重建相机帧。
papers.abstract_zh: 机器人必须理解自身状态，但相机只能看到其中一部分。力和接触在单帧中几乎没有痕迹，原始视觉特征在我们测试的每个机器人上读取力的R²等于或低于0.10。我们提出Kepler-Encoder-v0.1，一种机器人优先的多模态编码器，它将机器人状态视为一种模态，并通过学习查询交叉注意力层将视觉、本体感觉和力/扭矩融合到一个共享潜在空间中，使用LeJEPA/SIGReg目标进行掩码跨模态预测自监督训练。在评估时，只有视觉输入，这提出了一个尖锐的问题：将状态融合到训练中是否使仅视觉的潜在表示携带了像素本身不包含的信息？在RH20T语料库上，答案是肯定的，恰好是在相机最薄弱的方面。在保留场景上，仅视觉的潜在表示恢复了末端执行器状态，特别是力，显著高于原始冻结ViT特征和计算匹配的仅视觉控制（在每个有传感器的机器人上），尽管单时间步的绝对力恢复适中；在电机状态（相机基本能看到）上，它与最强的视觉基线统计持平，并且它是唯一潜在几何跟踪状态的表示。一个单一的不依赖具体形态的编码器覆盖了四个机器人，数据匹配的控制表明这种广度反映了形态多样性而非数据量。冻结的潜在表示直接有用。其自身的跨模态预测误差是一种无需训练的无效状态监测器（超出范围状态的AUROC为0.90，场景交换状态为0.69），并且一个扩散解码器（PixNerd）从潜在表示重建相机帧，确认空间压缩保留了世界状态。本报告验证了单时间步情况；原生速率时间融合是下一步。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出Kepler-Encoder-v0.1，一种通过多模态自监督训练使仅视觉潜在表示能够恢复力和状态，并可直接用于无效状态监测的机器人编码器。
papers.research_problem: 机器人需要理解自身状态，但视觉传感器无法直接捕捉力和接触信息，原始视觉特征对力的预测能力极低（R²≤0.10）。
papers.method_summary: Kepler-Encoder-v0.1采用学习查询交叉注意力层融合视觉、本体感觉和力/扭矩模态，在训练时使用LeJEPA/SIGReg目标进行掩码跨模态预测自监督学习。评估时仅使用视觉输入，通过训练中融合状态信息使视觉潜在表示隐含力/触觉信息。
papers.experimental_setup: 在RH20T语料库上进行评估，涉及四个不同机器人。比较了原始冻结ViT特征和计算匹配的仅视觉控制。使用AUROC评估无效状态监测性能。具体数据集大小和机器人型号未详述。
papers.key_results: 仅视觉潜在表示在恢复末端执行器状态和力上显著高于基线（R²提升），但单时间步绝对力恢复适中；在电机状态上与最强视觉基线持平；潜在几何跟踪状态；跨模态预测误差作为无效状态监测器AUROC达0.90（超出范围状态）和0.69（场景交换状态）；扩散解码器成功重建相机帧。
papers.limitations: 单时间步力恢复能力有限；目前仅验证单时间步情况，时间融合尚未实现；绝对力恢复值仍较低。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作展示了通过多模态自监督训练，视觉潜在表示可以携带力/触觉信息，这对于机器人操作中无需专用力传感器即可感知力具有重要意义。同时，跨机器人泛化和无需训练的无效状态监测能力增强了其实用性。

papers.title: One-Shot Multimodal Learning from Demonstration with Force-Constrained Elastic Maps
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation tasks often require simultaneous reasoning over motion and contact forces, yet most Learning from Demonstration (LfD) methods model only spatial trajectories and neglect force interactions with the environment. This limitation reduces robustness and can lead to unsafe or inconsistent task reproduction in force-constrained settings. We propose a novel one-shot multimodal LfD framework for the segmentation, encoding, and reproduction of force-inclusive demonstrations. First, we introduce a multimodal probabilistic segmentation method that adaptively weighs spatial and force modalities over time, enabling the automatic extraction of force-aware motion primitives. Second, we extend the elastic maps representation to incorporate external force constraints during skill encoding and formulate a convex optimization procedure for learning force-consistent trajectory models. The resulting skills reproduce both motion and contact characteristics from a single demonstration while promoting safer execution by accounting for demonstrated force profiles. We validate our approach on five real-world manipulation tasks across two distinct force-sensing configurations: wrist force sensing on a UR5e with a Robotiq 2f-85 gripper and finger force sensing on a Kinova Gen3 with an Openhand Model O gripper. Experimental results demonstrate robust multimodal segmentation, accurate force-aware reproduction, and cross-platform generality.
core_contributions: 提出一种多模态概率分割方法，自适应加权空间和力模态，自动提取力感知运动基元。
扩展弹性地图表示以纳入外部力约束，并制定凸优化过程学习力一致的轨迹模型。
实现从单个示范中同时复现运动和接触特性，提升执行安全性。
papers.abstract_zh: 机器人操作任务通常需要同时对运动和接触力进行推理，但大多数从示范学习（LfD）方法仅建模空间轨迹，忽略了与环境的力交互。这一限制降低了鲁棒性，并可能导致在力约束设置中不安全或不一致的任务复现。我们提出了一种新颖的一次性多模态LfD框架，用于包含力的示范的分割、编码和复现。首先，我们引入了一种多模态概率分割方法，该方法随时间自适应地加权空间和力模态，从而能够自动提取力感知的运动基元。其次，我们将弹性地图表示扩展到在技能编码过程中纳入外部力约束，并制定了一个凸优化过程来学习力一致的轨迹模型。由此产生的技能从单个示范中复现运动和接触特性，同时通过考虑示范的力分布促进更安全的执行。我们在五个真实世界操作任务上验证了我们的方法，跨越两种不同的力传感配置：UR5e与Robotiq 2f-85夹爪上的腕部力传感，以及Kinova Gen3与Openhand Model O夹爪上的手指力传感。实验结果表明了鲁棒的多模态分割、准确的力感知复现以及跨平台通用性。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出一种一次性多模态从示范学习框架，通过自适应加权空间和力模态的分割和力约束弹性地图扩展，实现从单个示范中同时学习运动和接触力技能。
papers.research_problem: 现有从示范学习方法大多忽略力交互，仅建模空间轨迹，导致在力约束环境中任务复现不安全、不一致且鲁棒性差。
papers.method_summary: 框架包括三个阶段：首先，多模态概率分割方法根据时间自适应加权空间和力模态，自动分割出力感知的运动基元；其次，将弹性地图表示扩展以融入外部力约束，通过凸优化学习力一致的轨迹模型；最后，从单个示范复现运动和接触力特性。
papers.experimental_setup: 在五个真实世界操作任务上验证，使用两种力传感配置：UR5e机械臂搭配Robotiq 2f-85夹爪的腕部力传感，以及Kinova Gen3机械臂搭配Openhand Model O夹爪的手指力传感。
papers.key_results: 实验表明该方法实现了鲁棒的多模态分割、准确的力感知复现，并展示了跨平台通用性。
papers.why_it_matters: 该方法解决了LfD中忽略力交互的关键问题，通过一次性示范学习力包含的技能，提高了操作的安全性和鲁棒性，且具有跨平台通用性，对机器人操作和具身智能研究具有重要意义。

papers.title: TouchWorld: A Predictive and Reactive Tactile Foundation Model for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Dexterous manipulation in everyday environments requires both anticipation and reaction: a robot must predict how contact should evolve while rapidly correcting local errors caused by slip, misalignment, unstable grasping, or force mismatch. Vision and language provide semantic and geometric guidance, but they cannot reliably reveal hidden contact states such as force, slip, and contact stability. Although tactile sensing exposes these physical cues, most existing policies treat touch as a low-frequency observation stream within a monolithic action model, coupling slow task reasoning, action generation, and fast contact feedback in a single loop. We introduce TouchWorld, a predictive-and-reactive tactile foundation model for dexterous manipulation. TouchWorld uses a hierarchical policy that separates vision-language subtask planning, tactile world-model prediction, visuo-tactile goal-conditioned action generation, and high-frequency tactile residual refinement. A High-Level Planning Layer produces executable subtasks and predicts tactile subgoals; a Visuo-Tactile Goal-Conditioned Policy generates nominal action chunks; and a Tactile-Conditioned Refinement Policy performs online residual correction using recent tactile and proprioceptive feedback. By using touch as both a predictive contact reference and a fast feedback signal, TouchWorld preserves the semantic generalization of vision-language-action policies while improving local contact adaptation. Across six long-horizon and contact-rich dexterous manipulation tasks, TouchWorld achieves 65.0% success in the clean setting and 53.7% success under human perturbations, outperforming the strongest baseline by 15.7 and 18.5 percentage points, respectively.
core_contributions: 提出了TouchWorld，一个预测和反应触觉基础模型，用于灵巧操作。
设计了分层策略，分离视觉-语言子任务规划、触觉世界模型预测、视觉-触觉目标条件动作生成和高频触觉残差细化。
将触觉同时作为预测性接触参考和快速反馈信号，保留了语义泛化并改进了局部接触适应。
在六个长时域和接触丰富的灵巧操作任务中，TouchWorld在干净和扰动设置下均显著优于最强基线。
papers.abstract_zh: 日常环境中的灵巧操作需要预测和反应：机器人必须预测接触如何演变，同时快速纠正由滑动、错位、抓取不稳定或力不匹配引起的局部错误。视觉和语言提供语义和几何指导，但它们无法可靠地揭示隐藏的接触状态，如力、滑动和接触稳定性。尽管触觉感知暴露了这些物理线索，但大多数现有策略将触觉视为单一动作模型中的低频观测流，将慢速任务推理、动作生成和快速接触反馈耦合在单个循环中。我们介绍了TouchWorld，一个用于灵巧操作的预测和反应触觉基础模型。TouchWorld使用分层策略，分离视觉-语言子任务规划、触觉世界模型预测、视觉-触觉目标条件动作生成和高频触觉残差细化。高层规划层产生可执行子任务并预测触觉子目标；视觉-触觉目标条件策略生成名义动作块；触觉条件细化策略使用最近的触觉和本体感觉反馈进行在线残差校正。通过将触觉作为预测性接触参考和快速反馈信号，TouchWorld保留了视觉-语言-动作策略的语义泛化，同时改进了局部接触适应。在六个长时域和接触丰富的灵巧操作任务中，TouchWorld在干净设置下达到65.0%的成功率，在人为扰动下达到53.7%，分别比最强基线高出15.7和18.5个百分点。
papers.summary_one_sentence: TouchWorld是一个用于灵巧操作的预测和反应触觉基础模型，通过分层策略分离视觉-语言规划、触觉预测和动作生成，并利用触觉反馈进行高频残差校正，在接触丰富的任务中显著优于基线。
papers.research_problem: 现有灵巧操作策略将触觉作为低频观测流，耦合了任务推理、动作生成和接触反馈，导致局部接触适应不足，无法有效利用触觉的预测和反应能力。

papers.title: Deform360: A Massive Multi-view Visuotactile Dataset for Deformable World Models
papers.abstract: Predicting object dynamics (i.e., world modeling) is a fundamental challenge for robotic manipulation, and modeling deformable objects presents a particularly difficult case due to their high-dimensional state spaces and complex material properties. While current world models approach this through two distinct paradigms: learning the dynamics over the 2D pixel space or more explicit 3D geometric space. A systematic understanding of their relative strengths and limitations remains elusive due to the lack of diverse, large-scale real-world data. To address this, we present Deform360, a large-scale visuotactile dataset featuring 198 daily-life objects, 1,980 interaction sequences, and over 215 hours of observations from 41 surround-view cameras and bimanual tactile grippers to capture both global motion and contact-induced local deformations. Leveraging a novel markerless visuotactile 3D tracking pipeline to extract dense geometry and motion, we systematically evaluate current state-of-the-art world models, comparing 2D video models against 3D particle models. Finally, we provide a preliminary demonstration indicating the real-world applicability of our dataset by performing robot planning tasks on deformable objects. Our analysis reveals key insights into the trade-offs between structural priors and scalability, providing a solid benchmark for future research in generalizable deformable object-centric world modeling. Project website: https://deform360.lhy.xyz
core_contributions: 提出了Deform360，一个大规模多视角视觉触觉数据集，包含198个日常物体、1,980个交互序列和超过215小时的观测数据，来自41个环绕相机和双手触觉夹爪。
开发了一种新颖的无标记视觉触觉3D跟踪管道，用于提取密集几何和运动信息。
系统评估了当前最先进的2D视频模型和3D粒子模型在可变形物体动力学预测中的表现，揭示了结构先验和可扩展性之间的权衡。
通过机器人规划任务初步展示了数据集在现实世界中的适用性，为可泛化的可变形物体世界建模提供了基准。
papers.abstract_zh: 预测物体动力学（即世界建模）是机器人操作的基本挑战，而由于可变形物体具有高维状态空间和复杂的材料属性，对其进行建模尤其困难。当前的世界模型主要通过两种不同的范式来解决这一问题：在2D像素空间上学习动力学，或在更显式的3D几何空间上学习。由于缺乏多样化的大规模真实世界数据，对它们相对优势和局限性的系统理解仍然难以实现。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Deform360，一个大规模视觉触觉数据集，包含198个日常物体、1,980个交互序列以及超过215小时的观测数据，来自41个环绕相机和双手触觉夹爪，以捕捉全局运动和接触引起的局部变形。利用一种新颖的无标记视觉触觉3D跟踪管道来提取密集几何和运动，我们系统地评估了当前最先进的世界模型，比较了2D视频模型和3D粒子模型。最后，我们通过执行可变形物体上的机器人规划任务，初步展示了数据集在现实世界中的适用性。我们的分析揭示了结构先验和可扩展性之间的权衡，为未来可泛化的以可变形物体为中心的世界建模研究提供了坚实的基准。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出了Deform360大规模多视角视觉触觉数据集，系统评估了2D和3D世界模型在可变形物体动力学预测中的表现，并揭示了结构先验与可扩展性之间的权衡。
papers.research_problem: 可变形物体的动力学预测（世界建模）因高维状态空间和复杂材料属性而困难，且缺乏大规模真实世界数据来系统比较2D像素空间和3D几何空间两种世界模型范式的优劣。
papers.method_summary: 构建了大规模多视角视觉触觉数据集，利用无标记视觉触觉3D跟踪管道从多视角视频和触觉数据中提取密集几何和运动信息，并基于此系统评估了2D视频模型和3D粒子模型在可变形物体动力学预测中的表现。

papers.title: High-Fidelity One-Step Generative Visuomotor Policy via Recursive Correction, Frequency Consistency, and Contrastive Flow Matching
papers.abstract: Generative models such as diffusion and flow matching have advanced robotic visuomotor policies by modeling multimodal action distributions, but their multi-step sampling or ODE solving introduces inference latency. Existing one-step acceleration methods often compress the whole generation process into a single large update, leading to spatial deviation, frequency distortion, and mode averaging. This paper proposes a high-fidelity one-step generative visuomotor policy framework that addresses these issues with three complementary mechanisms. Recursive Consistent Action Flow (RCAF) uses recursive correction to compensate for spatial truncation errors and align one-step predictions with refined flow trajectories. Dual-Timestep Frequency Consistency (DTFC) preserves high-frequency manipulation details through adaptive spectral consistency across flow timesteps. Contrastive Flow Matching (CFM) separates entangled action flows with a margin-based repulsive objective, reducing ambiguous actions in multimodal manipulation. Experiments on RoboTwin, RoboTwin 2.0, Adroit, DexArt, and real-world robot platforms show that the proposed method achieves competitive or superior performance compared with strong 10-step generative policy baselines while requiring only one forward pass (1 NFE), enabling low-latency visuomotor control.
core_contributions: 提出递归一致动作流（RCAF），通过递归校正补偿空间截断误差，使一步预测与精细流轨迹对齐。
提出双时间步频率一致性（DTFC），通过跨流时间步的自适应频谱一致性保留高频操作细节。
提出对比流匹配（CFM），通过基于边界的排斥目标分离纠缠的动作流，减少多模态操作中的模糊动作。
实现一步生成式策略，在仅需一次前向传播（1 NFE）的情况下达到与10步生成策略基线竞争或更优的性能。
papers.abstract_zh: 生成模型如扩散和流匹配通过建模多模态动作分布推动了机器人视觉运动策略的发展，但其多步采样或ODE求解引入了推理延迟。现有的一步加速方法通常将整个生成过程压缩为单次大更新，导致空间偏差、频率失真和模式平均。本文提出了一种高保真一步生成式视觉运动策略框架，通过三种互补机制解决这些问题。递归一致动作流（RCAF）使用递归校正补偿空间截断误差，使一步预测与精细流轨迹对齐。双时间步频率一致性（DTFC）通过跨流时间步的自适应频谱一致性保留高频操作细节。对比流匹配（CFM）通过基于边界的排斥目标分离纠缠的动作流，减少多模态操作中的模糊动作。在RoboTwin、RoboTwin 2.0、Adroit、DexArt和真实机器人平台上的实验表明，所提方法在仅需一次前向传播（1 NFE）的情况下，与强大的10步生成策略基线相比取得了竞争性或更优的性能，实现了低延迟视觉运动控制。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出一种高保真一步生成式视觉运动策略，通过递归校正、频率一致性和对比流匹配实现低延迟高性能的机器人操作。
papers.research_problem: 现有一步加速生成式视觉运动策略存在空间偏差、频率失真和模式平均问题，导致生成质量下降，无法兼顾低延迟和高保真。
papers.method_summary: 该方法包含三个互补机制：RCAF通过递归校正补偿一步预测的空间截断误差；DTFC通过跨时间步的频谱一致性保留高频细节；CFM通过基于边界的排斥损失分离动作流，减少模式平均。三者结合实现高保真一步生成。
papers.experimental_setup: 在RoboTwin、RoboTwin 2.0、Adroit、DexArt仿真环境和真实机器人平台上进行评估，与10步生成策略基线对比。

papers.title: Imagining the Sense of Touch: Touch-Informed Manipulation via Imagined Tactile Representations
papers.abstract: Tactile sensing can substantially improve contact-rich robotic manipulation, yet its practical deployment remains limited by the fragility, calibration requirements, and maintenance burden of tactile hardware. This raises a fundamental question: can robots benefit from tactile knowledge without requiring tactile sensors at deployment? We present TacImag, a tactile imagination framework that predicts tactile observations from vision and proprioception and uses the generated signals to guide manipulation policies. Trained from paired visuotactile demonstrations, TacImag enables touch-informed manipulation using only visual observations at test time. We evaluate TacImag on six simulated and four real-world manipulation tasks. Across simulation and real-world experiments, imagined tactile observations consistently improve manipulation performance without requiring tactile hardware. In real-world experiments, imagined force fields improve contact-sensitive tasks by 44.4% on average, whereas imagined tactile images improve texture-sensitive tasks by 23.3%, revealing that the effectiveness of tactile imagination depends strongly on the relationship between tactile representation and task requirements. Our results further suggest that tactile imagination does not simply recover missing tactile measurements. Instead, it acts as a form of contact-aware supervision that transforms subtle visual interaction cues into representations that are easier for manipulation policies to exploit.
core_contributions: 提出TacImag，一种触觉想象框架，从视觉和本体感觉预测触觉观测并用于指导操作策略。
通过成对的视觉-触觉演示训练，实现测试时仅用视觉的触觉感知操作。
在六个模拟和四个真实世界任务上验证了想象触觉观测的有效性。
揭示了触觉想象的有效性依赖于触觉表示与任务需求的关系。
发现触觉想象作为接触感知监督，而非简单恢复缺失测量。

papers.title: VLA-Corrector: Lightweight Detect-and-Correct Inference for Adaptive Action Horizon
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models have recently achieved strong progress in embodied intelligence. To reduce policy-call frequency while preserving temporal coherence, most generative policies adopt an action chunk mechanism, executing multiple future actions in an open-loop manner under a fixed action horizon. However, this "predict-then-blindly-execute" paradigm sacrifices closed-loop reactivity: in contact-rich physical interactions, even small local perturbations can rapidly amplify within the open-loop blind spot, leading to compounding errors and ultimately task failure. To address this limitation, we propose VLA-Corrector, a lightweight corrective inference framework for action-chunked VLA policies. Without modifying the backbone policy weights, VLA-Corrector introduces a lightweight Latent-space Vision Monitor (LVM) that continuously compares predicted and actual visual feature evolution, enabling online detection of visual dynamics deviations. Once persistent deviation is detected, the system triggers a truncation event, discards the remaining stale actions, and invokes corrective replanning via Online Gradient Guidance (OGG). The detect-and-correct mechanism of VLA-Corrector naturally induces an event-triggered adaptive action horizon: it preserves long-horizon execution when the current chunk remains reliable, and invokes short-horizon corrective replanning when execution begins to drift. In doing so, VLA-Corrector mitigates the trade-off imposed by static horizons between execution robustness and policy-call frequency. It can be integrated into different VLA models without further retraining the VLA backbone, interrupting compounding errors while preserving much of the efficiency benefit of action chunking and substantially improving robustness in long-horizon, contact-rich robotic manipulation tasks.
core_contributions: 提出VLA-Corrector轻量级校正推理框架，无需修改VLA骨干权重即可集成。
引入潜在空间视觉监控器（LVM）在线比较预测与实际视觉特征演变，检测视觉动态偏差。
设计在线梯度引导（OGG）机制，在检测到持续偏差时触发截断并校正重新规划。
实现事件触发的自适应动作视界，缓解静态视界在鲁棒性与策略调用频率之间的权衡。
在长视界、接触丰富的机器人操作任务中显著提升鲁棒性，同时保留动作块的效率优势。
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基础模型最近在具身智能方面取得了显著进展。为了降低策略调用频率同时保持时间连贯性，大多数生成式策略采用动作块机制，在固定动作视界下以开环方式执行多个未来动作。然而，这种“预测然后盲目执行”的范式牺牲了闭环反应性：在接触丰富的物理交互中，即使是小的局部扰动也会在开环盲点内迅速放大，导致复合误差并最终任务失败。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了VLA-Corrector，一个用于动作块VLA策略的轻量级校正推理框架。在不修改骨干策略权重的情况下，VLA-Corrector引入了一个轻量级的潜在空间视觉监控器（LVM），持续比较预测和实际视觉特征演变，实现视觉动态偏差的在线检测。一旦检测到持续偏差，系统触发截断事件，丢弃剩余的过时动作，并通过在线梯度引导（OGG）调用校正性重新规划。VLA-Corrector的检测-校正机制自然产生了一个事件触发的自适应动作视界：当当前块仍然可靠时保持长视界执行，当执行开始漂移时调用短视界校正性重新规划。这样，VLA-Corrector缓解了静态视界在执行鲁棒性和策略调用频率之间的权衡。它可以集成到不同的VLA模型中而无需进一步重新训练VLA骨干，中断复合误差同时保留动作块的大部分效率优势，并显著提高长视界、接触丰富的机器人操作任务的鲁棒性。

papers.title: UniTacVLA: Unified Tactile Understanding and Prediction in Vision Language Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong performance in many robotic manipulation tasks, yet remain limited in contact-rich dexterous manipulation. To overcome this limitation, recent vision-tactile-language-action (VTLA) methods incorporate tactile sensing into VLA models to provide direct contact information. However, they typically treat tactile signals as passive auxiliary inputs, making it difficult to model tactile semantics and future physical interactions. To this end, we propose a unified tactile learning framework for contact-rich manipulation that models tactile signals as dynamic interaction cues for both contact understanding and prediction. Specifically, we construct a unified tactile latent space and jointly model current tactile states and future contact changes through tactile chain-of-thought reasoning and coarse-to-fine future tactile prediction, thereby forming a state-aware and dynamics-aware tactile prior. Based on this prior, we introduce a tactile-action mixed controller that combines real-time and predicted tactile feedback to refine low-frequency action chunks with high-frequency corrections. Real-world experiments on four categories of contact-rich tasks, including adjustment, insertion, wiping, and assembly, under both clean and externally perturbed settings, show that our method improves success rate, manipulation accuracy, and contact robustness over existing methods, demonstrating its effectiveness in dexterous physical interaction.

提出了触觉-动作混合控制器，结合实时和预测触觉反馈，用高频修正细化低频动作块。
在四类接触丰富任务（调整、插入、擦拭、组装）上验证了有效性，在成功率和鲁棒性上优于现有方法。

papers.title: Support-Constrained RL Enables Real-World Policy Improvement without Real-World Experience
papers.abstract: Robots trained on real world data tend to be imprecise, slow, and brittle to perturbations. Improving these policies with reinforcement learning (RL) is an appealing alternative, but this process often requires expensive training in the real world. Performing policy improvement in simulation instead provides a far cheaper alternative, but unconstrained RL in simulation can exploit contact and dynamics mismatches, resulting in unsafe behaviors that do not transfer to hardware. Common forms of regularization can furthermore limit improvement by overconstraining to an imperfect behavior prior. In this work, we propose Support-Constrained Off-Domain REinforcement (SCORE), a real-to-sim-to-real framework that constrains RL in simulation to the support of a generative policy pretrained on real data. We instantiate this constraint through flow steering, restricting SCORE to actions the base policy can already produce, which ensures transferable behaviors while maximizing policy improvement. Improving a policy with SCORE requires minimal effort: it learns from sparse rewards, avoids distillation, and leaves the base policy untouched. Across eight real-world dexterous multi-fingered robotic manipulation tasks, SCORE improves average success rate from 37.8% to 89.9%, compared to 59.5% for the best baseline, and reaches success in 36.8% fewer steps than the base policy. Ultimately, through extensive experiments and ablations, we show that simulation can substantially improve real-world manipulation policies when policy optimization is appropriately constrained, introducing a new paradigm for real-to-sim-to-real policy improvement. Videos and code are available at https://weirdlabuw.github.io/score/.
core_contributions: 提出SCORE框架，一种real-to-sim-to-real框架，将仿真中的RL约束到真实数据预训练生成策略的支持域，确保可迁移的行为。
通过流引导（flow steering）实例化约束，限制动作空间到基础策略可产生的动作，最大化策略改进同时保证迁移性。
在8个真实世界灵巧多指机器人操作任务上，平均成功率从37.8%提升至89.9%，优于最佳基线（59.5%），且成功步骤减少36.8%。
引入了一种新的real-to-sim-to-real策略改进范式，表明适当约束的仿真优化可以显著改进真实世界策略。
papers.abstract_zh: 在真实世界数据上训练的机器人往往不精确、缓慢且对扰动脆弱。使用强化学习（RL）改进这些策略是一个有吸引力的替代方案，但这个过程通常需要在真实世界中进行昂贵的训练。在仿真中进行策略改进则提供了一个更便宜的替代方案，但仿真中无约束的RL可能利用接触和动力学不匹配，导致不安全的行为，无法迁移到硬件。常见的正则化形式可能通过过度约束到不完美的行为先验而限制改进。在这项工作中，我们提出了支持约束的域外强化学习（SCORE），一个真实-仿真-真实框架，它将仿真中的RL约束到基于真实数据预训练的生成策略的支持域。我们通过流引导实例化这个约束，将SCORE限制为基础策略已经能够产生的动作，这确保了可迁移的行为同时最大化策略改进。使用SCORE改进策略需要最小的努力：它从稀疏奖励中学习，避免蒸馏，并且不修改基础策略。在八个真实世界灵巧多指机器人操作任务中，SCORE将平均成功率从37.8%提高到89.9%，而最佳基线为59.5%，并且比基础策略少用36.8%的步骤达到成功。最终，通过广泛的实验和消融，我们表明当策略优化被适当约束时，仿真可以显著改进真实世界的操作策略，引入了一个新的真实-仿真-真实策略改进范式。视频和代码可在https://weirdlabuw.github.io/score/获取。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出SCORE框架，通过约束仿真中的强化学习到真实数据预训练策略的支持域，实现无需真实世界经验的策略改进，在灵巧操作任务上显著提升成功率。
papers.research_problem: 如何在不进行昂贵真实世界训练的情况下，利用仿真强化学习安全有效地改进基于真实数据训练的机器人操作策略，避免因接触和动力学不匹配导致的不迁移行为。
papers.method_summary: SCORE框架首先在真实数据上预训练一个生成策略作为基础策略，然后在仿真环境中进行强化学习，但通过流引导将RL动作约束到基础策略的支持域内，即只允许采取基础策略能够产生的动作，从而避免利用仿真中的接触和动力学不匹配，确保学到的行为可以迁移到真实硬件。该方法从稀疏奖励学习，无需蒸馏，且不修改基础策略。

papers.key_results: SCORE将平均成功率从基础策略的37.8%提升至89.9%，最佳基线为59.5%；同时达到成功所需的步骤比基础策略减少36.8%。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作提出了一种无需真实世界经验即可显著改进真实世界操作策略的方法，通过约束仿真RL避免了昂贵训练和不安全迁移，为机器人操作策略改进提供了高效、安全的新范式，尤其适用于灵巧操作等接触丰富的任务。

papers.title: HT-Bench: Benchmarking and Learning Dexterous Full-Hand Tactile Representations with Egocentric Vision
papers.abstract: Establishing a universal benchmark for tactile representation learning in robotic manipulation remains challenging due to the diversity of tactile sensor designs, data formats, and robot embodiments. Rather than seeking to establish such, we explore a scalable and promising direction for future development: egocentric vision paired with full-hand tactile data. To this end, we introduce \textbf{HT-Bench}, a large-scale multi-task benchmark for dexterous full-hand tactile sensing, comprising 10M RGB frames and 7.8M tactile frames collected across 226 tasks. HT-Bench evaluates tactile representations from three key perspectives: whether they encode meaningful contact geometry, whether they can align tactile observations with visual information, and whether they generalize to unseen tasks. To assess these capabilities, HT-Bench includes four tasks: fine-grained tactile similarity retrieval, masked tactile inpainting, vision-to-tactile synthesis, and multimodal tactile frame prediction. We further propose \textbf{HandTouch}, a vector-quantized vision--tactile encoder that learns tactile representations through progressive spatial, cross-modal, and temporal training. Across HT-Bench, HandTouch consistently outperforms representative tactile encoder baselines, improving Recall@5 on fine-grained tactile similarity retrieval from 74.65\% to 85.23\%, reducing RMSE on masked tactile inpainting from 0.022 to 0.010, and increasing OOD cIoU on vision-to-tactile synthesis from 0.628 to 0.705. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of HandTouch and suggest that large-scale egocentric full-hand tactile data provides a scalable basis for evaluating and advancing tactile representation learning in dexterous manipulation.
core_contributions: 提出了HT-Bench，一个大规模多任务基准，包含10M RGB帧和7.8M触觉帧，覆盖226个任务，用于评估灵巧全手触觉表示。
提出了HandTouch，一个矢量量化的视觉-触觉编码器，通过渐进的空间、跨模态和时间训练学习触觉表示。
在HT-Bench上，HandTouch在细粒度触觉相似性检索、掩码触觉修复和视觉到触觉合成任务上显著优于基线。
papers.abstract_zh: 建立机器人操作中触觉表示学习的通用基准仍然具有挑战性，因为触觉传感器设计、数据格式和机器人具身的多样性。与其寻求建立这样的基准，我们探索了一个可扩展且有前景的未来发展方向：以自我为中心的视觉与全手触觉数据配对。为此，我们引入了HT-Bench，一个大规模多任务基准，用于灵巧全手触觉感知，包含226个任务中收集的1000万RGB帧和780万触觉帧。HT-Bench从三个关键角度评估触觉表示：它们是否编码有意义的接触几何，它们是否能够将触觉观察与视觉信息对齐，以及它们是否泛化到未见任务。为了评估这些能力，HT-Bench包括四个任务：细粒度触觉相似性检索、掩码触觉修复、视觉到触觉合成和多模态触觉帧预测。我们进一步提出了HandTouch，一个矢量量化的视觉-触觉编码器，通过渐进的空间、跨模态和时间训练来学习触觉表示。在HT-Bench上，HandTouch始终优于代表性的触觉编码器基线，在细粒度触觉相似性检索上将Recall@5从74.65%提高到85.23%，在掩码触觉修复上将RMSE从0.022降低到0.010，在视觉到触觉合成上将OOD cIoU从0.628提高到0.705。这些结果证明了HandTouch的有效性，并表明大规模以自我为中心的全手触觉数据为评估和推进灵巧操作中的触觉表示学习提供了可扩展的基础。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 本文提出了HT-Bench基准和HandTouch编码器，用于灵巧全手触觉表示学习，通过大规模自我中心视觉-触觉数据评估和推进触觉表示。

papers.title: ContactWorld: What Matters in Vision-Tactile World Models for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires world models to reason over complex contact dynamics from multimodal sensory observations. However, it remains unclear which representation properties fundamentally support stable long-horizon planning in contact-rich settings. In this paper, we present ContactWorld, a benchmark and systematic empirical study of vision-tactile world models spanning 12 contact-rich manipulation tasks, including insertion, disassembly, screwing, and exploratory interaction. Across extensive experiments, we find that representations that are both spatially structured and temporally continuous consistently achieve the strongest planning performance. In particular, point-cloud observations improve average planning success rates from 20.7% with wrist-view observations and 22.0% with front-view observations to 32.1%. We further find that the effectiveness of tactile sensing depends critically on cross-modal representation compatibility rather than modality scaling alone. Combining point-cloud observations with tactile force-field representations, which preserve richer spatial structure and interaction dynamics, further improves performance to 36.1%, yielding the strongest overall planning performance across all evaluated tasks. Moreover, tactile sensing becomes increasingly important under long-horizon planning objectives, where compounding prediction errors and contact uncertainty accumulate over time. Together, these findings highlight the importance of representation structure, multimodal compatibility, and long-horizon robustness in vision-tactile world models for contact-rich robotic manipulation.
core_contributions: 提出了ContactWorld基准，包含12个接触丰富操作任务，用于系统评估视觉-触觉世界模型。
通过大量实验发现，空间结构化和时间连续的表示（如点云）能显著提高规划性能。
揭示了触觉传感的有效性关键取决于跨模态表示兼容性，而非仅模态缩放。
发现触觉传感在长时程规划目标下变得越来越重要。
提供了关于表示结构、多模态兼容性和长时程鲁棒性的重要见解。
papers.abstract_zh: 接触丰富操作需要世界模型从多模态感官观测中推理复杂的接触动力学。然而，目前尚不清楚哪些表示属性从根本上支持接触丰富环境中的稳定长时程规划。在本文中，我们提出了ContactWorld，一个涵盖12个接触丰富操作任务（包括插入、拆卸、拧螺丝和探索性交互）的基准和系统实证研究。通过大量实验，我们发现空间结构化和时间连续的表示始终能实现最强的规划性能。特别是，点云观测将平均规划成功率从腕部视图的20.7%和前视图的22.0%提高到32.1%。我们进一步发现，触觉传感的有效性关键取决于跨模态表示兼容性，而非仅模态缩放。将点云观测与触觉力场表示（保留了更丰富的空间结构和交互动力学）相结合，进一步将性能提高到36.1%，在所有评估任务中产生最强的整体规划性能。此外，触觉传感在长时程规划目标下变得越来越重要，因为复合预测误差和接触不确定性随时间累积。这些发现共同强调了表示结构、多模态兼容性和长时程鲁棒性在接触丰富机器人操作的视觉-触觉世界模型中的重要性。
papers.summary_one_sentence: ContactWorld通过系统实验发现，空间结构化和时间连续的表示以及跨模态兼容性对于接触丰富操作中的视觉-触觉世界模型至关重要。
papers.research_problem: 在接触丰富操作中，哪些表示属性（如空间结构、时间连续性、多模态兼容性）从根本上支持稳定的长时程规划？

papers.experimental_setup: 在12个接触丰富操作任务上进行了实验，包括插入、拆卸、拧螺丝和探索性交互。比较了腕部视图、前视图、点云观测以及触觉力场表示，评估了不同表示和模态组合下的规划成功率。
papers.key_results: 点云观测将平均规划成功率从腕部视图的20.7%和前视图的22.0%提高到32.1%；点云与触觉力场结合进一步将性能提高到36.1%，在所有任务中表现最强；触觉传感在长时程规划中重要性增加。
papers.why_it_matters: 该研究系统揭示了视觉-触觉世界模型中表示属性（空间结构、时间连续性、多模态兼容性）对接触丰富操作规划性能的影响，为设计更有效的多模态感知和规划系统提供了重要指导，有助于推动机器人操作在复杂接触任务中的应用。

papers.title: TacCoRL: Integrating Tactile Feedback into VLA via Simulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide strong visual, language, and action priors for robot manipulation, but visual observations alone often miss the local contact state required for contact-rich tasks. We present TacCoRL, a scalable framework that injects Tactile feedback into VLA policies and improves them through sim-real Co-training and simulation-based reinforcement learning (RL), without requiring large-scale tactile pretraining or extensive real-world contact exploration. The key idea is not only adding touch as an input, but learning how contact readings should modulate action responses in near-failure states that are rare in demonstrations and risky to collect on hardware. We use a real-aligned simulator as a closed-loop training environment for contact interaction. Mixed simulated and real trajectories first warm-start tactile-conditioned actions in the pretrained policy. Reinforcement learning with verifiable task rewards then optimizes the policy using simulated contact rollouts. It reinforces tactile-conditioned actions that lead to task completion, while a supervised objective on real trajectories keeps the refined policy anchored to deployment visual, tactile, and action distributions. The resulting policy transfers directly to the real robot without privileged simulation state or online real-world RL. Across four bimanual contact-rich tasks, the final visuo-tactile policy achieves an average success rate of 72.5%, compared to baseline of 50.0%. Result videos and more details are available at https://tac-corl.github.io/
core_contributions: 提出TacCoRL框架，将触觉反馈注入VLA策略，无需大规模触觉预训练或大量真实接触探索。
采用仿真-真实协同训练和基于仿真的强化学习，利用真实对齐模拟器进行闭环接触交互训练。
在四个双臂接触密集型任务上实现平均72.5%的成功率，相比基线50.0%有显著提升。
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为机器人操作提供了强大的视觉、语言和动作先验，但仅凭视觉观察往往缺失接触密集型任务所需的局部接触状态。我们提出TacCoRL，一个可扩展的框架，将触觉反馈注入VLA策略，并通过仿真-真实协同训练和基于仿真的强化学习（RL）进行改进，无需大规模触觉预训练或大量真实接触探索。关键思想不仅是将触觉作为输入添加，而是学习在演示中罕见且在硬件上收集有风险的近失败状态下，接触读数应如何调节动作响应。我们使用真实对齐的模拟器作为接触交互的闭环训练环境。混合的仿真和真实轨迹首先在预训练策略中预热触觉条件动作。然后，使用可验证任务奖励的强化学习通过仿真接触轨迹优化策略。它强化导致任务完成的触觉条件动作，同时真实轨迹上的监督目标使优化后的策略锚定到部署时的视觉、触觉和动作分布。最终策略直接迁移到真实机器人，无需特权仿真状态或在线真实世界RL。在四个双臂接触密集型任务上，最终的视觉-触觉策略平均成功率达到72.5%，而基线为50.0%。结果视频和更多细节见https://tac-corl.github.io/
papers.summary_one_sentence: TacCoRL通过仿真-真实协同训练和强化学习将触觉反馈注入VLA策略，在无需大规模触觉预训练的情况下显著提升了接触密集型任务的成功率。

papers.title: UniIntervene: Agentic Intervention for Efficient Real-World Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning (HiL-RL) has emerged as an effective paradigm for real-world robotic manipulation, enabling online policy improvement with human guidance. However, current HiL-RL frameworks remain intervention-intensive, relying on frequent human corrections to redirect the policy out of unproductive exploration, which incurs high labor cost and limits real-world scalability. To address this, we propose UniIntervene, an agentic intervention model that detects unproductive exploration and autonomously recovers the policy toward high-value states, taking over the bulk of interventions from human operators. Specifically, UniIntervene first performs future-conditioned action-value estimation, predicting the latent consequence of the current action and evaluating its induced value, which provides a more stable progress signal. Building on this, a temporal value-risk critic aggregates recent value dynamics and triggers intervention when the estimated value exhibits sustained stagnation or degradation. When intervention is required, UniIntervene retrieves a high-value recovery target from a memory of past intervention episodes and produces executable corrective actions through a goal-conditioned recovery policy. In this way, UniIntervene turns intervention from passive human correction into a value-aware recovery process for efficient real-world RL. Extensive experiments on diverse real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that UniIntervene improves the average success rate by 8.6% while reducing human interventions by 57% relative to state-of-the-art HiL-RL baselines.
core_contributions: 提出了UniIntervene，一种自主干预模型，能够检测无效探索并自动恢复策略。
设计了未来条件动作价值估计，提供更稳定的进展信号。
引入了时间价值风险批评者，基于价值动态触发干预。
利用记忆检索和目标条件恢复策略生成纠正动作。
在真实世界操作任务上实现了成功率提升和干预减少。
papers.abstract_zh: 人在回路强化学习（HiL-RL）已成为真实世界机器人操作的有效范式，能够通过人类指导实现在线策略改进。然而，当前的HiL-RL框架仍然需要大量干预，依赖频繁的人类纠正来引导策略脱离无效探索，这导致高昂的人力成本并限制了真实世界的可扩展性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了UniIntervene，一种代理干预模型，能够检测无效探索并自主将策略恢复到高价值状态，从而接管人类操作员的大部分干预工作。具体来说，UniIntervene首先执行未来条件动作价值估计，预测当前动作的潜在后果并评估其诱导价值，从而提供更稳定的进展信号。在此基础上，一个时间价值风险批评者聚合最近的价值动态，并在估计价值出现持续停滞或下降时触发干预。当需要干预时，UniIntervene从过去干预事件的内存中检索高价值恢复目标，并通过目标条件恢复策略生成可执行的纠正动作。通过这种方式，UniIntervene将干预从被动的人类纠正转变为价值感知的恢复过程，以实现高效的真实世界强化学习。在多种真实世界操作任务上的大量实验表明，与最先进的HiL-RL基线相比，UniIntervene将平均成功率提高了8.6%，同时将人类干预减少了57%。

papers.title: Blind Dexterous Grasping via Real2Sim2Real Tactile Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Blind grasping with a dexterous hand is a crucial manipulation capability. Nevertheless, learning such tactile-only policies for real robots remains challenging due to the tactile sim-to-real gap and the limited expressiveness of sparse tactile signals. To bridge this gap, we propose a framework for tactile-only blind grasping that is deployable on a physical multi-fingered robotic hand. Our approach combines three key components. First, we introduce a Real2Sim tactile calibration pipeline that constructs a contact-calibrated digital-twin simulator capable of reproducing real tactile signals. Second, we improve the expressiveness of sparse tactile observations using a layout-aware tactile encoder, which incorporates sensor-geometry priors through self-supervised pretraining. Third, to improve generalization to unseen objects, we train object-specific reinforcement-learning experts in the calibrated simulator and aggregate their successful grasp trajectories into a tactile-conditioned Diffusion Policy. We evaluate our method on a physical LEAP Hand equipped with distributed tactile sensing across 10 seen and 10 unseen objects. The deployed policy achieves a 27\% real-world grasp success rate across all 20 objects, without real-world grasping demonstrations or visual input. Simulation ablations show that layout-aware tactile pretraining improves grasping performance, while sensing-level evaluations confirm that Real2Sim calibration increases the consistency of tactile contact events between simulation and hardware. Together, these results suggest that contact-event calibration, geometry-aware tactile representation learning, and diffusion-based policy aggregation provide an effective path toward tactile-only blind grasping on real dexterous robotic hands. Project page:Dex-Blind-Grasp.github.io.

papers.abstract_zh: 用灵巧手进行盲抓是一项关键的操作能力。然而，由于触觉的仿真到现实差距以及稀疏触觉信号的有限表达能力，在真实机器人上学习这种仅触觉的策略仍然具有挑战性。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了一个仅触觉盲抓框架，可部署在物理多指机器人手上。我们的方法结合了三个关键组件。首先，我们引入了一个Real2Sim触觉校准流水线，构建了一个接触校准的数字孪生模拟器，能够再现真实的触觉信号。其次，我们使用布局感知的触觉编码器提高了稀疏触觉观测的表达能力，该编码器通过自监督预训练融入了传感器几何先验。第三，为了提高对未见物体的泛化能力，我们在校准的模拟器中训练特定物体的强化学习专家，并将其成功的抓取轨迹聚合到触觉条件扩散策略中。我们在配备分布式触觉传感的物理LEAP手上评估了我们的方法，涉及10个见过和10个未见过的物体。部署的策略在所有20个物体上实现了27%的真实世界抓取成功率，无需真实世界的抓取演示或视觉输入。模拟消融实验表明，布局感知的触觉预训练提高了抓取性能，而传感级评估证实Real2Sim校准增加了模拟和硬件之间触觉接触事件的一致性。总之，这些结果表明，接触事件校准、几何感知的触觉表示学习和基于扩散的策略聚合为在真实灵巧手上实现仅触觉盲抓提供了一条有效路径。

papers.title: TacForeSight: Force-Guided Tactile World Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires robots to continuously perceive and regulate evolving physical interactions under dynamic contact transitions or complex surface geometries. Recent imitation learning methods improve contact-aware control by incorporating tactile or force feedback, but they rarely model the asymmetric spatiotemporal roles of global force and local tactile sensing. To address this, we propose TacForeSight, a lightweight force-conditioned tactile foresight framework for real-time manipulation. The core component is TacForceWM, a tactile world model that predicts short-horizon tactile latent dynamics from dual-finger tactile observations conditioned on high-frequency wrist force and torque signals. Another key component, the Predictive Tactile-Conditioned Policy, leverages the predicted latents as anticipatory contact priors, models the current-to-future tactile evolution via cross-attention, and adaptively fuses visuo-tactile features through a tactile-guided gating module. By forecasting purely within a compact latent space, TacForeSight enables proactive contact reasoning with efficient real-time inference suitable for high-frequency manipulation control. Real-robot experiments on five representative tasks and three in-process perturbation settings show that TacForeSight consistently outperforms existing baselines, particularly under dynamic contact disturbances. All models and datasets will be made publicly available on the project website at https://tacforesight.github.io/ProjectPage.
core_contributions: 提出TacForeSight，一个轻量级的力条件触觉预见框架，用于实时接触丰富操作。
设计TacForceWM，一个触觉世界模型，从双指触觉观测预测短时触觉潜在动力学，以高频腕部力和扭矩为条件。
提出预测性触觉条件策略，利用预测潜在作为接触先验，通过交叉注意力建模触觉演变，并通过触觉引导门控融合视觉-触觉特征。
在五个代表性任务和三个过程中扰动设置的真实机器人实验中验证了方法优于现有基线，尤其在动态接触干扰下。

papers.title: IMPACT: Learning Internal-Model Predictive Control for Forceful Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Real-world robotic manipulation tasks often involve forceful interactions with the environment, such as using tools of varying weights, transporting objects with different masses, and performing contact-rich tasks like table wiping. Previous learning-based approaches typically employ imitation learning policies that output target end-effector poses tracked by low-level impedance controllers. In these systems, forceful interactions are either implicitly realized through steady-state tracking errors or explicitly commanded using wrist force/torque or tactile sensors. However, implicit approaches generalize poorly across object weights, while explicit approaches require specialized hardware and increase system complexity. In this work, we propose IMPACT, a framework that decouples these forceful tasks into task-planning and internal-model-based predictive control. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves higher success rates and improved generalization to unseen object weights, as well as better safety and energy efficiency.
core_contributions: 提出IMPACT框架，将有力操作任务解耦为任务规划和基于内部模型的预测控制
在仿真和真实世界实验中验证了框架在成功率、泛化性、安全性和能效方面的优势
papers.abstract_zh: 真实世界的机器人操作任务通常涉及与环境的有力交互，例如使用不同重量的工具、运输不同质量的物体以及执行接触丰富的任务（如擦桌子）。以前基于学习的方法通常采用模仿学习策略，输出由低级阻抗控制器跟踪的目标末端执行器位姿。在这些系统中，有力交互要么通过稳态跟踪误差隐式实现，要么使用腕部力/力矩或触觉传感器显式命令。然而，隐式方法在不同物体重量下泛化性差，而显式方法需要专门的硬件并增加系统复杂性。在这项工作中，我们提出了IMPACT，一个将这些有力任务解耦为任务规划和基于内部模型的预测控制的框架。广泛的仿真和真实世界实验表明，所提出的框架实现了更高的成功率、对未见物体重量的更好泛化性，以及更好的安全性和能效。

papers.title: Dream-Tac: A Unified Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: World action models inherit the predictive capability of world models, enabling action generation to be guided by anticipated future observations. However, they rely primarily on vision and often fail in contact-rich manipulation, where critical cues arise from physical interaction. In this paper, we propose Dream-Tac, a unified Tactile-World Action Model that jointly models actions, future visual observations, and tactile dynamics. Specifically, Dream-Tac introduces (i) contact-gated visuotactile fusion to selectively integrate tactile signals and (ii) a contact-aware attention bias to better regulate cross-modal interactions during manipulation. To support real-time deployment, we further design a dual-level acceleration strategy, reformulating the contact-aware bias to preserve the fused attention path during training and introducing cache-based diffusion acceleration at inference, achieving up to 2.9$\times$ faster training and 1.8$\times$ faster inference. Across six contact-rich manipulation tasks, Dream-Tac improves action accuracy by 31.7\% on average, demonstrating the effectiveness of unified visuotactile world modeling.Code is available at https://github.com/LYFCLOUDFAN/Dream-Tac.
core_contributions: 提出Dream-Tac，一个统一的触觉-世界动作模型，联合建模动作、未来视觉观察和触觉动态
引入接触门控视觉-触觉融合，选择性整合触觉信号

提出双级加速策略（训练时重新制定偏置+推理时缓存扩散加速），实现2.9倍训练加速和1.8倍推理加速
在六个接触丰富操作任务上平均提高31.7%的动作准确性
papers.abstract_zh: 世界动作模型继承了世界模型的预测能力，使得动作生成能够由预期的未来观察引导。然而，它们主要依赖视觉，在接触丰富的操作中常常失败，因为关键线索来自物理交互。在本文中，我们提出了Dream-Tac，一个统一的触觉-世界动作模型，联合建模动作、未来视觉观察和触觉动态。具体来说，Dream-Tac引入了(i)接触门控视觉-触觉融合，以选择性整合触觉信号，以及(ii)接触感知注意力偏置，以更好地调节操作期间的跨模态交互。为了支持实时部署，我们进一步设计了一个双级加速策略，在训练期间重新制定接触感知偏置以保留融合注意力路径，并在推理时引入基于缓存的扩散加速，实现了高达2.9倍的训练加速和1.8倍的推理加速。在六个接触丰富的操作任务中，Dream-Tac平均提高了31.7%的动作准确性，证明了统一视觉-触觉世界建模的有效性。
papers.summary_one_sentence: Dream-Tac提出了一种统一的触觉-世界动作模型，通过接触门控融合和接触感知注意力偏置，在接触丰富操作中显著提升了动作准确性并实现了实时部署加速。

papers.title: VoLo: A Physical Orchestrator for Open-Vocabulary Long-Horizon Manipulation
papers.abstract: Open-vocabulary long-horizon manipulation requires robots to reason over flexible instructions and complex multi-object scenes while adaptively planning, executing, monitoring, and recovering from failures. We address these demands with a closed agent loop in which a VLM orchestrates heterogeneous robot capabilities as interruptible tools. Unlike in virtual AI agents, the timing of decisions, actions and tool calls is important in a physical world that does not pause for reasoning. We refer to this setting as Physical Orchestration, and propose VoLoAgent, a VLM that plans, monitors, and recovers by treating a VLA/WAM as an interruptible tool it steers mid-rollout alongside vision models and action primitives. To evaluate these long-horizon capabilities, we introduce RoboVoLo, a high-fidelity benchmark for open-vocabulary long-horizon manipulation across common sense, memory/state tracking, complex references, and world knowledge, with both task-level success and failure-mode diagnostics. Experiments show VoLoAgent substantially outperforms single VLA/VLM or tool-based systems, with validation on real-robot experiments. Project page: https://chicychen.github.io/VoLo/
core_contributions: 提出物理编排（Physical Orchestration）概念，强调物理世界中决策与动作时序的重要性。
提出VoLoAgent，一个基于VLM的闭环代理，将VLA/WAM、视觉模型和动作原语作为可中断工具进行编排。
引入RoboVoLo基准，用于评估开放词汇长时域操作，涵盖常识、记忆/状态跟踪、复杂引用和世界知识。
通过实验证明VoLoAgent在任务级成功率和失败模式诊断上显著优于单个VLA/VLM或基于工具的系统，并在真实机器人上验证。
papers.abstract_zh: 开放词汇长时域操作要求机器人能够推理灵活指令和复杂多物体场景，同时自适应地规划、执行、监控和从失败中恢复。我们通过一个闭环代理来应对这些需求，其中VLM将异构机器人能力编排为可中断的工具。与虚拟AI代理不同，在物理世界中，决策、动作和工具调用的时机很重要，因为物理世界不会暂停等待推理。我们将这种设置称为物理编排，并提出VoLoAgent，一个VLM，通过将VLA/WAM视为可中断的工具，在滚动过程中与视觉模型和动作原语一起进行规划、监控和恢复。为了评估这些长时域能力，我们引入了RoboVoLo，一个高保真基准，用于开放词汇长时域操作，涵盖常识、记忆/状态跟踪、复杂引用和世界知识，并提供任务级成功率和失败模式诊断。实验表明，VoLoAgent显著优于单个VLA/VLM或基于工具的系统，并在真实机器人实验中得到了验证。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出VoLoAgent，一种利用VLM作为物理编排器实现开放词汇长时域操作的方法，并引入RoboVoLo基准进行评估，实验证明其显著优于现有系统。
papers.research_problem: 如何实现机器人在物理世界中的开放词汇长时域操作，使其能够推理灵活指令、处理复杂多物体场景，并自适应地规划、执行、监控和从失败中恢复。
papers.method_summary: VoLoAgent采用闭环代理架构，由一个VLM作为核心编排器，将异构机器人能力（如VLA/WAM、视觉模型、动作原语）视为可中断的工具，在物理世界滚动过程中动态规划、监控和恢复，通过适时调用这些工具来应对开放词汇长时域操作任务。
papers.experimental_setup: 使用RoboVoLo基准进行评测，该基准包含常识、记忆/状态跟踪、复杂引用和世界知识等任务，并提供任务级成功率和失败模式诊断；此外在真实机器人上进行了验证实验。具体实验细节（如机器人平台、场景数量等）无法从摘要确认。
papers.key_results: VoLoAgent在RoboVoLo基准上显著优于单个VLA/VLM或基于工具的系统，并在真实机器人实验中验证了其有效性。
papers.why_it_matters: 开放词汇长时域操作是机器人具身智能的核心挑战之一，该工作通过物理编排框架有效整合了VLM与多种机器人能力，提升了复杂任务的成功率和鲁棒性，并提供了标准化的评测基准，对推动机器人操作研究具有重要意义。
