papers.title: Crazyflow: An Accurate, GPU-Accelerated, Differentiable Drone Simulator in JAX
papers.abstract: High-quality, large-scale synthetic data from simulations is becoming a cornerstone for pushing the capabilities of robot algorithms. While aerial robotics simulators have evolved to support specialized needs such as fidelity, differentiability, and swarms independently, a unified platform that can synthesize data across all these domains is missing. In this work, we propose Crazyflow, a simulator designed to push the limits of aerial-robotics algorithm development, from model-based to data-driven methods, gradient-based to sampling-based approaches, and single-agent to multi-agent systems. Compared to existing state-of-the-art drone simulators, it achieves speeds more than an order of magnitude faster for a single drone and can simulate thousands of swarms of 4000 drones each. Real-world experiments show Crazyflow supports both analytical-gradient-based policy learning, achieving sub-centimeter trajectory tracking accuracy without domain randomization, and sampling-based obstacle avoidance at speeds exceeding half a billion steps per second. Breaking the traditional train-then-deploy paradigm, we show that its unprecedented speed even enables in-flight reinforcement learning; we demonstrate this by throwing a physical drone into the air and training a recovery policy from scratch in 0.38 seconds, successfully stabilizing the drone. Crazyflow supports multiple levels of simulation abstraction, is directly compatible with all open-source Crazyflie models, and enables rapid reconfiguration across custom drone platforms and applications by providing a light-weight system identification pipeline. By pushing accuracy, speed, and differentiability simultaneously, Crazyflow serves as an open-source resource for synthetic data generation, with emerging capabilities for large-scale parallelization for online, in-execution learning and optimization, opening the door to novel algorithm development.
core_contributions: 提出了Crazyflow仿真器，比现有最先进的无人机仿真器快一个数量级以上。
支持大规模群体仿真，可模拟数千个由4000架无人机组成的群体。
支持基于解析梯度的策略学习，实现亚厘米级轨迹跟踪精度。
支持基于采样的避障，速度超过每秒5亿步。
实现了飞行中的强化学习，在0.38秒内训练恢复策略并成功稳定无人机。
提供多种仿真抽象级别，兼容所有开源Crazyflie模型，并提供轻量级系统识别流水线。
作为开源资源，推动空中机器人算法开发。
papers.abstract_zh: 高质量、大规模的仿真合成数据正成为推动机器人算法能力的关键。虽然空中机器人仿真器已经发展到独立支持诸如保真度、可微性和群体等专门需求，但缺乏一个能够跨所有这些领域合成数据的统一平台。在这项工作中，我们提出了Crazyflow，一个旨在推动空中机器人算法开发极限的仿真器，从基于模型到数据驱动的方法，从基于梯度到基于采样的方法，以及从单智能体到多智能体系统。与现有的最先进的无人机仿真器相比，它实现了单个无人机速度超过一个数量级的提升，并且可以模拟数千个由4000架无人机组成的群体。真实世界实验表明，Crazyflow支持基于解析梯度的策略学习，无需领域随机化即可实现亚厘米级的轨迹跟踪精度，以及以每秒超过5亿步的速度进行基于采样的避障。打破了传统的训练-然后部署范式，我们展示了其前所未有的速度甚至可以实现飞行中的强化学习；我们通过将一架物理无人机抛向空中并在0.38秒内从头训练一个恢复策略来证明这一点，成功稳定了无人机。Crazyflow支持多种级别的仿真抽象，直接兼容所有开源的Crazyflie模型，并通过提供轻量级的系统识别流水线，支持跨自定义无人机平台和应用的快速重新配置。通过同时推动精度、速度和可微性，Crazyflow作为合成数据生成的开源资源，具有大规模并行化在线、执行中学习和优化的新兴能力，为新颖的算法开发打开了大门。
papers.summary_one_sentence: Crazyflow是一个基于JAX的GPU加速、可微分的无人机仿真器，实现了比现有仿真器快一个数量级以上的速度，支持大规模群体仿真和飞行中强化学习。
papers.research_problem: 缺乏一个统一的高保真、可微分、支持群体仿真的空中机器人仿真平台，现有仿真器不能同时满足这些需求。
papers.method_summary: Crazyflow基于JAX框架，利用GPU加速和自动微分实现高速、可微分的仿真。它支持多种仿真抽象级别，并提供系统识别流水线以快速配置自定义无人机平台。
papers.experimental_setup: 真实世界实验包括：基于解析梯度的策略学习（轨迹跟踪）、基于采样的避障（速度测试）以及飞行中强化学习（将无人机抛向空中训练恢复策略）。具体实验环境和数据集未在摘要中详述。
papers.key_results: 速度比现有仿真器快一个数量级以上；可模拟数千个4000架无人机的群体；轨迹跟踪精度达到亚厘米级；避障速度超过5亿步/秒；飞行中强化学习在0.38秒内成功稳定无人机。
papers.why_it_matters: Crazyflow通过同时实现高精度、高速度和可微性，为空中机器人算法开发提供了强大的仿真平台，支持从模型到数据驱动、从梯度到采样、从单智能体到多智能体的广泛方法，并且其速度使得在线学习成为可能，打破了传统的训练-部署范式，为新颖的算法开发打开了大门。

papers.title: Any-ttach: Quick End-effector Swapping Enables Manipulation Dexterity with Simplicity
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation dexterity is often pursued by building increasingly complex high-DoF multifingered hands. While many robotic hands are designed to replicate human morphology, the functional role of human hands suggests a different perspective: much of their complexity may exist to enable tool use and tool making. This observation motivates Any-ttach, a tool-centric manipulation framework that treats quick end-effector swapping as a mechanism for dexterity with simplicity. Any-ttach combines a low-cost automatic swapping mechanism for an open-close robot interface, a handheld device for collecting human demonstrations, and a task planning framework that composes learned, parameterized, and planned tool-use skills. The system supports diverse tools and end-effector modules, including daily tools, articulated tools such as scissors, Fin Ray fingers, and a low-cost anthropomorphic hand, through the same shared interface. Our experiments show that Any-ttach improves tool-swapping reliability, increases demonstration efficiency, reduces tool-pose variability, and supports diverse tool-use skills. In two long-horizon tasks, making a sandwich and preparing a cucumber, Any-ttach executes six tool-use subskills through end-effector switching and execution monitoring. These results suggest that robots can expand manipulation capability not only through more complex end-effectors, but also through rapidly exchangeable tools and end-effector modules. More details and videos are available at https://any-ttach.github.io/.
core_contributions: 提出了Any-ttach框架，以工具为中心，将快速末端执行器交换作为灵巧性机制。
设计了低成本的自动交换机制，用于开合机器人接口。
开发了手持设备用于收集人类演示。
构建了任务规划框架，组合学习、参数化和规划的工具使用技能。
实验证明提高了工具交换可靠性、演示效率，减少了工具姿态变异性，并支持多样化技能。
papers.abstract_zh: 机器人操作的灵巧性通常通过构建越来越复杂的高自由度多指手来实现。虽然许多机器人手被设计来复制人类形态，但人类手的功能角色提出了不同的视角：它们的复杂性可能很大程度上是为了实现工具使用和工具制造。这一观察激发了Any-ttach，一个以工具为中心的操作框架，将快速末端执行器交换视为一种简单实现灵巧性的机制。Any-ttach结合了一个低成本的自动交换机制用于开合机器人接口，一个手持设备用于收集人类演示，以及一个任务规划框架，该框架组合了学习、参数化和规划的工具使用技能。该系统支持多种工具和末端执行器模块，包括日常工具、铰接工具如剪刀、Fin Ray手指，以及一个低成本拟人手，通过相同的共享接口。我们的实验表明，Any-ttach提高了工具交换可靠性，增加了演示效率，减少了工具姿态变异性，并支持多样化的工具使用技能。在两个长时任务中，制作三明治和准备黄瓜，Any-ttach通过末端执行器切换和执行监控执行了六个工具使用子技能。这些结果表明，机器人可以通过快速可交换的工具和末端执行器模块来扩展操作能力，而不仅仅是通过更复杂的末端执行器。更多细节和视频请访问https://any-ttach.github.io/。

papers.image_caption: Fig. 3: System pipeline of Any-ttach. (A) Task Planner: a vision language model decomposes instruction into an ordered sequence of tool–skill pairs. (B) Skill Execution: learning-based policies execute each skill in closed loop using visual and proprioceptive observations. (C) End-effector Swap Primitives: the robot autonomously docks, attaches, and detaches tool modules through the standardized quick-swap interface. papers.title: Tactile-Proprioceptive Sensor Fusion for Contact Wrench Estimation in Whole-Body Physical Human-Robot Interaction
papers.abstract: Direct physical guidance is a natural means of teaching and interacting with robots, and robotic skins make a key contribution by enabling sensitive contact sensing and localization. This paper presents a tactile-proprioceptive sensor fusion framework for natural physical human-robot interaction. Tactile cues from pneumatic skin pads serve as contact indicators that bypass the ambiguity between frictional residues and applied external forces, enabling highly sensitive contact detection without explicit friction identification. We fuse these cues with motor-current-based proprioception to reconstruct multi-axis contact forces on the robot surface. To maintain accuracy during motion, we employ a temporal convolutional network (TCN) to mitigate friction hysteresis during stick-slip transitions, reducing uncertainty at contact onset and yielding smooth, responsive guidance. We validate the approach on a skin-integrated robot arm: (i) multi-axis forces are reconstructed in stationary contacts, and (ii) simultaneous force estimation and kinesthetic teaching are demonstrated. Results indicate improved sensitivity and responsiveness across diverse contact conditions compared with tactile-only and proprioceptive-only baselines, supporting tactile-proprioceptive fusion as a reliable pathway to safe, intuitive physical human-robot interaction.
core_contributions: 提出触觉-本体感觉融合框架用于接触扳手估计，绕过摩擦歧义实现高灵敏度接触检测
利用气动皮肤垫作为接触指示器，无需显式摩擦识别
采用时间卷积网络（TCN）减轻粘滑过渡期间的摩擦滞后，提高运动中的力估计精度
在集成皮肤的机器人手臂上验证了多轴力重建和动觉教学，证明融合方法优于单一模态基线
papers.abstract_zh: 直接物理引导是一种自然的机器人与之交互和教学方式，机器人皮肤通过实现灵敏的接触感知和定位做出了关键贡献。本文提出了一种用于自然物理人机交互的触觉-本体感觉融合框架。来自气动皮肤垫的触觉线索作为接触指示器，绕过了摩擦残留物和施加的外部力之间的歧义，实现了无需明确摩擦识别的高灵敏度接触检测。我们将这些线索与基于电机电流的本体感觉融合，以重建机器人表面上的多轴接触力。为了在运动过程中保持精度，我们采用时间卷积网络（TCN）来减轻粘滑过渡期间的摩擦滞后，减少接触开始时的不确定性，并产生平滑、响应灵敏的引导。我们在集成皮肤的机器人手臂上验证了该方法：（i）在静止接触中重建多轴力，（ii）同时展示了力估计和动觉教学。结果表明，与仅触觉和仅本体感觉的基线相比，在各种接触条件下灵敏度和响应性都有所提高，支持触觉-本体感觉融合作为安全、直观的物理人机交互的可靠途径。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 本文提出一种触觉-本体感觉融合框架，利用气动皮肤垫触觉线索和电机电流本体感觉，结合时间卷积网络处理摩擦滞后，实现多轴接触力重建与动觉教学，提升物理人机交互的灵敏度和响应性。
papers.research_problem: 在物理人机交互中，如何准确估计接触扳手（接触力），特别是解决摩擦残留与外部力之间的歧义以及运动中的摩擦滞后问题。
papers.method_summary: 融合气动皮肤垫的触觉线索（作为接触指示器）与基于电机电流的本体感觉，通过时间卷积网络（TCN）处理摩擦滞后，重建机器人表面多轴接触力。
papers.experimental_setup: 在集成皮肤的机器人手臂上进行实验，包括两个场景：(i) 静止接触中多轴力重建，(ii) 同时进行力估计和动觉教学演示。与仅触觉和仅本体感觉基线比较。
papers.key_results: 与仅触觉和仅本体感觉基线相比，所提融合方法在各种接触条件下提高了灵敏度和响应性，实现了平滑、响应灵敏的引导。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作为安全、直观的物理人机交互提供了可靠途径，通过触觉-本体感觉融合提高了接触检测的灵敏度和力估计的准确性，有助于实现更自然的机器人教学和交互。

papers.title: ForceFlow: Learning to Feel and Act via Contact-Driven Flow Matching
papers.abstract: ForceFlow is a force-aware reactive framework based on flow matching for contact-rich manipulation. It addresses the tendency of high-dimensional visual features to overshadow sparse force signals through temporal force history and joint prediction, aiming for multimodal generalization in contact-stage policy design.

papers.title: To Do or Not to Do: Ensuring the Safety of Visuomotor Policies Learned from Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Task success has historically been the primary measure of policy performance in imitation learning (IL) research. This characteristics strictly limits the ubiquitous applications of IL algorithms in field robotics where safety assurance, in addition to task-success, is of paramount importance. It is often desirable for an IL-powered robot in the field not to roll out a policy, and hence score a poor performance, if the safety is not guaranteed. Although this trade-off between safety and performance is well investigated in classical control literature, policy safety is a heavily underexplored domain in IL research. There is no universal definition of safety in IL. To make things worst, many existing theoretical works on safety is notoriously difficult to extend to IL-powered robots in the field. This paper offers important insights on the safety and performance of IL policies. We propose execution guarantee, a policy-agnostic safety measure that guarantees the maximum task success for a visuomotor IL policy, despite minor run-time changes, from within a specific region in the state space. We leverage recent advances in view synthesis to identify such regions in the state space for an IL policy and explore a fundamental result on set invariance - namely, Nagumo's sub-tangentiality condition - to prove and operationalize execution guarantee from inside that region. Experiments with a Franka robot, both in simulation and real world, demonstrate how the proposed safety analysis allows various IL policies to achieve maximum task success with guarantee. We also demonstrate some interesting results on how a recovery policy - a by-product of the proposed safety analysis - can help to increase the policy performance and thereby mitigating the safety-performance tradeoff in IL.
core_contributions: 提出执行保证（execution guarantee）作为策略无关的安全度量，保证视觉运动IL策略在状态空间特定区域内实现最大任务成功。
利用视图合成的最新进展识别IL策略状态空间中的安全区域。
利用Nagumo的次切条件证明和操作化执行保证。
通过Franka机器人仿真和真实实验验证所提安全分析允许各种IL策略在有保证的情况下实现最大任务成功。
展示恢复策略作为副产品可提高策略性能，缓解安全-性能权衡。
papers.abstract_zh: 任务成功历来是模仿学习（IL）研究中策略性能的主要衡量标准。这一特性严格限制了IL算法在现场机器人中的广泛应用，因为在现场机器人中，除了任务成功之外，安全保证也至关重要。对于现场中由IL驱动的机器人来说，如果安全无法保证，通常希望不执行策略，从而获得较差的性能。尽管安全与性能之间的权衡在经典控制文献中已有充分研究，但策略安全在IL研究中仍是一个严重未被探索的领域。IL中没有通用的安全定义。更糟糕的是，许多现有的安全理论工作很难扩展到现场中由IL驱动的机器人。本文提供了关于IL策略安全性和性能的重要见解。我们提出了执行保证（execution guarantee），一种策略无关的安全度量，它保证视觉运动IL策略在状态空间特定区域内，尽管运行时发生微小变化，也能实现最大任务成功。我们利用视图合成的最新进展来识别IL策略状态空间中的此类区域，并探索集合不变性的基本结果——即Nagumo的次切条件——来证明和操作化从该区域内部的执行保证。使用Franka机器人在仿真和真实世界中的实验展示了所提出的安全分析如何允许各种IL策略在有保证的情况下实现最大任务成功。我们还展示了一些有趣的结果，说明恢复策略（所提出安全分析的副产品）如何帮助提高策略性能，从而缓解IL中的安全-性能权衡。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 本文提出执行保证（execution guarantee）作为模仿学习中视觉运动策略的策略无关安全度量，利用视图合成和Nagumo次切条件保证状态空间特定区域内的最大任务成功，并通过Franka机器人实验验证。
papers.research_problem: 模仿学习中的策略安全未被充分探索，缺乏通用安全定义，现有安全理论难以扩展到IL机器人，需要一种可操作的安全度量来保证视觉运动策略的安全性。

papers.title: Wrench-Aware Admittance Control for Unknown-Payload Manipulation
papers.abstract: Unknown payloads can strongly affect compliant robotic manipulation, especially when the payload center of mass is not aligned with the tool center point. In this case, the payload generates an offset wrench at the robot wrist. During motion, this wrench is not only related to payload weight, but also to payload inertia. If it is not modeled, the compliant controller can interpret it as an external interaction wrench, which causes unintended compliant motion, larger tracking error, and reduced transport accuracy. This paper presents a wrench-aware admittance control framework for unknown-payload pick-and-place using a UR5e robot. The method uses force-torque measurements in two different roles. First, a three-axis translational excitation term is used to reduce payload-induced force effects during transport without making the robot excessively stiff. Second, after grasping, the controller first estimates payload mass for transport compensation and then estimates the payload CoM offset relative to the TCP using wrist force-torque measurements collected during the subsequent translational motion. This helps improve object placement and stacking behavior. Experimental results show improved transport and placement performance compared with uncorrected placement while preserving compliant motion.

papers.title: AI-Enabled Image-Based Hybrid Vision/Force Control of Tendon-Driven Aerial Continuum Manipulators
papers.abstract: This paper presents an AI-enabled cascaded hybrid vision/force control framework for tendon-driven aerial continuum manipulators based on constant-strain modeling in $SE(3)$ as a coupled system. The proposed controller is designed to enable autonomous, physical interaction with a static environment while stabilizing the image feature error. The developed strategy combines the cascaded fast fixed-time sliding mode control and a radial basis function neural network to cope with the uncertainties in the image acquired by the eye-in-hand monocular camera and the measurements from the force sensing apparatus. This ensures rapid, online learning of the vision- and force-related uncertainties without requiring offline training. Furthermore, the features are extracted via a state-of-the-art graph neural network architecture employed by a visual servoing framework using line features, rather than relying on heuristic geometric line extractors, to concurrently contribute to tracking the desired normal interaction force during contact and regulating the image feature error. A comparative study benchmarks the proposed controller against established rigid-arm aerial manipulation methods, evaluating robustness across diverse scenarios and feature extraction strategies. The simulation and experimental results showcase the effectiveness of the proposed methodology under various initial conditions and demonstrate robust performance in executing manipulation tasks.

papers.title: A Physical Agentic Loop for Language-Guided Grasping with Execution-State Monitoring
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation systems that follow language instructions often execute grasp primitives in a largely single-shot manner: a model proposes an action, the robot executes it, and failures such as empty grasps, slips, stalls, timeouts, or semantically wrong grasps are not surfaced to the decision layer in a structured way. Inspired by agentic loops in digital tool-using agents, we reformulate language-guided grasping as a bounded embodied agent operating over grounded execution states, where physical actions expose an explicit tool-state stream. We introduce a physical agentic loop that wraps an unmodified learned manipulation primitive (grasp-and-lift) with (i) an event-based interface and (ii) an execution monitoring layer, Watchdog, which converts noisy gripper telemetry into discrete outcome labels using contact-aware fusion and temporal stabilization. These outcome events, optionally combined with post-grasp semantic verification, are consumed by a deterministic bounded policy that finalizes, retries, or escalates to the user for clarification, guaranteeing finite termination. We validate the resulting loop on a mobile manipulator with an eye-in-hand D405 camera, keeping the underlying grasp model unchanged and evaluating representative scenarios involving visual ambiguity, distractors, and induced execution failures. Results show that explicit execution-state monitoring and bounded recovery enable more robust and interpretable behavior than open-loop execution, while adding minimal architectural overhead. For the source code and demo refer to our project page: https://wenzewwz123.github.io/Agentic-Loop/
core_contributions: 引入物理代理循环，将语言引导的抓取重新定义为有界具身代理，基于接地执行状态操作。
设计基于事件的接口和执行监控层Watchdog，将嘈杂夹爪遥测转换为离散结果标签。
提出确定性有界策略，消费结果事件并决定最终化、重试或升级给用户，保证有限终止。
在移动操作器上验证，保持底层抓取模型不变，在视觉模糊、干扰物和诱导失败场景下展示鲁棒性和可解释性。
papers.abstract_zh: 机器人操作系统在遵循语言指令执行抓取原语时，通常采用单次执行的方式：模型提出动作，机器人执行，而失败（如空抓、滑落、停滞、超时或语义错误的抓取）不会以结构化方式反馈到决策层。受数字工具使用代理中的代理循环启发，我们将语言引导的抓取重新定义为有界具身代理，它基于接地执行状态进行操作，其中物理动作暴露显式的工具状态流。我们引入了一个物理代理循环，它包装了一个未经修改的学习操作原语（抓取并提升），包括（i）基于事件的接口和（ii）执行监控层Watchdog，它使用接触感知融合和时间稳定性将嘈杂的夹爪遥测转换为离散结果标签。这些结果事件，可选地与抓取后语义验证结合，由确定性有界策略消费，该策略最终确定、重试或升级给用户澄清，保证有限终止。我们在带有眼在手D405摄像头的移动操作器上验证了该循环，保持底层抓取模型不变，并评估了涉及视觉模糊、干扰物和诱导执行失败的典型场景。结果表明，显式的执行状态监控和有界恢复比开环执行更鲁棒和可解释，同时增加了最小的架构开销。

papers.image_caption: Fig. 6: End-to-end execution workflow of the proposed system across representative task scenarios. Each row illustrates a complete execution trace, and each column corresponds to a stage of the agentic grasping pipeline. Column 1: Scene observation. The robot observes the scene and receives a natural-language instruction specifying the target object or constraint. Column 2: Target grounding and perception conditioning. The system parses the instruction and applies perception conditioning to isolate the intended target. Depending on the task, non-target objects may be suppressed (black regions) using RGB-D conditioning or instance selection. Column 3: Grasping execution. The robot executes the visual servoing policy to approach and grasp the selected target object while maintaining target consistency. Column 4: Outcome evaluation and final grasp state. The watchdog monitors gripper signals and system state to determine the outcome, enabling bounded decisions such as finalize, retry, or clarification if needed. The four rows correspond to different task scenarios: (top) toy grasping under distractor presence, (second) multiple diverse cups under varying background conditions, (third) two identical cups with the target positioned farther away, and (bottom) selecting the target-colored cup from two differently colored cups. Across scenarios, the system maintains consistent target selection through semantic grounding and outcome-aware execution.

papers.title: Learning When to See and When to Feel: Adaptive Vision-Torque Fusion for Contact-Aware Manipulation
papers.abstract: This work compares force/torque-vision integration strategies within diffusion-based manipulation policies and proposes an adaptive strategy that ignores force/torque during non-contact phases while leveraging vision and torque during contact. The paper reports a 14% success-rate improvement over its strongest baseline.

papers.title: Bayesian Active Object Recognition and 6D Pose Estimation from Multimodal Contact Sensing
papers.abstract: We present an active tactile exploration framework for joint object recognition and 6D pose estimation. The proposed method integrates wrist force/torque sensing, GelSight tactile sensing, and free-space constraints within a Bayesian inference framework that maintains a belief over object class and pose during active tactile exploration. By combining contact and non-contact evidence, the framework reduces ambiguity and improves robustness in the joint class-pose estimation problem. To enable efficient inference in the large hypothesis space, we employ a customized particle filter that progressively samples particles based on new observations. The inferred belief is further used to guide active exploration by selecting informative next touches under reachability constraints. For effective data collection, a motion planning and control framework is developed to plan and execute feasible paths for tactile exploration, handle unexpected contacts and GelSight-surface alignment with tactile servoing. We evaluate the framework in simulation and on a Franka Panda robot using 11 YCB objects. Results show that incorporating tactile and free-space information substantially improves recognition and pose estimation accuracy and stability, while reducing the number of action cycles compared with force/torque-only baselines. Code, dataset, and supplementary material will be made available online.
core_contributions: 提出了一种集成腕部力/力矩传感、GelSight触觉传感和自由空间约束的主动触觉探索框架。

开发了运动规划与控制框架，包括触觉伺服，以执行可行探索路径并处理意外接触。
在仿真和真实机器人上使用11个YCB物体验证了方法，相比力/力矩基线显著提升了性能。

papers.image_caption: Fig. 2 : Overview of the proposed system. The system processes measurements from the GelSight sensor, the force/torque sensor, and robot proprioception to extract contact points and contact-type labels, and to build a free-space map. These observations are then fed to a customized particle filter, which performs Bayesian inference over object class and 6D pose. The particle filter proposes new particles conditioned on the incoming observations, approximates their weights, and mixes them with the existing particle set for subsequent belief updates, yielding both the MAP estimate and the posterior distribution. The MAP estimate is used to select the next target point and approach direction for data collection. Given the target point and approach direction, our planning and control stack generates and executes a trajectory with compliance, and aligns the GelSight sensor with the contact surface once contact is detected. Each module shown in the figure is described in detail in the Section III .
papers.image_caption_zh: 所提出系统的概述。该系统处理来自GelSight传感器、力/力矩传感器和机器人本体感觉的测量数据，提取接触点和接触类型标签，并构建自由空间地图。然后将这些观测输入到定制的粒子滤波器中，对物体类别和六维位姿进行贝叶斯推断。粒子滤波器根据新观测提出新粒子，近似其权重，并与现有粒子集混合以进行后续信念更新，得到最大后验估计和后验分布。最大后验估计用于选择下一个数据采集的目标点和接近方向。给定目标点和接近方向，规划与控制栈生成执行数据采集的运动规划。

papers.title: Force Policy: Learning Hybrid Force-Position Control Policy under Interaction Frame for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation demands human-like integration of perception and force feedback: vision should guide task progress, while high-frequency interaction control must stabilize contact under uncertainty. Existing learning-based policies often entangle these roles in a monolithic network, trading off global generalization against stable local refinement, while control-centric approaches typically assume a known task structure or learn only controller parameters rather than the structure itself. In this paper, we formalize a physically grounded interaction frame, an instantaneous local basis that decouples force regulation from motion execution, and propose a method to recover it from demonstrations. Based on this, we address both issues by proposing Force Policy, a global-local vision-force policy in which a global policy guides free-space actions using vision, and upon contact, a high-frequency local policy with force feedback estimates the interaction frame and executes hybrid force-position control for stable interaction. Real-world experiments across diverse contact-rich tasks show consistent gains over strong baselines, with more robust contact establishment, more accurate force regulation, and reliable generalization to novel objects with varied geometries and physical properties, ultimately improving both contact stability and execution quality. Project page: https://force-policy.github.io/

papers.abstract_zh: 接触丰富的操作需要类似人类的感知和力反馈集成：视觉应引导任务进展，而高频交互控制必须在不确定性下稳定接触。现有的基于学习的策略通常将这些角色纠缠在单一网络中，在全局泛化和稳定局部细化之间权衡，而控制中心的方法通常假设已知的任务结构或仅学习控制器参数而非结构本身。在本文中，我们形式化了一个物理基础的交互帧，一个瞬时局部基，它将力调节与运动执行解耦，并提出了一种从演示中恢复它的方法。基于此，我们通过提出Force Policy来解决这两个问题，这是一种全局-局部视觉-力策略，其中全局策略使用视觉引导自由空间动作，而在接触时，一个带有力反馈的高频局部策略估计交互帧并执行混合力位控制以实现稳定交互。在多种接触丰富的真实世界任务上的实验表明，与强基线相比，该方法持续获得改进，具有更鲁棒的接触建立、更准确的力调节以及对具有不同几何和物理特性的新颖物体的可靠泛化，最终提高了接触稳定性和执行质量。

papers.title: TaF-VLA: Tactile-Force Alignment in Vision-Language-Action Models for Force-aware Manipulation
papers.abstract: TaF-VLA argues that force-aware manipulation requires aligning high-dimensional tactile observations with physical interaction forces rather than treating tactile inputs as auxiliary visual textures. The work introduces an automated tactile-force data acquisition device and collects synchronized visuotactile observations, six-axis force/torque measurements and force maps.

papers.image_caption: Fig. 3 : Overview of the TaF-VLA learning framework. The architecture consists of two distinct stages: (a) Tactile-Force Alignment (TaF-Adapter): We propose a self-supervised learning paradigm. The Force Encoder ( f ϕ ′ , f ϕ ′′ f_{\phi^{\prime}},f_{\phi^{\prime\prime}} ) quantizes heterogeneous force signals, distributed pressure maps, and 6-axis F/T vectors, into two discrete codebooks via vqvae , creating stable physical anchors. The Tactile Encoder ( f causal-TF f_{\textrm{causal-TF}} ) employs a Causal Transformer to process sequential tactile images. These branches are synchronized in a shared latent space via a contrastive InfoNCE objective ( ℒ NCE \mathcal{L}_{\text{NCE}} ), effectively teaching the tactile encoder to infer force dynamics from visual deformation. (b) Policy Integration (TaF-VLA): The pre-trained, frozen TaF-Adapter is integrated into a vla backbone. It injects force-aligned tactile tokens alongside visual and language embeddings, allowing the Action Expert to generate force-aware manipulation trajectories.

papers.title: Diagnose, Correct, and Learn from Manipulation Failures via Visual Symbols
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently achieved remarkable progress in robotic manipulation, yet they remain limited in failure diagnosis and learning from failures. Additionally, existing failure datasets are mostly generated programmatically in simulation, which limits their generalization to the real world. In light of these, we introduce ViFailback, a framework designed to diagnose robotic manipulation failures and provide both textual and visual correction guidance. Our framework utilizes explicit visual symbols to enhance annotation efficiency. We further release the ViFailback dataset, a large-scale collection of 58,126 Visual Question Answering (VQA) pairs along with their corresponding 5,202 real-world manipulation trajectories. Based on the dataset, we establish ViFailback-Bench, a benchmark of 11 fine-grained VQA tasks designed to assess the failure diagnosis and correction abilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), featuring ViFailback-Bench Lite for closed-ended and ViFailback-Bench Hard for open-ended evaluation. To demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework, we built the ViFailback-8B VLM, which not only achieves significant overall performance improvement on ViFailback-Bench but also generates visual symbols for corrective action guidance. Finally, by integrating ViFailback-8B with a VLA model, we conduct real-world robotic experiments demonstrating its ability to assist the VLA model in recovering from failures. Project Website: https://x1nyuzhou.github.io/vifailback.github.io/
core_contributions: 提出ViFailback框架，用于诊断机器人操作失败并提供文本和视觉纠正指导。
发布ViFailback数据集，包含58,126个VQA对和5,202个真实世界操作轨迹。
建立ViFailback-Bench基准，包含11个细粒度VQA任务，用于评估VLM的故障诊断和纠正能力。
构建ViFailback-8B VLM，在基准上取得显著性能提升并生成视觉符号用于纠正动作指导。
通过真实世界机器人实验证明ViFailback-8B能帮助VLA模型从操作失败中恢复。
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型最近在机器人操作中取得了显著进展，但它们在故障诊断和从失败中学习方面仍然有限。此外，现有的故障数据集大多在模拟中程序化生成，限制了它们对真实世界的泛化。鉴于此，我们引入了ViFailback，一个旨在诊断机器人操作失败并提供文本和视觉纠正指导的框架。我们的框架利用显式视觉符号来提高注释效率。我们进一步发布了ViFailback数据集，这是一个大规模集合，包含58,126个视觉问答（VQA）对及其对应的5,202个真实世界操作轨迹。基于该数据集，我们建立了ViFailback-Bench，一个包含11个细粒度VQA任务的基准，旨在评估视觉语言模型（VLM）的故障诊断和纠正能力，包括用于封闭式评估的ViFailback-Bench Lite和用于开放式评估的ViFailback-Bench Hard。为了展示我们框架的有效性，我们构建了ViFailback-8B VLM，它不仅在整个ViFailback-Bench上取得了显著的性能提升，还能生成用于纠正动作指导的视觉符号。最后，通过将ViFailback-8B与VLA模型集成，我们进行了真实世界的机器人实验，证明了它帮助VLA模型从失败中恢复的能力。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 本文提出ViFailback框架，利用显式视觉符号进行机器人操作故障诊断与纠正，并构建了大规模VQA数据集和基准，验证了其在真实世界中的有效性。

papers.title: Self-Supervised Multisensory Pretraining for Contact-Rich Robot Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Effective contact-rich manipulation requires robots to synergistically leverage vision, force, and proprioception. However, Reinforcement Learning agents struggle to learn in such multisensory settings, especially amidst sensory noise and dynamic changes. We propose MultiSensory Dynamic Pretraining (MSDP), a novel framework for learning expressive multisensory representations tailored for task-oriented policy learning. MSDP is based on masked autoencoding and trains a transformer-based encoder by reconstructing multisensory observations from only a subset of sensor embeddings, leading to cross-modal prediction and sensor fusion. For downstream policy learning, we introduce a novel asymmetric architecture, where a cross-attention mechanism allows the critic to extract dynamic, task-specific features from the frozen embeddings, while the actor receives a stable pooled representation to guide its actions. Our method demonstrates accelerated learning and robust performance under diverse perturbations, including sensor noise, and changes in object dynamics. Evaluations in multiple challenging, contact-rich robot manipulation tasks in simulation and the real world showcase the effectiveness of MSDP. Our approach exhibits strong robustness to perturbations and achieves high success rates on the real robot with as few as 6,000 online interactions, offering a simple yet powerful solution for complex multisensory robotic control. Website: https://msdp-pearl.github.io/
core_contributions: 提出MSDP框架，基于掩码自编码从部分传感器嵌入重建完整多感官观测，实现跨模态预测和传感器融合。
引入非对称actor-critic架构，评论家通过交叉注意力从冻结嵌入提取动态任务特征，行动者使用稳定池化表示。
在多个接触丰富的机器人操作任务（仿真和真实世界）中验证了加速学习和鲁棒性能。
在真实机器人上仅用6000次在线交互即实现高成功率，显著提高样本效率。
papers.abstract_zh: 有效的接触丰富操作要求机器人协同利用视觉、力和本体感觉。然而，强化学习智能体在这种多感官设置中难以学习，尤其是在感官噪声和动态变化中。我们提出多感官动态预训练（MSDP），一种新颖的框架，用于学习表达性多感官表示，专门用于面向任务的策略学习。MSDP基于掩码自编码，通过仅从传感器嵌入的子集重建多感官观测来训练基于Transformer的编码器，从而实现跨模态预测和传感器融合。对于下游策略学习，我们引入了一种新颖的非对称架构，其中交叉注意力机制允许评论家从冻结的嵌入中提取动态、任务特定的特征，而行动者接收稳定的池化表示来指导其动作。我们的方法在多种扰动下（包括传感器噪声和物体动态变化）展示了加速学习和鲁棒性能。在仿真和真实世界的多个具有挑战性的接触丰富机器人操作任务中的评估展示了MSDP的有效性。我们的方法对扰动表现出强鲁棒性，并在真实机器人上仅用6000次在线交互就实现了高成功率，为复杂的多感官机器人控制提供了一个简单而强大的解决方案。

papers.abstract: FARM integrates high-dimensional tactile data to infer tactile-conditioned force signals and uses a matching force-based action space. The policy jointly predicts robot pose, grip width and grip force, and is evaluated on tasks with distinct force requirements.

papers.title: Multimodal Anomaly Detection with a Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract: With a growing number of robots being deployed across diverse applications, robust multimodal anomaly detection becomes increasingly important. In robotic manipulation, failures typically arise from (1) robot-driven anomalies due to an insufficient task model or hardware limitations, and (2) environment-driven anomalies caused by dynamic environmental changes or external interferences. Conventional anomaly detection methods focus either on the first by low-level statistical modeling of proprioceptive signals or the second by deep learning-based visual environment observation, each with different computational and training data requirements. To effectively capture anomalies from both sources, we propose a mixture-of-experts framework that integrates the complementary detection mechanisms with a visual-language model for environment monitoring and a Gaussian-mixture regression-based detector for tracking deviations in interaction forces and robot motions. We introduce a confidence-based fusion mechanism that dynamically selects the most reliable detector for each situation. We evaluate our approach on both household and industrial tasks using two robotic systems, demonstrating a 60% reduction in detection delay while improving frame-wise anomaly detection performance compared to individual detectors.
core_contributions: 提出了一个混合专家框架，整合视觉-语言模型用于环境监测和高斯混合回归检测器用于跟踪交互力和机器人运动偏差。
引入了一种基于置信度的融合机制，动态选择每个情况下最可靠的检测器。
在家庭和工业任务中使用两个机器人系统进行评估，检测延迟降低60%，帧级异常检测性能优于单个检测器。
papers.abstract_zh: 随着越来越多的机器人被部署在各种应用中，鲁棒的多模态异常检测变得越来越重要。在机器人操作中，故障通常源于（1）由于任务模型不足或硬件限制导致的机器人驱动异常，以及（2）由动态环境变化或外部干扰引起的环境驱动异常。传统的异常检测方法要么通过本体感知信号的低级统计建模关注前者，要么通过基于深度学习的视觉环境观察关注后者，每种方法都有不同的计算和训练数据需求。为了有效捕获来自两种来源的异常，我们提出了一种混合专家框架，该框架集成了互补的检测机制：一个用于环境监测的视觉-语言模型和一个基于高斯混合回归的检测器，用于跟踪交互力和机器人运动中的偏差。我们引入了一种基于置信度的融合机制，动态选择每个情况下最可靠的检测器。我们在家庭和工业任务中使用两个机器人系统评估了我们的方法，结果表明与单个检测器相比，检测延迟降低了60%，同时帧级异常检测性能得到了提升。

papers.title: Adaptive Visuo-Tactile Fusion with Predictive Force Attention for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: This work proposes a force-guided attention fusion module that adaptively adjusts the weights of visual and tactile features without human labeling. The paper reports an average success rate of 93% across three fine-grained contact-rich tasks in real-world experiments.

papers.title: RoboCulture: A Robotics Platform for Automated Biological Experimentation
papers.abstract: Automating biological experimentation remains challenging due to the need for millimeter-scale precision, long and multi-step experiments, and the dynamic nature of living systems. Current liquid handlers only partially automate workflows, requiring human intervention for plate loading, tip replacement, and calibration. Industrial solutions offer more automation but are costly and lack the flexibility needed in research settings. Meanwhile, research in autonomous robotics has yet to bridge the gap for long-duration, failure-sensitive biological experiments. We introduce RoboCulture, a cost-effective and flexible platform that uses a general-purpose robotic manipulator to automate key biological tasks. RoboCulture performs liquid handling, interacts with lab equipment, and leverages computer vision for real-time decisions using optical density-based growth monitoring. We demonstrate a fully autonomous 15-hour yeast culture experiment where RoboCulture uses vision and force feedback and a modular behavior tree framework to robustly execute, monitor, and manage experiments. Video demonstrations of RoboCulture can be found at https://ac-rad.github.io/roboculture.
core_contributions: 提出了RoboCulture平台，一种成本效益高且灵活的自动化生物实验解决方案
使用通用机器人操纵器执行液体处理、实验室设备交互和计算机视觉监控
结合视觉和力反馈以及模块化行为树框架实现长时间实验的稳健执行和监控
在15小时酵母培养实验中验证了平台的完全自主性和可靠性
papers.abstract_zh: 自动化生物实验仍然具有挑战性，因为需要毫米级精度、长时间和多步骤实验以及生命系统的动态特性。当前的液体处理器只能部分自动化工作流程，需要人工干预进行板加载、吸头更换和校准。工业解决方案提供更多自动化，但成本高昂且缺乏研究环境所需的灵活性。同时，自主机器人研究尚未弥合长时间、对失败敏感的生物实验的差距。我们介绍RoboCulture，一个成本效益高且灵活的平台，使用通用机器人操纵器来自动化关键生物任务。RoboCulture执行液体处理，与实验室设备交互，并利用计算机视觉基于光密度生长监测进行实时决策。我们演示了一个完全自主的15小时酵母培养实验，其中RoboCulture使用视觉和力反馈以及模块化行为树框架来稳健地执行、监控和管理实验。RoboCulture的视频演示可在https://ac-rad.github.io/roboculture找到。

papers.image_caption: Fig. 6: Overview of the perception pipeline. Raw images are obtained from the downward facing camera attached to the robot’s end effector. The raw images are preprocessed with a Gaussian blur, normalization and contrast adjustment. The pipette and the well plate are segmented using FastSAM, using point prompts and a text prompt as inputs respectively. The image is converted into a binary edge representation using the Canny algorithm, and masked using the mask obtained from the well plate segmentation. The bounding rectangle produces the corners, which are used to compute a projective transformation to a template well plate. This transform is applied to the template well locations to obtain the image coordinates of each well. The pipette tip coordinates are found using the pipette tip segmentation mask. The error vector between the pipette tip and a desired well can be computed in the image frame and used to control the robot motion via a feedback controller.
papers.image_caption_zh: 感知流水线概述。原始图像来自机器人末端执行器上的朝下摄像头。原始图像经过高斯模糊、归一化和对比度调整预处理。使用FastSAM分别通过点提示和文本提示对移液器和孔板进行分割。图像通过Canny算法转换为二值边缘表示，并使用孔板分割得到的掩码进行掩膜。边界矩形生成角点，用于计算到模板孔板的投影变换。该变换应用于模板孔位置，以获得每个孔的图像坐标。移液器尖端坐标通过移液器尖端分割获得。

papers.title: Hierarchical Task Decomposition for Execution Monitoring and Error Recovery: Understanding the Rationale Behind Task Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Multi-step manipulation tasks where robots interact with their environment and must apply process forces based on the perceived situation remain challenging to learn and prone to execution errors. Accurately simulating these tasks is also difficult. Hence, it is crucial for robust task performance to learn how to coordinate end-effector pose and applied force, monitor execution, and react to deviations. To address these challenges, we propose a learning approach that directly infers both low- and high-level task representations from user demonstrations on the real system. We developed an unsupervised task segmentation algorithm that combines intention recognition and feature clustering to infer the skills of a task. We leverage the inferred characteristic features of each skill in a novel unsupervised anomaly detection approach to identify deviations from the intended task execution. Together, these components form a comprehensive framework capable of incrementally learning task decisions and new behaviors as new situations arise. Compared to state-of-the-art learning techniques, our approach significantly reduces the required amount of training data and computational complexity while efficiently learning complex in-contact behaviors and recovery strategies. Our proposed task segmentation and anomaly detection approaches outperform state-of-the-art methods on force-based tasks evaluated on two different robotic systems.

papers.abstract_zh: 多步操作任务中，机器人需要与环境交互并根据感知情况施加过程力，这类任务学习起来仍然具有挑战性且容易发生执行错误。准确模拟这些任务也很困难。因此，对于鲁棒的任务执行，学习如何协调末端执行器位姿和施加力、监控执行并应对偏差至关重要。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种学习方法，直接从真实系统上的用户演示中推断低层和高层任务表示。我们开发了一种无监督任务分割算法，结合意图识别和特征聚类来推断任务的技能。我们利用每个技能推断出的特征，采用一种新颖的无监督异常检测方法来识别与预期任务执行的偏差。这些组件共同形成了一个综合框架，能够在新情况出现时增量学习任务决策和新行为。与最先进的学习技术相比，我们的方法显著减少了所需的训练数据和计算复杂度，同时有效学习了复杂的接触行为和恢复策略。我们提出的任务分割和异常检测方法在两个不同的机器人系统上评估的基于力的任务中优于最先进的方法。

papers.image_caption: Figure 2 : Our proposed incremental high- and low-level task learning framework. The process of learning a new task starts with an initial teaching sequence \raisebox{-.9pt} {1}⃝ (Sec. 3.1 ), where the user provides several demonstrations of the intended task that are segmented using BNG-IRL to learn an initial task model. The low-level skills of this initial model can then be further refined during the skill refinement teaching sequence \raisebox{-.9pt} {2}⃝ (Sec. 3.2 ), depicted at the bottom. During this phase, the robot performs the initial task, while the user supervises and assists in phases, where the skills need refinement. The recorded training data is used to update the skills. The last teaching sequence \raisebox{-.9pt} {3}⃝ (Sec. 3.3 ) is triggered if the execution module identifies a new anomaly (see Sec. 6.1 and 6.3 ). Similar to the initial teaching sequence, the user provides a demonstration that shows how to recover from the anomaly, which is segmented and appended to the skill during which the anomaly occurred.

papers.title: FoAR: Force-Aware Reactive Policy for Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich tasks present significant challenges for robotic manipulation policies due to complex contact dynamics. FoAR combines high-frequency force/torque sensing with visual inputs and uses a future contact predictor to adjust force/torque usage between non-contact and contact phases. Its reactive controller enables contact-rich tasks through simple position control and is evaluated under unexpected dynamic disturbances.

papers.title: Soft Finger Grasp Force and Contact State Estimation from Tactile Sensors
papers.abstract: Soft robotic fingers can improve adaptability in grasping and manipulation, compensating for geometric variation in object or environmental contact, but today lack force capacity and fine dexterity. Integrated tactile sensors can provide grasp and task information which can improve dexterity,but should ideally not require object-specific training. The total force vector exerted by a finger provides general information to the internal grasp forces (e.g. for grasp stability) and, when summed over fingers, an estimate of the external force acting on the grasped object (e.g. for task-level control). In this study, we investigate the efficacy of estimating finger force from integrated soft sensors and use it to estimate contact states. We use a neural network for force regression, collecting labelled data with a force/torque sensor and a range of test objects. Subsequently, we apply this model in a plug-in task scenario and demonstrate its validity in estimating contact states.

papers.title: Task Success Prediction for Open-Vocabulary Manipulation Based on Multi-Level Aligned Representations
papers.abstract: In this study, we consider the problem of predicting task success for open-vocabulary manipulation by a manipulator, based on instruction sentences and egocentric images before and after manipulation. Conventional approaches, including multimodal large language models (MLLMs), often fail to appropriately understand detailed characteristics of objects and/or subtle changes in the position of objects. We propose Contrastive $λ$-Repformer, which predicts task success for table-top manipulation tasks by aligning images with instruction sentences. Our method integrates the following three key types of features into a multi-level aligned representation: features that preserve local image information; features aligned with natural language; and features structured through natural language. This allows the model to focus on important changes by looking at the differences in the representation between two images. We evaluate Contrastive $λ$-Repformer on a dataset based on a large-scale standard dataset, the RT-1 dataset, and on a physical robot platform. The results show that our approach outperformed existing approaches including MLLMs. Our best model achieved an improvement of 8.66 points in accuracy compared to the representative MLLM-based model.
core_contributions: 提出Contrastive λ-Repformer模型用于开放词汇操作任务成功预测

papers.abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们考虑基于指令句子和操作前后的自我中心图像，预测机械臂在开放词汇操作中的任务成功问题。传统方法，包括多模态大语言模型（MLLM），通常无法正确理解物体的详细特征和/或物体位置的细微变化。我们提出了Contrastive λ-Repformer，通过对齐图像与指令句子来预测桌面操作任务的成功。我们的方法将以下三种关键特征整合到多级对齐表示中：保留局部图像信息的特征；与自然语言对齐的特征；通过自然语言结构化的特征。这使得模型能够通过观察两个图像表示之间的差异来关注重要变化。我们在基于大规模标准数据集RT-1的数据集和物理机器人平台上评估了Contrastive λ-Repformer。结果表明，我们的方法优于包括MLLM在内的现有方法。我们的最佳模型相比代表性MLLM模型在准确率上提高了8.66个百分点。

papers.title: A Self-Correcting Vision-Language-Action Model for Fast and Slow System Manipulation
papers.abstract: SC-VLA integrates a fast system for direct action prediction and a slow system for reflecting on failed actions. It uses parameter-efficient fine-tuning for pose prediction and a chain-of-thought training strategy for failure correction within a VLA policy.
papers.abstract_zh: SC-VLA将直接预测动作的快速系统与失败反思的慢速系统结合，用参数高效微调和失败纠正训练提升操作鲁棒性。

The left part shows the SC-VLA model architecture, where a vision encoder and projection layer transform robot images into LLM language embeddings. papers.title: Multimodal Detection and Identification of Robot Manipulation Failures
papers.abstract: An autonomous service robot should be able to interact with its environment safely and robustly without requiring human assistance. Unstructured environments are challenging for robots since the exact prediction of outcomes is not always possible. Even when the robot behaviors are well-designed, the unpredictable nature of physical robot-object interaction may prevent success in object manipulation. Therefore, execution of a manipulation action may result in an undesirable outcome involving accidents or damages to the objects or environment. Situation awareness becomes important in such cases to enable the robot to (i) maintain the integrity of both itself and the environment, (ii) recover from failed tasks in the short term, and (iii) learn to avoid failures in the long term. For this purpose, robot executions should be continuously monitored, and failures should be detected and classified appropriately. In this work, we focus on detecting and classifying both manipulation and post-manipulation phase failures using the same exteroception setup. We cover a diverse set of failure types for primary tabletop manipulation actions. In order to detect these failures, we propose FINO-Net [1], a deep multimodal sensor fusion based classifier network. Proposed network accurately detects and classifies failures from raw sensory data without any prior knowledge. In this work, we use our extended FAILURE dataset [1] with 99 new multimodal manipulation recordings and annotate them with their corresponding failure types. FINO-Net achieves 0.87 failure detection and 0.80 failure classification F1 scores. Experimental results show that proposed architecture is also appropriate for real-time use.
core_contributions: 提出了FINO-Net，一种深度多模态传感器融合分类器网络，能够从原始传感器数据中检测和分类操作失败，无需先验知识。
扩展了FAILURE数据集，新增99个多模态操作记录并标注了相应的失败类型。
在失败检测和分类任务上分别取得了0.87和0.80的F1分数，并验证了实时适用性。
papers.abstract_zh: 自主服务机器人应能在无需人类协助的情况下安全鲁棒地与环境交互。非结构化环境对机器人具有挑战性，因为无法总是准确预测结果。即使机器人行为设计良好，物理机器人-物体交互的不可预测性也可能阻碍物体操作的成功。因此，执行操作动作可能导致不良后果，包括事故或对物体或环境的损坏。在这种情况下，态势感知变得重要，使机器人能够(i)维护自身和环境的完整性，(ii)在短期内从失败任务中恢复，以及(iii)长期学习避免失败。为此，应持续监控机器人执行，并适当检测和分类失败。在这项工作中，我们专注于使用相同的外部感知设置检测和分类操作阶段和操作后阶段的失败。我们涵盖了主要桌面操作动作的多种失败类型。为了检测这些失败，我们提出了FINO-Net，一种基于深度多模态传感器融合的分类器网络。所提出的网络能够从原始传感器数据中准确检测和分类失败，无需任何先验知识。在这项工作中，我们使用了扩展的FAILURE数据集，包含99个新的多模态操作记录，并标注了相应的失败类型。FINO-Net在失败检测上达到0.87 F1分数，在失败分类上达到0.80 F1分数。实验结果表明，所提出的架构也适用于实时使用。

papers.title: Rotating Objects via In-Hand Pivoting using Vision, Force and Touch
papers.abstract: We propose a robotic manipulation system that can pivot objects on a surface using vision, wrist force and tactile sensing. We aim to control the rotation of an object around the grip point of a parallel gripper by allowing rotational slip, while maintaining a desired wrist force profile. Our approach runs an end-effector position controller and a gripper width controller concurrently in a closed loop. The position controller maintains a desired force using vision and wrist force. The gripper controller uses tactile sensing to keep the grip firm enough to prevent translational slip, but loose enough to induce rotational slip. Our sensor-based control approach relies on matching a desired force profile derived from object dimensions and weight and vision-based monitoring of the object pose. The gripper controller uses tactile sensors to detect and prevent translational slip by tightening the grip when needed. Experimental results where the robot was tasked with rotating cuboid objects 90 degrees show that the multi-modal pivoting approach was able to rotate the objects without causing lift or slip, and was more energy-efficient compared to using a single sensor modality and to pick-and-place. While our work demonstrated the benefit of multi-modal sensing for the pivoting task, further work is needed to generalize our approach to any given object.
core_contributions: 提出了一种结合视觉、腕部力和触觉传感的机器人枢转系统
设计了同时运行末端执行器位置控制器和夹爪宽度控制器的闭环控制方法
通过触觉传感检测和防止平移滑动，同时允许旋转滑动
实验证明了多模态传感相比单一传感器模态和拾取放置更节能
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种机器人操作系统，能够利用视觉、腕部力和触觉传感在表面上枢转物体。我们旨在通过允许旋转滑动来控制物体围绕平行夹爪夹持点的旋转，同时保持期望的腕部力曲线。我们的方法在闭环中同时运行末端执行器位置控制器和夹爪宽度控制器。位置控制器使用视觉和腕部力维持期望的力。夹爪控制器使用触觉传感来保持夹持足够紧以防止平移滑动，但足够松以引起旋转滑动。我们的基于传感器的控制方法依赖于匹配从物体尺寸和重量导出的期望力曲线以及基于视觉的物体姿态监测。夹爪控制器使用触觉传感器检测和防止平移滑动，在需要时收紧夹持。实验结果表明，当机器人被要求将长方体物体旋转90度时，多模态枢转方法能够旋转物体而不引起抬起或滑动，并且与使用单一传感器模态和拾取放置相比更节能。虽然我们的工作展示了多模态传感在枢转任务中的优势，但还需要进一步工作将我们的方法推广到任意物体。

papers.title: Diffusion Policy: Visuomotor Policy Learning via Action Diffusion
papers.abstract: Diffusion Policy represents a visuomotor policy as a conditional denoising diffusion process. It benchmarks across 12 tasks from four robot manipulation benchmarks and reports an average improvement of 46.9% over prior methods. The diffusion formulation handles multimodal action distributions and high-dimensional action spaces.
papers.abstract_zh: Diffusion Policy将视觉运动策略表示为条件去噪扩散过程，在多个机器人操作基准上验证了其对多峰动作分布和高维动作空间的适应性。

At time step t t , the policy takes the latest T o T_{o} steps of observation data O t O_{t} as input and outputs T a T_{a} steps of actions A t A_{t} . b) In the CNN-based Diffusion Policy, FiLM (Feature-wise Linear Modulation) [ 39 ] conditioning of the observation feature O t O_{t} is applied to every convolution layer, channel-wise. papers.title: Probabilistic Contact State Estimation for Legged Robots using Inertial Information
papers.abstract: Legged robot navigation in unstructured and slippery terrains depends heavily on the ability to accurately identify the quality of contact between the robot's feet and the ground. Contact state estimation is regarded as a challenging problem and is typically addressed by exploiting force measurements, joint encoders and/or robot kinematics and dynamics. In contrast to most state of the art approaches, the current work introduces a novel probabilistic method for estimating the contact state based solely on proprioceptive sensing, as it is readily available by Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs) mounted on the robot's end effectors. Capitalizing on the uncertainty of IMU measurements, our method estimates the probability of stable contact. This is accomplished by approximating the multimodal probability density function over a batch of data points for each axis of the IMU with Kernel Density Estimation. The proposed method has been extensively assessed against both real and simulated scenarios on bipedal and quadrupedal robotic platforms such as ATLAS, TALOS and Unitree's GO1.
core_contributions: 提出了一种仅基于IMU的接触状态概率估计方法
利用核密度估计处理IMU数据的不确定性，近似多模态概率密度函数
在双足和四足机器人平台上进行了真实和模拟实验验证
papers.abstract_zh: 足式机器人在非结构化、光滑地形上的导航高度依赖于准确识别机器人脚与地面之间的接触质量。接触状态估计被认为是一个具有挑战性的问题，通常通过利用力测量、关节编码器和/或机器人运动学与动力学来解决。与大多数现有方法不同，本文提出了一种新颖的概率方法，仅基于本体感知（即机器人末端执行器上安装的惯性测量单元（IMU））来估计接触状态。利用IMU测量的不确定性，我们的方法估计稳定接触的概率。这是通过使用核密度估计近似每个IMU轴上一批数据点的多模态概率密度函数来实现的。该方法已在双足和四足机器人平台（如ATLAS、TALOS和Unitree的GO1）上进行了真实和模拟场景的广泛评估。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出了一种仅利用IMU的足式机器人接触状态概率估计方法，通过核密度估计近似多模态概率密度函数来估计稳定接触概率。
papers.research_problem: 如何仅利用本体感知（IMU）准确估计足式机器人在非结构化地形上的接触状态。
papers.method_summary: 基于安装在机器人末端执行器上的IMU测量，通过核密度估计近似每个IMU轴上一批数据点的多模态概率密度函数，从而估计稳定接触的概率。
papers.experimental_setup: 在ATLAS、TALOS和Unitree GO1机器人上进行了真实和模拟场景的实验评估。
papers.key_results: 无法从摘要确认具体数值结果，但方法在多种平台上得到了广泛评估。
papers.why_it_matters: 该方法仅依赖IMU，避免了力传感器等昂贵设备，利用IMU的不确定性进行概率估计，有望提高足式机器人在复杂地形上的接触状态估计鲁棒性。

papers.title: RT-1: Robotics Transformer for Real-World Control at Scale
papers.abstract: RT-1 studies scalable general robotic control through open-ended task-agnostic training and a high-capacity Robotics Transformer. It investigates how diverse real-world robotic data can support generalization across tasks and objects.
papers.abstract_zh: RT-1研究如何利用大规模、多样、任务无关的真实机器人数据训练通用控制Transformer。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 展示了大规模真实机器人数据与Transformer策略结合的通用控制路线。
papers.research_problem: 机器人数据规模和任务多样性不足限制了策略泛化，单任务策略难以复用。
core_contributions: 面向机器人控制的Transformer策略
开放式任务无关数据训练思路
真实世界跨任务泛化研究
papers.method_summary: 将图像、语言和机器人状态编码为序列，由Transformer预测离散化动作。
papers.experimental_setup: 论文面向真实机器人控制和多任务数据；具体数据规模与任务列表需以正文为准。
papers.key_results: 摘要确认研究了跨任务、跨物体泛化，但此处不填未从摘要直接核验的数字。
papers.limitations: 视觉主导且不包含末端F/T，对当前研究更适合作为VLA/通用策略背景。
papers.why_it_matters: 帮助理解为何当前项目应把视觉–力觉分支设计成可插拔的上层状态与反馈模块。
papers.relevance_reason: 研究对象是机器人操作或接触任务；方法包含可迁移的策略学习或多模态建模；具有真实机器人、公开代码或可复现资源线索；有真实机器人实验线索

papers.title: Robust Contact State Estimation in Humanoid Walking Gaits
papers.abstract: In this article, we propose a deep learning framework that provides a unified approach to the problem of leg contact detection in humanoid robot walking gaits. Our formulation accomplishes to accurately and robustly estimate the contact state probability for each leg (i.e., stable or slip/no contact). The proposed framework employs solely proprioceptive sensing and although it relies on simulated ground-truth contact data for the classification process, we demonstrate that it generalizes across varying friction surfaces and different legged robotic platforms and, at the same time, is readily transferred from simulation to practice. The framework is quantitatively and qualitatively assessed in simulation via the use of ground-truth contact data and is contrasted against state of-the-art methods with an ATLAS, a NAO, and a TALOS humanoid robot. Furthermore, its efficacy is demonstrated in base estimation with a real TALOS humanoid. To reinforce further research endeavors, our implementation is offered as an open-source ROS/Python package, coined Legged Contact Detection (LCD).
core_contributions: 提出了一个统一的深度学习框架用于腿部接触检测
仅使用本体感觉实现鲁棒估计
展示了跨不同摩擦表面和机器人平台的泛化能力
实现了从模拟到真实的迁移
提供了开源ROS/Python包LCD
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一个深度学习框架，为人形机器人行走步态中的腿部接触检测问题提供了统一的方法。我们的公式能够准确且鲁棒地估计每条腿的接触状态概率（即稳定或滑动/无接触）。所提出的框架仅使用本体感觉，尽管它依赖于模拟的真实接触数据进行分类过程，但我们证明它能够泛化到不同的摩擦表面和不同的腿式机器人平台，并且同时可以轻松地从模拟转移到实践。该框架在仿真中通过使用真实接触数据进行了定量和定性评估，并与ATLAS、NAO和TALOS人形机器人的最先进方法进行了对比。此外，其有效性在真实TALOS人形机器人的基座估计中得到了展示。为了促进进一步的研究工作，我们的实现作为开源ROS/Python包提供，名为Legged Contact Detection (LCD)。
papers.summary_one_sentence: 提出一个基于深度学习的统一框架，仅使用本体感觉实现人形机器人行走中腿部接触状态的鲁棒估计，并能从模拟泛化到真实机器人。
papers.research_problem: 人形机器人行走步态中的腿部接触状态检测问题，需要准确鲁棒地估计每条腿是稳定接触还是滑动/无接触。
papers.method_summary: 基于深度学习的分类框架，利用本体感觉输入，在模拟数据上训练，估计每条腿的接触状态概率（稳定或滑动/无接触）。
papers.experimental_setup: 在仿真环境中使用真实接触数据进行定量和定性评估，与ATLAS、NAO、TALOS人形机器人的现有方法对比，并在真实TALOS机器人上进行基座估计实验。
papers.key_results: 所提方法能够准确鲁棒地估计接触状态，并成功泛化到不同摩擦表面和机器人平台，且从模拟迁移到真实机器人。
papers.why_it_matters: 提供了一种仅依赖本体感觉的鲁棒接触状态估计方法，能够泛化到不同平台和表面，有利于人形机器人的稳定行走控制，且开源促进研究。
papers.relevance_reason: 研究对象是机器人操作或接触任务；包含接触、滑移、状态或成功判断信号；具有真实机器人、公开代码或可复现资源线索；有公开代码或资源线索
papers.related_to_my_research: 该论文直接涉及接触状态估计，是机器人操作和具身智能中的基础问题；其方法仅使用本体感觉，与力觉感知相关，可作为接触状态估计任务的基线对比或方法参考；同时其开源实现便于集成到相关研究中。
papers.reproduction_value: High: 提供了开源ROS/Python包LCD，便于复现和验证
